3727 // Converts an OpenMP taskloop construct into LLVM IR using OpenMPIRBuilder.
3728 static LogicalResult
3729 convertOmpTaskloopContextOp(omp::TaskloopContextOp contextOp,
3730  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
3731  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
3732  using InsertPointTy = llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy;
3733  mlir::Operation &opInst = *contextOp.getOperation();
3734  omp::TaskloopWrapperOp loopWrapperOp = contextOp.getLoopOp();
3735  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(opInst)))
3736  return failure();
3737 
3738  // It stores the pointer of allocated firstprivate copies,
3739  // which can be used later for freeing the allocated space.
3740  SmallVector<llvm::Value *> llvmFirstPrivateVars;
3741  PrivateVarsInfo privateVarsInfo(contextOp);
3742  TaskContextStructManager taskStructMgr{builder, moduleTranslation,
3743  privateVarsInfo.privatizers};
3744 
3745  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::BasicBlock *> deallocBlocks;
3746  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy allocaIP =
3747  findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation, &deallocBlocks);
3748 
3749  assert(builder.GetInsertPoint() == builder.GetInsertBlock()->end());
3750  llvm::BasicBlock *taskloopStartBlock = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(
3751  builder.getContext(), "omp.taskloop.wrapper.start",
3752  /*Parent=*/builder.GetInsertBlock()->getParent());
3753  llvm::Instruction *branchToTaskloopStartBlock =
3754  builder.CreateBr(taskloopStartBlock);
3755  builder.SetInsertPoint(branchToTaskloopStartBlock);
3756 
3757  llvm::BasicBlock *copyBlock =
3758  splitBB(builder, /*CreateBranch=*/true, "omp.private.copy");
3759  llvm::BasicBlock *initBlock =
3760  splitBB(builder, /*CreateBranch=*/true, "omp.private.init");
3761 
3762  LLVM::ModuleTranslation::SaveStack<OpenMPAllocStackFrame> frame(
3763  moduleTranslation, allocaIP, deallocBlocks);
3764 
3765  // Allocate and initialize private variables
3766  builder.SetInsertPoint(initBlock->getTerminator());
3767 
3768  // TODO: don't allocate if the loop has zero iterations.
3769  taskStructMgr.generateTaskContextStruct();
3770  taskStructMgr.createGEPsToPrivateVars();
3771 
3772  llvmFirstPrivateVars.resize(privateVarsInfo.blockArgs.size());
3773 
3774  for (auto [i, zip] : llvm::enumerate(llvm::zip_equal(
3775  privateVarsInfo.privatizers, privateVarsInfo.mlirVars,
3776  privateVarsInfo.blockArgs, taskStructMgr.getLLVMPrivateVarGEPs()))) {
3777  auto [privDecl, mlirPrivVar, blockArg, llvmPrivateVarAlloc] = zip;
3778  // To be handled inside the taskloop.
3779  if (!privDecl.readsFromMold())
3780  continue;
3781  assert(llvmPrivateVarAlloc &&
3782  "reads from mold so shouldn't have been skipped");
3783 
3784  llvm::Expected<llvm::Value *> privateVarOrErr =
3785  initPrivateVar(builder, moduleTranslation, privDecl, mlirPrivVar,
3786  blockArg, llvmPrivateVarAlloc, initBlock);
3787  if (!privateVarOrErr)
3788  return handleError(privateVarOrErr, *contextOp.getOperation());
3789 
3790  llvmFirstPrivateVars[i] = privateVarOrErr.get();
3791 
3792  llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPointGuard guard(builder);
3793  builder.SetInsertPoint(builder.GetInsertBlock()->getTerminator());
3794 
3795  [[maybe_unused]] llvm::Value *llvmPrivateVar = llvmPrivateVarAlloc;
3796  if ((privateVarOrErr.get() != llvmPrivateVarAlloc) &&
3797  !mlir::isa<LLVM::LLVMPointerType>(blockArg.getType())) {
3798  builder.CreateStore(privateVarOrErr.get(), llvmPrivateVarAlloc);
3799  // Load it so we have the value pointed to by the GEP
3800  llvmPrivateVar = builder.CreateLoad(privateVarOrErr.get()->getType(),
3801  llvmPrivateVarAlloc);
3802  }
3803  assert(llvmPrivateVar->getType() ==
3804  moduleTranslation.convertType(blockArg.getType()));
3805  }
3806 
3807  // firstprivate copy region
3808  setInsertPointForPossiblyEmptyBlock(builder, copyBlock);
3809  if (failed(copyFirstPrivateVars(
3810  contextOp, builder, moduleTranslation, privateVarsInfo.mlirVars,
3811  taskStructMgr.getLLVMPrivateVarGEPs(), privateVarsInfo.privatizers,
3812  contextOp.getPrivateNeedsBarrier())))
3813  return llvm::failure();
3814 
3815  // Resolve and validate reduction / in_reduction declarations up front.
3816  // This is pure MLIR symbol-table work and does not emit IR, so do it
3817  // before moving the builder to the taskloop start block. Richer
3818  // declare_reduction shapes (byref) have been rejected already by
3819  // checkImplementationStatus; the rest (two-argument initializer, cleanup
3820  // region, missing combiner) are rejected by the helper.
3821  SmallVector<omp::DeclareReductionOp> redDecls;
3822  if (failed(collectAndValidateTaskloopRedDecls(
3823  contextOp.getOperation(), contextOp.getReductionSyms(),
3824  "omp.taskloop.context", "reduction", redDecls)))
3825  return failure();
3826  SmallVector<omp::DeclareReductionOp> inRedDecls;
3827  if (failed(collectAndValidateTaskloopRedDecls(
3828  contextOp.getOperation(), contextOp.getInReductionSyms(),
3829  "omp.taskloop.context", "in_reduction", inRedDecls)))
3830  return failure();
3831 
3832  // The op verifier rejects nogroup + reduction, so no check is needed here.
3833 
3834  SmallVector<llvm::Value *> redOrigPtrs;
3835  redOrigPtrs.reserve(redDecls.size());
3836  for (Value v : contextOp.getReductionVars())
3837  redOrigPtrs.push_back(moduleTranslation.lookupValue(v));
3838  SmallVector<llvm::Value *> inRedOrigPtrs;
3839  inRedOrigPtrs.reserve(inRedDecls.size());
3840  for (Value v : contextOp.getInReductionVars())
3841  inRedOrigPtrs.push_back(moduleTranslation.lookupValue(v));
3842 
3843  // Set up insertion point for emitting the implicit-taskgroup reduction
3844  // setup (if any) and for the subsequent call to createTaskloop().
3845  builder.SetInsertPoint(taskloopStartBlock);
3846 
3847  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder &ompBuilderRef = *moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
3848  llvm::Module *module = moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule();
3849 
3850  // If we have task_reduction items, we must emit our own implicit
3851  // __kmpc_taskgroup so that the descriptor returned by __kmpc_taskred_init
3852  // is associated with that taskgroup. We then force NoGroup=true so that
3853  // OpenMPIRBuilder::createTaskloop does not emit a second taskgroup.
3854  bool implicitTaskgroup = !redDecls.empty();
3855  llvm::Value *redDesc = nullptr;
3856  if (implicitTaskgroup) {
3857  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription redLoc(builder);
3858  uint32_t srcLocSize;
3859  llvm::Constant *srcLocStr =
3860  ompBuilderRef.getOrCreateSrcLocStr(redLoc, srcLocSize);
3861  llvm::Value *ident = ompBuilderRef.getOrCreateIdent(srcLocStr, srcLocSize);
3862  // Align OpenMPIRBuilder's internal IRBuilder with `builder` so the
3863  // gtid call lands at our insertion point.
3864  ompBuilderRef.updateToLocation(redLoc);
3865  llvm::Value *outerGtid = ompBuilderRef.getOrCreateThreadID(ident);
3866  llvm::FunctionCallee taskgroupFn = ompBuilderRef.getOrCreateRuntimeFunction(
3867  *module, llvm::omp::OMPRTL___kmpc_taskgroup);
3868  builder.CreateCall(taskgroupFn, {ident, outerGtid});
3869 
3870  redDesc = emitTaskReductionInitCall(redDecls, redOrigPtrs,
3871  "__omp_taskloop_taskred_", builder,
3872  allocaIP, moduleTranslation);
3873  if (!redDesc)
3874  return failure();
3875  }
3876 
3877  auto loopOp = cast<omp::LoopNestOp>(loopWrapperOp.getWrappedLoop());
3878  llvm::Value *lbVal = nullptr;
3879  llvm::Value *ubVal = nullptr;
3880  llvm::Value *stepVal = nullptr;
3881  if (llvm::Error err = computeTaskloopBounds(
3882  loopOp, builder, moduleTranslation, lbVal, ubVal, stepVal))
3883  return handleError(std::move(err), opInst);
3884 
3885  auto bodyCB =
3886  [&](InsertPointTy allocaIP, InsertPointTy codegenIP,
3887  llvm::ArrayRef<llvm::BasicBlock *> deallocBlocks) -> llvm::Error {
3888  // Save the alloca insertion point on ModuleTranslation stack for use in
3889  // nested regions.
3890  LLVM::ModuleTranslation::SaveStack<OpenMPAllocStackFrame> frame(
3891  moduleTranslation, allocaIP, deallocBlocks);
3892 
3893  // translate the body of the taskloop:
3894  builder.restoreIP(codegenIP);
3895 
3896  llvm::BasicBlock *privInitBlock = nullptr;
3897  privateVarsInfo.llvmVars.resize(privateVarsInfo.blockArgs.size());
3898  for (auto [i, zip] : llvm::enumerate(llvm::zip_equal(
3899  privateVarsInfo.blockArgs, privateVarsInfo.privatizers,
3900  privateVarsInfo.mlirVars))) {
3901  auto [blockArg, privDecl, mlirPrivVar] = zip;
3902  // This is handled before the task executes
3903  if (privDecl.readsFromMold())
3904  continue;
3905 
3906  llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPointGuard guard(builder);
3907  llvm::Type *llvmAllocType =
3908  moduleTranslation.convertType(privDecl.getType());
3909  builder.SetInsertPoint(allocaIP.getBlock()->getTerminator());
3910  llvm::Value *llvmPrivateVar = builder.CreateAlloca(
3911  llvmAllocType, /*ArraySize=*/nullptr, "omp.private.alloc");
3912 
3913  llvm::Expected<llvm::Value *> privateVarOrError =
3914  initPrivateVar(builder, moduleTranslation, privDecl, mlirPrivVar,
3915  blockArg, llvmPrivateVar, privInitBlock);
3916  if (!privateVarOrError)
3917  return privateVarOrError.takeError();
3918  moduleTranslation.mapValue(blockArg, privateVarOrError.get());
3919  privateVarsInfo.llvmVars[i] = privateVarOrError.get();
3920  }
3921 
3922  taskStructMgr.createGEPsToPrivateVars();
3923  for (auto [i, llvmPrivVar] :
3924  llvm::enumerate(taskStructMgr.getLLVMPrivateVarGEPs())) {
3925  if (!llvmPrivVar) {
3926  assert(privateVarsInfo.llvmVars[i] &&
3927  "This is added in the loop above");
3928  continue;
3929  }
3930  privateVarsInfo.llvmVars[i] = llvmPrivVar;
3931  }
3932 
3933  // Find and map the addresses of each variable within the taskloop context
3934  // structure
3935  for (auto [blockArg, llvmPrivateVar, privateDecl] :
3936  llvm::zip_equal(privateVarsInfo.blockArgs, privateVarsInfo.llvmVars,
3937  privateVarsInfo.privatizers)) {
3938  // This was handled above.
3939  if (!privateDecl.readsFromMold())
3940  continue;
3941  // Fix broken pass-by-value case for Fortran character boxes
3942  if (!mlir::isa<LLVM::LLVMPointerType>(blockArg.getType())) {
3943  llvmPrivateVar = builder.CreateLoad(
3944  moduleTranslation.convertType(blockArg.getType()), llvmPrivateVar);
3945  }
3946  assert(llvmPrivateVar->getType() ==
3947  moduleTranslation.convertType(blockArg.getType()));
3948  moduleTranslation.mapValue(blockArg, llvmPrivateVar);
3949  }
3950 
3951  // Map reduction and in_reduction block arguments to the per-task private
3952  // storage returned by __kmpc_task_reduction_get_th_data. This call must
3953  // be emitted inside the to-be-outlined task body so that it returns the
3954  // *executing* thread's gtid (not the encountering thread's). The
3955  // taskgroup descriptor `redDesc` is computed in the outer scope and is
3956  // auto-captured into the task shareds aggregate by CodeExtractor during
3957  // OpenMPIRBuilder::finalize. For in_reduction the descriptor is NULL:
3958  // the runtime walks up enclosing taskgroups to find the matching
3959  // task_reduction registration for `origPtr`.
3960  if (!redDecls.empty() || !inRedDecls.empty()) {
3961  auto iface =
3962  cast<omp::BlockArgOpenMPOpInterface>(contextOp.getOperation());
3963  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder &ompB = *moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
3964  llvm::Module *m = moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule();
3965  llvm::LLVMContext &llvmCtx = m->getContext();
3966  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription bodyLoc(builder);
3967  uint32_t srcLocSize;
3968  llvm::Constant *srcLocStr =
3969  ompB.getOrCreateSrcLocStr(bodyLoc, srcLocSize);
3970  llvm::Value *bodyIdent = ompB.getOrCreateIdent(srcLocStr, srcLocSize);
3971  // Align OpenMPIRBuilder's internal IRBuilder with `builder` so the
3972  // gtid call lands inside the to-be-outlined task body.
3973  ompB.updateToLocation(bodyLoc);
3974  llvm::Value *bodyGtid = ompB.getOrCreateThreadID(bodyIdent);
3975  llvm::FunctionCallee getThData = ompB.getOrCreateRuntimeFunction(
3976  *m, llvm::omp::OMPRTL___kmpc_task_reduction_get_th_data);
3977  llvm::Type *ptrTy = llvm::PointerType::getUnqual(llvmCtx);
3978 
3979  // Emit one __kmpc_task_reduction_get_th_data lookup for a reduction /
3980  // in_reduction item and map its block argument to the per-task private
3981  // storage the runtime returns. The runtime entry point takes (and
3982  // returns) a generic, default-address-space `ptr`, so normalize a
3983  // non-default-address-space original pointer to the generic address
3984  // space before the call (mirroring the descriptor setup in
3985  // emitTaskReductionInitCall), and cast the returned private pointer back
3986  // to the block argument's address space when that differs.
3987  auto remapReductionArg = [&](BlockArgument blockArg, llvm::Value *desc,
3988  llvm::Value *origPtr,
3989  const llvm::Twine &name) {
3990  if (auto *origPtrTy =
3991  llvm::dyn_cast<llvm::PointerType>(origPtr->getType());
3992  origPtrTy && origPtrTy->getAddressSpace() != 0)
3993  origPtr = builder.CreateAddrSpaceCast(origPtr, ptrTy);
3994  llvm::Value *priv =
3995  builder.CreateCall(getThData, {bodyGtid, desc, origPtr}, name);
3996  if (auto *argPtrTy = llvm::dyn_cast<llvm::PointerType>(
3997  moduleTranslation.convertType(blockArg.getType()));
3998  argPtrTy && argPtrTy->getAddressSpace() != 0)
3999  priv = builder.CreateAddrSpaceCast(priv, argPtrTy);
4000  moduleTranslation.mapValue(blockArg, priv);
4001  };
4002 
4003  ArrayRef<BlockArgument> redBlockArgs = iface.getReductionBlockArgs();
4004  for (auto [blockArg, origPtr] :
4005  llvm::zip_equal(redBlockArgs, redOrigPtrs))
4006  remapReductionArg(blockArg, redDesc, origPtr, "omp.taskred.priv");
4007  ArrayRef<BlockArgument> inRedBlockArgs = iface.getInReductionBlockArgs();
4008  llvm::Value *nullDesc = llvm::ConstantPointerNull::get(ptrTy);
4009  for (auto [blockArg, origPtr] :
4010  llvm::zip_equal(inRedBlockArgs, inRedOrigPtrs))
4011  remapReductionArg(blockArg, nullDesc, origPtr, "omp.inred.priv");
4012  }
4013 
4014  // Lower the contents of the taskloop context region: this is the body of
4015  // the generated task, not the loop.
4016  auto continuationBlockOrError = convertOmpOpRegions(
4017  contextOp.getRegion(), "omp.taskloop.context.region", builder,
4018  moduleTranslation);
4019 
4020  if (failed(handleError(continuationBlockOrError, opInst)))
4021  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
4022 
4023  builder.SetInsertPoint(continuationBlockOrError.get()->getTerminator());
4024 
4025  // This is freeing the private variables as mapped inside of the task: these
4026  // will be per-task private copies possibly after task duplication. This is
4027  // handled transparently by how these are passed to the structure passed
4028  // into the outlined function. When the task is duplicated, that structure
4029  // is duplicated too.
4030  if (failed(cleanupPrivateVars(contextOp, builder, moduleTranslation,
4031  contextOp.getLoc(), privateVarsInfo)))
4032  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
4033  // Similarly, the task context structure freed inside the task is the
4034  // per-task copy after task duplication.
4035  taskStructMgr.freeStructPtr();
4036 
4037  return llvm::Error::success();
4038  };
4039 
4040  // Taskloop divides into an appropriate number of tasks by repeatedly
4041  // duplicating the original task. Each time this is done, the task context
4042  // structure must be duplicated too.
4043  auto taskDupCB = [&](InsertPointTy allocaIP, InsertPointTy codegenIP,
4044  llvm::Value *destPtr, llvm::Value *srcPtr)
4045  -> llvm::Expected<llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPoint> {
4046  llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPointGuard guard(builder);
4047  builder.restoreIP(codegenIP);
4048 
4049  llvm::Type *ptrTy =
4050  builder.getPtrTy(srcPtr->getType()->getPointerAddressSpace());
4051  llvm::Value *src =
4052  builder.CreateLoad(ptrTy, srcPtr, "omp.taskloop.context.src");
4053 
4054  TaskContextStructManager &srcStructMgr = taskStructMgr;
4055  TaskContextStructManager destStructMgr(builder, moduleTranslation,
4056  privateVarsInfo.privatizers);
4057  destStructMgr.generateTaskContextStruct();
4058  llvm::Value *dest = destStructMgr.getStructPtr();
4059  dest->setName("omp.taskloop.context.dest");
4060  builder.CreateStore(dest, destPtr);
4061 
4062  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> srcGEPs =
4063  srcStructMgr.createGEPsToPrivateVars(src);
4064  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *> destGEPs =
4065  destStructMgr.createGEPsToPrivateVars(dest);
4066 
4067  // Inline init regions.
4068  for (auto [privDecl, mold, blockArg, llvmPrivateVarAlloc] :
4069  llvm::zip_equal(privateVarsInfo.privatizers, srcGEPs,
4070  privateVarsInfo.blockArgs, destGEPs)) {
4071  // To be handled inside task body.
4072  if (!privDecl.readsFromMold())
4073  continue;
4074  assert(llvmPrivateVarAlloc &&
4075  "reads from mold so shouldn't have been skipped");
4076 
4077  llvm::Value *moldArg = materializeRegionArgValue(
4078  builder, moduleTranslation, privDecl.getInitMoldArg(), mold);
4079  llvm::Expected<llvm::Value *> privateVarOrErr = initPrivateVar(
4080  builder, moduleTranslation, privDecl, moldArg, blockArg,
4081  llvmPrivateVarAlloc, builder.GetInsertBlock());
4082  if (!privateVarOrErr)
4083  return privateVarOrErr.takeError();
4084 
4085  setInsertPointForPossiblyEmptyBlock(builder);
4086 
4087  // TODO: this is a bit of a hack for Fortran character boxes.
4088  // Character boxes are passed by value into the init region and then the
4089  // initialized character box is yielded by value. Here we need to store
4090  // the yielded value into the private allocation, and load the private
4091  // allocation to match the type expected by region block arguments.
4092  [[maybe_unused]] llvm::Value *llvmPrivateVar = llvmPrivateVarAlloc;
4093  if ((privateVarOrErr.get() != llvmPrivateVarAlloc) &&
4094  !mlir::isa<LLVM::LLVMPointerType>(blockArg.getType())) {
4095  builder.CreateStore(privateVarOrErr.get(), llvmPrivateVarAlloc);
4096  // Load it so we have the value pointed to by the GEP
4097  llvmPrivateVar = builder.CreateLoad(privateVarOrErr.get()->getType(),
4098  llvmPrivateVarAlloc);
4099  }
4100  assert(llvmPrivateVar->getType() ==
4101  moduleTranslation.convertType(blockArg.getType()));
4102 
4103  // Mapping blockArg -> llvmPrivateVarAlloc is done inside the body
4104  // callback so that OpenMPIRBuilder doesn't try to pass each GEP address
4105  // through a stack allocated structure.
4106  }
4107 
4108  if (failed(copyFirstPrivateVars(contextOp.getOperation(), builder,
4109  moduleTranslation, srcGEPs, destGEPs,
4110  privateVarsInfo.privatizers,
4111  contextOp.getPrivateNeedsBarrier())))
4112  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
4113 
4114  return builder.saveIP();
4115  };
4116 
4117  auto loopInfo = [&]() -> llvm::Expected<llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *> {
4118  llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *loopInfo = findCurrentLoopInfo(moduleTranslation);
4119  return loopInfo;
4120  };
4121 
4122  llvm::Value *ifCond = nullptr;
4123  llvm::Value *grainsize = nullptr;
4124  int sched = 0; // default
4125  mlir::Value grainsizeVal = contextOp.getGrainsize();
4126  mlir::Value numTasksVal = contextOp.getNumTasks();
4127  if (Value ifVar = contextOp.getIfExpr())
4128  ifCond = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(ifVar);
4129  if (grainsizeVal) {
4130  grainsize = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(grainsizeVal);
4131  sched = 1; // grainsize
4132  } else if (numTasksVal) {
4133  grainsize = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(numTasksVal);
4134  sched = 2; // num_tasks
4135  }
4136 
4137  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::TaskDupCallbackTy taskDupOrNull = nullptr;
4138  if (taskStructMgr.getStructPtr())
4139  taskDupOrNull = taskDupCB;
4140 
4141  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder &ompBuilder = *moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
4142  SmallVector<llvm::UncondBrInst *> cancelTerminators;
4143  // The directive to match here is OMPD_taskgroup because it is the
4144  // taskgroup which is canceled. This is handled here because it is the
4145  // task's cleanup block which should be branched to. It doesn't depend upon
4146  // nogroup because even in that case the taskloop might still be inside an
4147  // explicit taskgroup.
4148  pushCancelFinalizationCB(cancelTerminators, builder, ompBuilder, contextOp,
4149  llvm::omp::Directive::OMPD_taskgroup);
4150 
4151  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
4152  bool effectiveNoGroup = contextOp.getNogroup() || implicitTaskgroup;
4153  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterIP =
4154  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->createTaskloop(
4155  ompLoc, allocaIP, deallocBlocks, bodyCB, loopInfo, lbVal, ubVal,
4156  stepVal, contextOp.getUntied(), ifCond, grainsize, effectiveNoGroup,
4157  sched, moduleTranslation.lookupValue(contextOp.getFinal()),
4158  contextOp.getMergeable(),
4159  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(contextOp.getPriority()),
4160  loopOp.getCollapseNumLoops(), taskDupOrNull,
4161  taskStructMgr.getStructPtr());
4162 
4163  if (failed(handleError(afterIP, opInst)))
4164  return failure();
4165 
4166  popCancelFinalizationCB(cancelTerminators, ompBuilder, afterIP.get());
4167 
4168  builder.restoreIP(*afterIP);
4169 
4170  // Close the implicit taskgroup we opened for task_reduction. The end call
4171  // must execute on the encountering thread, so use the outer-scope gtid.
4172  if (implicitTaskgroup) {
4173  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription endLoc(builder);
4174  uint32_t srcLocSize;
4175  llvm::Constant *srcLocStr =
4176  ompBuilder.getOrCreateSrcLocStr(endLoc, srcLocSize);
4177  llvm::Value *ident = ompBuilder.getOrCreateIdent(srcLocStr, srcLocSize);
4178  // Align OpenMPIRBuilder's internal IRBuilder with `builder` so the
4179  // gtid call lands at our insertion point.
4180  ompBuilder.updateToLocation(endLoc);
4181  llvm::Value *outerGtid = ompBuilder.getOrCreateThreadID(ident);
4182  llvm::FunctionCallee endTgFn = ompBuilder.getOrCreateRuntimeFunction(
4183  *moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule(),
4184  llvm::omp::OMPRTL___kmpc_end_taskgroup);
4185  builder.CreateCall(endTgFn, {ident, outerGtid});
4186  }
4187  return success();
4188 }

4190 /// Build an outlined init helper for a task_reduction declare_reduction op.
4191 /// Signature: void(ptr %priv, ptr %orig). For non-byref reductions, the init
4192 /// region's mold argument is mapped following the same rule as the regular
4193 /// reduction path (`mapInitializationArgs`): a non-pointer mold loads the
4194 /// value from %orig, while a pointer-typed mold receives %orig directly. The
4195 /// yielded value is stored into %priv.
4196 static llvm::Function *
4197 emitTaskReductionInitFn(omp::DeclareReductionOp decl, StringRef baseName,
4198  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
4199  llvm::Module *llvmModule = moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule();
4200  llvm::LLVMContext &ctx = llvmModule->getContext();
4201  llvm::Type *voidTy = llvm::Type::getVoidTy(ctx);
4202  llvm::Type *ptrTy = llvm::PointerType::getUnqual(ctx);
4203  llvm::FunctionType *fty =
4204  llvm::FunctionType::get(voidTy, {ptrTy, ptrTy}, false);
4205  llvm::Function *fn =
4206  llvm::Function::Create(fty, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
4207  baseName + ".red.init", llvmModule);
4208  fn->setDoesNotRecurse();
4209  fn->getArg(0)->setName("priv");
4210  fn->getArg(1)->setName("orig");
4211 
4212  llvm::BasicBlock *entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(ctx, "entry", fn);
4213  llvm::IRBuilder<> b(entry);
4214 
4215  // Map the initializer's mold argument the same way the regular reduction
4216  // path does in `mapInitializationArgs`: only load the original value when a
4217  // non-pointer mold is expected. For a pointer-typed mold the storage pointer
4218  // (%orig) is passed through directly, so a mold-yielding initializer lowers
4219  // to `store ptr %orig, ptr %priv` rather than emitting a spurious load.
4220  Value moldArg = decl.getInitializerMoldArg();
4221  llvm::Value *origVal = fn->getArg(1);
4222  if (!isa<LLVM::LLVMPointerType>(moldArg.getType()))
4223  origVal = b.CreateLoad(moduleTranslation.convertType(moldArg.getType()),
4224  fn->getArg(1), "omp.orig");
4225  moduleTranslation.mapValue(moldArg, origVal);
4226  SmallVector<llvm::Value *, 1> phis;
4227  if (failed(inlineConvertOmpRegions(decl.getInitializerRegion(),
4228  "omp.taskred.init", b, moduleTranslation,
4229  &phis))) {
4230  fn->eraseFromParent();
4231  return nullptr;
4232  }
4233  assert(phis.size() == 1 &&
4234  "expected one value yielded from reduction initializer");
4235  b.CreateStore(phis[0], fn->getArg(0));
4236  b.CreateRetVoid();
4237 
4238  moduleTranslation.forgetMapping(decl.getInitializerRegion());
4239  return fn;
4240 }
4241 
4242 /// Build an outlined combiner helper for a task_reduction declare_reduction op.
4243 /// Signature: void(ptr %lhs, ptr %rhs). For non-byref reductions, the values
4244 /// at *%lhs and *%rhs are loaded, fed into the combiner region, and the
4245 /// yielded scalar is stored back into *%lhs.
4246 static llvm::Function *
4247 emitTaskReductionCombFn(omp::DeclareReductionOp decl, StringRef baseName,
4248  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
4249  llvm::Module *llvmModule = moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule();
4250  llvm::LLVMContext &ctx = llvmModule->getContext();
4251  llvm::Type *voidTy = llvm::Type::getVoidTy(ctx);
4252  llvm::Type *ptrTy = llvm::PointerType::getUnqual(ctx);
4253  llvm::FunctionType *fty =
4254  llvm::FunctionType::get(voidTy, {ptrTy, ptrTy}, false);
4255  llvm::Function *fn =
4256  llvm::Function::Create(fty, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
4257  baseName + ".red.comb", llvmModule);
4258  fn->setDoesNotRecurse();
4259  fn->getArg(0)->setName("lhs");
4260  fn->getArg(1)->setName("rhs");
4261 
4262  llvm::BasicBlock *entry = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(ctx, "entry", fn);
4263  llvm::IRBuilder<> b(entry);
4264 
4265  llvm::Type *elemTy = moduleTranslation.convertType(decl.getType());
4266  Block &combBlock = decl.getReductionRegion().front();
4267  assert(combBlock.getNumArguments() == 2 &&
4268  "expected two arguments in declare_reduction combiner");
4269  llvm::Value *lhsVal = b.CreateLoad(elemTy, fn->getArg(0), "omp.lhs");
4270  llvm::Value *rhsVal = b.CreateLoad(elemTy, fn->getArg(1), "omp.rhs");
4271  moduleTranslation.mapValue(combBlock.getArgument(0), lhsVal);
4272  moduleTranslation.mapValue(combBlock.getArgument(1), rhsVal);
4273 
4274  SmallVector<llvm::Value *, 1> phis;
4275  if (failed(inlineConvertOmpRegions(decl.getReductionRegion(),
4276  "omp.taskred.comb", b, moduleTranslation,
4277  &phis))) {
4278  fn->eraseFromParent();
4279  return nullptr;
4280  }
4281  assert(phis.size() == 1 &&
4282  "expected one value yielded from reduction combiner");
4283  b.CreateStore(phis[0], fn->getArg(0));
4284  b.CreateRetVoid();
4285 
4286  moduleTranslation.forgetMapping(decl.getReductionRegion());
4287  return fn;
4288 }
4289 
4290 /// Emit the per-taskgroup task_reduction descriptor array and the
4291 /// `__kmpc_taskred_init` runtime call. \p origPtrs holds the LLVM values for
4292 /// the original (shared) variables, one per declaration in \p redDecls.
4293 /// `builder` must be set to the point at which the descriptor stores and the
4294 /// init call should be emitted; the descriptor array itself is allocated at
4295 /// \p allocaIP. \p helperNamePrefix is used to disambiguate the generated
4296 /// init/combiner helper symbol names between taskgroup and taskloop callers.
4297 ///
4298 /// When \p isModifier is false, emits `__kmpc_taskred_init` and returns the
4299 /// `ptr` value it produces (the taskgroup reduction handle). When \p isModifier
4300 /// is true, emits `__kmpc_taskred_modifier_init` instead to open a
4301 /// task-reduction scope for a parallel or worksharing construct, passing
4302 /// \p isWorksharing as the runtime `is_ws` argument. Returns null on failure.
4303 ///
4304 /// Only the non-byref form is handled here. Byref reductions have already
4305 /// been rejected by `checkImplementationStatus`.
4306 static llvm::Value *emitTaskReductionInitCall(
4307  ArrayRef<omp::DeclareReductionOp> redDecls,
4308  ArrayRef<llvm::Value *> origPtrs, StringRef helperNamePrefix,
4309  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder, llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy allocaIP,
4310  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation, bool isModifier,
4311  bool isWorksharing) {
4312  assert(redDecls.size() == origPtrs.size() &&
4313  "expected one orig pointer per reduction decl");
4314  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
4315  llvm::Module *llvmModule = moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule();
4316  llvm::LLVMContext &ctx = llvmModule->getContext();
4317  const llvm::DataLayout &dl = llvmModule->getDataLayout();
4318 
4319  llvm::Type *ptrTy = llvm::PointerType::getUnqual(ctx);
4320  llvm::Type *i32Ty = llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(ctx);
4321  llvm::Type *sizeTy =
4322  llvm::Type::getIntNTy(ctx, dl.getPointerSizeInBits(/*AddrSpace=*/0));
4323 
4324  // Identified `kmp_taskred_input_t` struct, matching the layout used by
4325  // Clang's CGOpenMPRuntime::emitTaskReductionInit.
4326  llvm::StructType *redInputTy =
4327  llvm::StructType::getTypeByName(ctx, "kmp_taskred_input_t");
4328  if (!redInputTy)
4329  redInputTy = llvm::StructType::create(
4330  ctx, {ptrTy, ptrTy, sizeTy, ptrTy, ptrTy, ptrTy, i32Ty},
4331  "kmp_taskred_input_t");
4332 
4333  unsigned n = redDecls.size();
4334  llvm::ArrayType *arrTy = llvm::ArrayType::get(redInputTy, n);
4335 
4336  // Allocate the descriptor array in the enclosing function's alloca block.
4337  llvm::AllocaInst *arrAlloca;
4338  {
4339  llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPointGuard guard(builder);
4340  builder.restoreIP(allocaIP);
4341  arrAlloca =
4342  builder.CreateAlloca(arrTy, /*ArraySize=*/nullptr, ".taskred.input");
4343  }
4344 
4345  // Fill each descriptor entry at the current builder insertion point.
4346  llvm::Value *zero = builder.getInt32(0);
4347  for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
4348  omp::DeclareReductionOp decl = redDecls[i];
4349  llvm::Value *orig = origPtrs[i];
4350  if (auto *origPtrTy = llvm::dyn_cast<llvm::PointerType>(orig->getType());
4351  origPtrTy && origPtrTy->getAddressSpace() != 0)
4352  orig = builder.CreateAddrSpaceCast(orig, ptrTy);
4353  llvm::Type *elemTy = moduleTranslation.convertType(decl.getType());
4354  uint64_t size = dl.getTypeAllocSize(elemTy).getFixedValue();
4355 
4356  std::string baseName =
4357  (llvm::Twine(helperNamePrefix) + decl.getSymName()).str();
4358  llvm::Function *initFn =
4359  emitTaskReductionInitFn(decl, baseName, moduleTranslation);
4360  llvm::Function *combFn =
4361  emitTaskReductionCombFn(decl, baseName, moduleTranslation);
4362  if (!initFn || !combFn)
4363  return nullptr;
4364  llvm::Value *elemPtr = builder.CreateInBoundsGEP(
4365  arrTy, arrAlloca, {zero, builder.getInt32(i)}, ".taskred.elem");
4366  auto storeField = [&](unsigned fieldIdx, llvm::Value *val) {
4367  llvm::Value *fieldPtr =
4368  builder.CreateStructGEP(redInputTy, elemPtr, fieldIdx);
4369  builder.CreateStore(val, fieldPtr);
4370  };
4371  storeField(0, orig); // reduce_shar
4372  storeField(1, orig); // reduce_orig
4373  storeField(2, llvm::ConstantInt::get(sizeTy, size)); // reduce_size
4374  storeField(3, initFn); // reduce_init
4375  storeField(4, llvm::ConstantPointerNull::get(ptrTy)); // reduce_fini
4376  storeField(5, combFn); // reduce_comb
4377  storeField(6, llvm::ConstantInt::get(i32Ty, 0)); // flags
4378  }
4379 
4380  // Emit the runtime call that registers the task reduction data.
4381  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
4382  uint32_t srcLocSize;
4383  llvm::Constant *srcLocStr =
4384  ompBuilder->getOrCreateSrcLocStr(ompLoc, srcLocSize);
4385  llvm::Value *ident = ompBuilder->getOrCreateIdent(srcLocStr, srcLocSize);
4386  ompBuilder->updateToLocation(ompLoc);
4387  llvm::Value *gtid = ompBuilder->getOrCreateThreadID(ident);
4388  if (isModifier) {
4389  // __kmpc_taskred_modifier_init(loc, gtid, is_ws, num, &arr) opens a
4390  // task-reduction scope for the enclosing parallel/worksharing region.
4391  llvm::FunctionCallee modInit = ompBuilder->getOrCreateRuntimeFunction(
4392  *llvmModule, llvm::omp::OMPRTL___kmpc_taskred_modifier_init);
4393  return builder.CreateCall(modInit,
4394  {ident, gtid,
4395  builder.getInt32(isWorksharing ? 1 : 0),
4396  builder.getInt32(n), arrAlloca},
4397  ".taskred.desc");
4398  }
4399  // __kmpc_taskred_init(gtid, num, &arr).
4400  llvm::FunctionCallee taskredInit = ompBuilder->getOrCreateRuntimeFunction(
4401  *llvmModule, llvm::omp::OMPRTL___kmpc_taskred_init);
4402  return builder.CreateCall(taskredInit, {gtid, builder.getInt32(n), arrAlloca},
4403  ".taskred.desc");
4404 }
4405 
4406 /// Emits `__kmpc_task_reduction_modifier_fini(loc, gtid, is_ws)` at the current
4407 /// builder insertion point, closing the task-reduction scope opened by the
4408 /// `task` reduction modifier on a parallel or worksharing construct.
4409 static void
4410 emitTaskReductionModifierFini(bool isWorksharing, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
4411  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
4412  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
4413  llvm::Module *llvmModule = moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule();
4414  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
4415  uint32_t srcLocSize;
4416  llvm::Constant *srcLocStr =
4417  ompBuilder->getOrCreateSrcLocStr(ompLoc, srcLocSize);
4418  llvm::Value *ident = ompBuilder->getOrCreateIdent(srcLocStr, srcLocSize);
4419  ompBuilder->updateToLocation(ompLoc);
4420  llvm::Value *gtid = ompBuilder->getOrCreateThreadID(ident);
4421  llvm::FunctionCallee fini = ompBuilder->getOrCreateRuntimeFunction(
4422  *llvmModule, llvm::omp::OMPRTL___kmpc_task_reduction_modifier_fini);
4423  builder.CreateCall(fini,
4424  {ident, gtid, builder.getInt32(isWorksharing ? 1 : 0)});
4425 }

4427 /// Converts an OpenMP taskgroup construct into LLVM IR using OpenMPIRBuilder.
4428 static LogicalResult
4429 convertOmpTaskgroupOp(omp::TaskgroupOp tgOp, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
4430  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
4431  using InsertPointTy = llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy;
4432  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(*tgOp)))
4433  return failure();
4434 
4435  // Resolve and validate task_reduction declarations up front. We only handle
4436  // declare_reduction ops shaped like a non-byref scalar reduction in this
4437  // first cut; richer shapes (two-argument initializer, cleanup region,
4438  // missing combiner) require additional infrastructure.
4439  SmallVector<omp::DeclareReductionOp> redDecls;
4440  if (auto syms = tgOp.getTaskReductionSyms()) {
4441  redDecls.reserve(syms->size());
4442  for (auto sym : syms->getAsRange<SymbolRefAttr>()) {
4443  auto decl = SymbolTable::lookupNearestSymbolFrom<omp::DeclareReductionOp>(
4444  tgOp, sym);
4445  if (!decl)
4446  return tgOp.emitError()
4447  << "failed to resolve task_reduction declare_reduction symbol "
4448  << sym.getRootReference() << " in omp.taskgroup";
4449  if (decl.getInitializerRegion().front().getNumArguments() != 1)
4450  return tgOp.emitError("not yet implemented: task_reduction with "
4451  "two-argument initializer in omp.taskgroup");
4452  if (!decl.getCleanupRegion().empty())
4453  return tgOp.emitError("not yet implemented: task_reduction with "
4454  "cleanup region in omp.taskgroup");
4455  if (decl.getReductionRegion().empty())
4456  return tgOp.emitError("task_reduction declare_reduction is missing a "
4457  "combiner region");
4458  redDecls.push_back(decl);
4459  }
4460  }
4461 
4462  auto bodyCB =
4463  [&](InsertPointTy allocaIP, InsertPointTy codegenIP,
4464  llvm::ArrayRef<llvm::BasicBlock *> deallocBlocks) -> llvm::Error {
4465  builder.restoreIP(codegenIP);
4466 
4467  if (!redDecls.empty()) {
4468  SmallVector<llvm::Value *> origPtrs;
4469  origPtrs.reserve(redDecls.size());
4470  for (Value v : tgOp.getTaskReductionVars())
4471  origPtrs.push_back(moduleTranslation.lookupValue(v));
4472  if (!emitTaskReductionInitCall(redDecls, origPtrs, "__omp_taskred_",
4473  builder, allocaIP, moduleTranslation))
4474  return llvm::createStringError(
4475  llvm::inconvertibleErrorCode(),
4476  "failed to emit task_reduction initialization for omp.taskgroup");
4477  }
4478 
4479  // Inside the taskgroup body, each task_reduction block argument refers to
4480  // the same shared/original storage that the runtime now knows about via
4481  // the descriptor array. Inner tasks that declare in_reduction look up
4482  // per-task private copies through the runtime; the taskgroup body itself
4483  // uses the original variable.
4484  for (auto [i, blockArg] :
4485  llvm::enumerate(tgOp.getRegion().getArguments())) {
4486  llvm::Value *orig =
4487  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(tgOp.getTaskReductionVars()[i]);
4488  moduleTranslation.mapValue(blockArg, orig);
4489  }
4490 
4491  return convertOmpOpRegions(tgOp.getRegion(), "omp.taskgroup.region",
4492  builder, moduleTranslation)
4493  .takeError();
4494  };
4495 
4496  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::BasicBlock *> deallocBlocks;
4497  InsertPointTy allocaIP =
4498  findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation, &deallocBlocks);
4499  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
4500  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterIP =
4501  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->createTaskgroup(
4502  ompLoc, allocaIP, deallocBlocks, bodyCB);
4503 
4504  if (failed(handleError(afterIP, *tgOp)))
4505  return failure();
4506 
4507  builder.restoreIP(*afterIP);
4508  return success();
4509 }
4510 
4511 static LogicalResult
4512 convertOmpInteropInitOp(omp::InteropInitOp initOp, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
4513  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
4514  if (!initOp.getDependVars().empty() || initOp.getDependKinds() ||
4515  !initOp.getDependIterated().empty() || initOp.getDependIteratedKinds())
4516  return initOp.emitError()
4517  << "not yet implemented: Unhandled clause depend in "
4518  << omp::InteropInitOp::getOperationName() << " operation";
4519 
4520  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
4521  llvm::Value *interopVar =
4522  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(initOp.getInteropVar());
4523  llvm::Value *device = initOp.getDevice()
4524  ? moduleTranslation.lookupValue(initOp.getDevice())
4525  : nullptr;
4526 
4527  // TODO: Handle depend clauses when supported.
4528  llvm::Value *numDeps = llvm::ConstantInt::get(builder.getInt32Ty(), 0);
4529  llvm::Value *depArray = llvm::ConstantPointerNull::get(builder.getPtrTy());
4530  bool hasNowait = initOp.getNowait();
4531 
4532  // A single `init` clause may list both `target` and `targetsync`, but the
4533  // runtime init call takes a single interop-type. Collapse the set to one
4534  // value, matching Clang: if `target` is present use Target, otherwise
4535  // TargetSync. The offload runtime object model supports only one type per
4536  // object; representing both would require a runtime change.
4537  bool hasTarget = false, hasTargetSync = false;
4538  for (mlir::Attribute typeAttr : initOp.getInteropTypes()) {
4539  switch (cast<omp::InteropTypeAttr>(typeAttr).getValue()) {
4540  case omp::InteropType::target:
4541  hasTarget = true;
4542  break;
4543  case omp::InteropType::targetsync:
4544  hasTargetSync = true;
4545  break;
4546  }
4547  }
4548  llvm::omp::OMPInteropType interopType =
4549  (!hasTarget && hasTargetSync) ? llvm::omp::OMPInteropType::TargetSync
4550  : llvm::omp::OMPInteropType::Target;
4551  ompBuilder->createOMPInteropInit(builder, interopVar, interopType, device,
4552  numDeps, depArray, hasNowait);
4553  return success();
4554 }
4555

4610 convertOmpTaskwaitOp(omp::TaskwaitOp twOp, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,

4616  if (failed(buildDependData(
4617  twOp.getDependVars(), twOp.getDependKinds(), twOp.getDependIterated(),

4630 /// Converts an OpenMP workshare loop into LLVM IR using OpenMPIRBuilder.
4631 static LogicalResult
4632 convertOmpWsloop(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
4633  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
4634  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
4635  auto wsloopOp = cast<omp::WsloopOp>(opInst);
4636  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(opInst)))
4637  return failure();
4638 
4639  auto loopOp = cast<omp::LoopNestOp>(wsloopOp.getWrappedLoop());
4640  llvm::ArrayRef<bool> isByRef = getIsByRef(wsloopOp.getReductionByref());
4641  assert(isByRef.size() == wsloopOp.getNumReductionVars());
4642 
4643  // Static is the default.
4644  auto schedule =
4645  wsloopOp.getScheduleKind().value_or(omp::ClauseScheduleKind::Static);
4646 
4647  // Find the loop configuration.
4648  llvm::Value *step = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(loopOp.getLoopSteps()[0]);
4649  llvm::Type *ivType = step->getType();
4650  llvm::Value *chunk = nullptr;
4651  if (wsloopOp.getScheduleChunk()) {
4652  llvm::Value *chunkVar =
4653  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(wsloopOp.getScheduleChunk());
4654  chunk = builder.CreateSExtOrTrunc(chunkVar, ivType);
4655  }
4656 
4657  omp::DistributeOp distributeOp = nullptr;
4658  llvm::Value *distScheduleChunk = nullptr;
4659  bool hasDistSchedule = false;
4660  if (llvm::isa_and_present<omp::DistributeOp>(opInst.getParentOp())) {
4661  distributeOp = cast<omp::DistributeOp>(opInst.getParentOp());
4662  hasDistSchedule = distributeOp.getDistScheduleStatic();
4663  if (distributeOp.getDistScheduleChunkSize()) {
4664  llvm::Value *chunkVar = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(
4665  distributeOp.getDistScheduleChunkSize());
4666  distScheduleChunk = builder.CreateSExtOrTrunc(chunkVar, ivType);
4667  }
4668  }
4669 
4670  PrivateVarsInfo privateVarsInfo(wsloopOp);
4671 
4672  SmallVector<omp::DeclareReductionOp> reductionDecls;
4673  collectReductionDecls(wsloopOp, reductionDecls);
4674 
4675  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy allocaIP =
4676  findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation);
4677 
4678  SmallVector<llvm::Value *> privateReductionVariables(
4679  wsloopOp.getNumReductionVars());
4680 
4681  llvm::Expected<llvm::BasicBlock *> afterAllocas = allocatePrivateVars(
4682  wsloopOp, builder, moduleTranslation, privateVarsInfo, allocaIP);
4683  if (handleError(afterAllocas, opInst).failed())
4684  return failure();
4685 
4686  DenseMap<Value, llvm::Value *> reductionVariableMap;
4687 
4688  MutableArrayRef<BlockArgument> reductionArgs =
4689  cast<omp::BlockArgOpenMPOpInterface>(opInst).getReductionBlockArgs();
4690 
4691  SmallVector<DeferredStore> deferredStores;
4692 
4693  if (failed(allocReductionVars(wsloopOp, reductionArgs, builder,
4694  moduleTranslation, allocaIP, reductionDecls,
4695  privateReductionVariables, reductionVariableMap,
4696  deferredStores, isByRef)))
4697  return failure();
4698 
4699  if (handleError(initPrivateVars(builder, moduleTranslation, privateVarsInfo),
4700  opInst)
4701  .failed())
4702  return failure();
4703 
4704  if (failed(copyFirstPrivateVars(
4705  wsloopOp, builder, moduleTranslation, privateVarsInfo.mlirVars,
4706  privateVarsInfo.llvmVars, privateVarsInfo.privatizers,
4707  wsloopOp.getPrivateNeedsBarrier())))
4708  return failure();
4709 
4710  assert(afterAllocas.get()->getSinglePredecessor());
4711  if (failed(initReductionVars(wsloopOp, reductionArgs, builder,
4712  moduleTranslation,
4713  afterAllocas.get()->getSinglePredecessor(),
4714  reductionDecls, privateReductionVariables,
4715  reductionVariableMap, isByRef, deferredStores)))
4716  return failure();
4717 
4718  // For `reduction(task, ...)` open a task-reduction scope for the worksharing
4719  // loop. Participating explicit tasks accumulate into the per-thread private
4720  // copies, which the worksharing reduction then combines across threads.
4721  bool isTaskReductionMod =
4722  wsloopOp.getReductionMod() == omp::ReductionModifier::task &&
4723  wsloopOp.getNumReductionVars() > 0;
4724  if (isTaskReductionMod &&
4725  !emitTaskReductionInitCall(reductionDecls, privateReductionVariables,
4726  "__omp_taskred_mod_", builder, allocaIP,
4727  moduleTranslation, /*isModifier=*/true,
4728  /*isWorksharing=*/true))
4729  return wsloopOp.emitError(
4730  "failed to emit task reduction modifier initialization");
4731 
4732  // TODO: Handle doacross loops when the ordered clause has a parameter.
4733  bool isOrdered = wsloopOp.getOrdered().has_value();
4734  std::optional<omp::ScheduleModifier> scheduleMod = wsloopOp.getScheduleMod();
4735  bool isSimd = wsloopOp.getScheduleSimd();
4736  bool loopNeedsBarrier = !wsloopOp.getNowait();
4737 
4738  // The only legal way for the direct parent to be omp.distribute is that this
4739  // represents 'distribute parallel do'. Otherwise, this is a regular
4740  // worksharing loop.
4741  llvm::omp::WorksharingLoopType workshareLoopType =
4742  llvm::isa_and_present<omp::DistributeOp>(opInst.getParentOp())
4743  ? llvm::omp::WorksharingLoopType::DistributeForStaticLoop
4744  : llvm::omp::WorksharingLoopType::ForStaticLoop;
4745 
4746  SmallVector<llvm::UncondBrInst *> cancelTerminators;
4747  pushCancelFinalizationCB(cancelTerminators, builder, *ompBuilder, wsloopOp,
4748  llvm::omp::Directive::OMPD_for);
4749 
4750  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
4751 
4752  // Initialize linear variables and linear step
4753  LinearClauseProcessor linearClauseProcessor;
4754 
4755  if (!wsloopOp.getLinearVars().empty()) {
4756  auto linearVarTypes = wsloopOp.getLinearVarTypes().value();
4757  for (mlir::Attribute linearVarType : linearVarTypes)
4758  linearClauseProcessor.registerType(moduleTranslation, linearVarType);
4759 
4760  for (auto [idx, linearVar] : llvm::enumerate(wsloopOp.getLinearVars()))
4761  linearClauseProcessor.createLinearVar(
4762  builder, moduleTranslation, moduleTranslation.lookupValue(linearVar),
4763  idx);
4764  for (mlir::Value linearStep : wsloopOp.getLinearStepVars())
4765  linearClauseProcessor.initLinearStep(moduleTranslation, linearStep);
4766  }
4767 
4768  llvm::Expected<llvm::BasicBlock *> regionBlock = convertOmpOpRegions(
4769  wsloopOp.getRegion(), "omp.wsloop.region", builder, moduleTranslation);
4770 
4771  if (failed(handleError(regionBlock, opInst)))
4772  return failure();
4773 
4774  llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *loopInfo = findCurrentLoopInfo(moduleTranslation);
4775 
4776  // Emit Initialization and Update IR for linear variables
4777  if (!wsloopOp.getLinearVars().empty()) {
4778  linearClauseProcessor.initLinearVar(builder, moduleTranslation,
4779  loopInfo->getPreheader());
4780  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterBarrierIP =
4781  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->createBarrier(
4782  builder, llvm::omp::OMPD_barrier);
4783  if (failed(handleError(afterBarrierIP, *loopOp)))
4784  return failure();
4785  builder.restoreIP(*afterBarrierIP);
4786  linearClauseProcessor.updateLinearVar(builder, loopInfo->getBody(),
4787  loopInfo->getIndVar());
4788  linearClauseProcessor.splitLinearFiniBB(builder, loopInfo->getExit());
4789  }
4790 
4791  builder.SetInsertPoint(*regionBlock, (*regionBlock)->begin());
4792 
4793  // Check if we can generate no-loop kernel
4794  bool noLoopMode = false;
4795  omp::TargetOp targetOp = wsloopOp->getParentOfType<mlir::omp::TargetOp>();
4796  if (targetOp &&
4797  targetOp.getKernelType() == omp::TargetExecMode::spmd_no_loop) {
4798  Operation *targetCapturedOp =
4799  cast<omp::ComposableOpInterface>(*targetOp).findCapturedOp();
4800  // We need this check because, without it, noLoopMode would be set to true
4801  // for every omp.wsloop nested inside a no-loop SPMD target region, even if
4802  // that loop is not the top-level SPMD one.
4803  if (loopOp == targetCapturedOp)
4804  noLoopMode = true;
4805  }
4806 
4807  for (size_t index = 0; index < wsloopOp.getLinearVars().size(); index++)
4808  linearClauseProcessor.rewriteInPlace(builder, loopInfo->getBody(),
4809  loopInfo->getLatch(), index);
4810 
4811  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy wsloopIP =
4812  ompBuilder->applyWorkshareLoop(
4813  ompLoc.DL, loopInfo, allocaIP, loopNeedsBarrier,
4814  convertToScheduleKind(schedule), chunk, isSimd,
4815  scheduleMod == omp::ScheduleModifier::monotonic,
4816  scheduleMod == omp::ScheduleModifier::nonmonotonic, isOrdered,
4817  workshareLoopType, noLoopMode, hasDistSchedule, distScheduleChunk);
4818 
4819  if (failed(handleError(wsloopIP, opInst)))
4820  return failure();
4821 
4822  // Emit finalization and in-place rewrites for linear vars.
4823  if (!wsloopOp.getLinearVars().empty()) {
4824  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy oldIP = builder.saveIP();
4825  assert(loopInfo->getLastIter() &&
4826  "`lastiter` in CanonicalLoopInfo is nullptr");
4827  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterBarrierIP =
4828  linearClauseProcessor.finalizeLinearVar(builder, moduleTranslation,
4829  loopInfo->getLastIter());
4830  if (failed(handleError(afterBarrierIP, *loopOp)))
4831  return failure();
4832 
4833  builder.restoreIP(oldIP);
4834  }
4835 
4836  // Set the correct branch target for task cancellation
4837  popCancelFinalizationCB(cancelTerminators, *ompBuilder, wsloopIP.get());
4838 
4839  // Close the task-reduction scope before the worksharing reduction combine.
4840  if (isTaskReductionMod)
4841  emitTaskReductionModifierFini(/*isWorksharing=*/true, builder,
4842  moduleTranslation);
4843 
4844  // Process the reductions if required.
4845  if (failed(createReductionsAndCleanup(
4846  wsloopOp, builder, moduleTranslation, allocaIP, reductionDecls,
4847  privateReductionVariables, isByRef, wsloopOp.getNowait(),
4848  /*isTeamsReduction=*/false)))
4849  return failure();
4850 
4851  return cleanupPrivateVars(wsloopOp, builder, moduleTranslation,
4852  wsloopOp.getLoc(), privateVarsInfo);
4853 }
4854 
4855 /// Converts the OpenMP parallel operation to LLVM IR.
4856 static LogicalResult
4857 convertOmpParallel(omp::ParallelOp opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
4858  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
4859  using InsertPointTy = llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy;
4860  ArrayRef<bool> isByRef = getIsByRef(opInst.getReductionByref());
4861  assert(isByRef.size() == opInst.getNumReductionVars());
4862  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
4863  bool isCancellable = constructIsCancellable(opInst);
4864 
4865  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(*opInst)))
4866  return failure();
4867 
4868  PrivateVarsInfo privateVarsInfo(opInst);
4869  for (Value allocatorVar : opInst.getAllocatorVars()) {
4870  if (privateVarsInfo.convertedAllocators.contains(allocatorVar))
4871  continue;
4872 
4873  llvm::Value *allocator = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(allocatorVar);
4874  if (!allocator)
4875  return opInst.emitError("failed to translate OpenMP allocator operand");
4876  if (allocator->getType()->isIntegerTy())
4877  allocator = builder.CreateIntToPtr(allocator, builder.getPtrTy());
4878  else if (allocator->getType()->isPointerTy())
4879  allocator = builder.CreatePointerBitCastOrAddrSpaceCast(
4880  allocator, builder.getPtrTy());
4881  else
4882  return opInst.emitError(
4883  "OpenMP allocator operand must have integer or pointer type");
4884 
4885  privateVarsInfo.convertedAllocators.try_emplace(allocatorVar, allocator);
4886  }
4887 
4888  // Collect reduction declarations
4889  SmallVector<omp::DeclareReductionOp> reductionDecls;
4890  collectReductionDecls(opInst, reductionDecls);
4891  SmallVector<llvm::Value *> privateReductionVariables(
4892  opInst.getNumReductionVars());
4893  SmallVector<DeferredStore> deferredStores;
4894  // Only open a task-reduction scope when the `task` modifier is present and
4895  // there are reduction variables to combine; otherwise the matching fini in
4896  // the reduction-combine path (guarded by getNumReductionVars() > 0) would be
4897  // skipped, leaving the modifier init unbalanced.
4898  bool isTaskReductionMod =
4899  opInst.getReductionMod() == omp::ReductionModifier::task &&
4900  opInst.getNumReductionVars() > 0;
4901 
4902  auto bodyGenCB =
4903  [&](InsertPointTy allocaIP, InsertPointTy codeGenIP,
4904  llvm::ArrayRef<llvm::BasicBlock *> deallocBlocks) -> llvm::Error {
4905  llvm::Expected<llvm::BasicBlock *> afterAllocas = allocatePrivateVars(
4906  opInst, builder, moduleTranslation, privateVarsInfo, allocaIP);
4907  if (handleError(afterAllocas, *opInst).failed())
4908  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
4909 
4910  // Allocate reduction vars
4911  DenseMap<Value, llvm::Value *> reductionVariableMap;
4912 
4913  MutableArrayRef<BlockArgument> reductionArgs =
4914  cast<omp::BlockArgOpenMPOpInterface>(*opInst).getReductionBlockArgs();
4915 
4916  allocaIP =
4917  InsertPointTy(allocaIP.getBlock(),
4918  allocaIP.getBlock()->getTerminator()->getIterator());
4919 
4920  if (failed(allocReductionVars(
4921  opInst, reductionArgs, builder, moduleTranslation, allocaIP,
4922  reductionDecls, privateReductionVariables, reductionVariableMap,
4923  deferredStores, isByRef)))
4924  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
4925 
4926  assert(afterAllocas.get()->getSinglePredecessor());
4927  builder.restoreIP(codeGenIP);
4928 
4929  if (handleError(
4930  initPrivateVars(builder, moduleTranslation, privateVarsInfo),
4931  *opInst)
4932  .failed())
4933  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
4934 
4935  if (failed(copyFirstPrivateVars(
4936  opInst, builder, moduleTranslation, privateVarsInfo.mlirVars,
4937  privateVarsInfo.llvmVars, privateVarsInfo.privatizers,
4938  opInst.getPrivateNeedsBarrier())))
4939  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
4940 
4941  if (failed(
4942  initReductionVars(opInst, reductionArgs, builder, moduleTranslation,
4943  afterAllocas.get()->getSinglePredecessor(),
4944  reductionDecls, privateReductionVariables,
4945  reductionVariableMap, isByRef, deferredStores)))
4946  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
4947 
4948  // For `reduction(task, ...)` open a task-reduction scope so participating
4949  // explicit tasks accumulate into the per-thread private copies; the
4950  // parallel reduction then combines those copies across the team.
4951  if (isTaskReductionMod &&
4952  !emitTaskReductionInitCall(reductionDecls, privateReductionVariables,
4953  "__omp_taskred_mod_", builder, allocaIP,
4954  moduleTranslation, /*isModifier=*/true,
4955  /*isWorksharing=*/false))
4956  return llvm::createStringError(
4957  "failed to emit task reduction modifier initialization");
4958 
4959  // Save the alloca insertion point on ModuleTranslation stack for use in
4960  // nested regions.
4961  LLVM::ModuleTranslation::SaveStack<OpenMPAllocStackFrame> frame(
4962  moduleTranslation, allocaIP, deallocBlocks);
4963 
4964  // ParallelOp has only one region associated with it.
4965  llvm::Expected<llvm::BasicBlock *> regionBlock = convertOmpOpRegions(
4966  opInst.getRegion(), "omp.par.region", builder, moduleTranslation);
4967  if (!regionBlock)
4968  return regionBlock.takeError();
4969 
4970  // Process the reductions if required.
4971  if (opInst.getNumReductionVars() > 0) {
4972  // Collect reduction info
4973  SmallVector<OwningReductionGen> owningReductionGens;
4974  SmallVector<OwningAtomicReductionGen> owningAtomicReductionGens;
4975  SmallVector<OwningDataPtrPtrReductionGen>
4976  owningReductionGenRefDataPtrGens;
4977  SmallVector<llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::ReductionInfo, 2> reductionInfos;
4978  collectReductionInfo(opInst, builder, moduleTranslation, reductionDecls,
4979  owningReductionGens, owningAtomicReductionGens,
4980  owningReductionGenRefDataPtrGens,
4981  privateReductionVariables, reductionInfos, isByRef);
4982 
4983  // Move to region cont block
4984  builder.SetInsertPoint((*regionBlock)->getTerminator());
4985 
4986  // Close the task-reduction scope before the per-thread reduction
4987  // contributions are combined across the team.
4988  if (isTaskReductionMod)
4989  emitTaskReductionModifierFini(/*isWorksharing=*/false, builder,
4990  moduleTranslation);
4991 
4992  // Generate reductions from info
4993  llvm::UnreachableInst *tempTerminator = builder.CreateUnreachable();
4994  builder.SetInsertPoint(tempTerminator);
4995 
4996  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy contInsertPoint =
4997  ompBuilder->createReductions(builder, allocaIP, reductionInfos,
4998  isByRef,
4999  /*IsNoWait=*/false,
5000  /*IsTeamsReduction=*/false);
5001  if (!contInsertPoint)
5002  return contInsertPoint.takeError();
5003 
5004  if (!contInsertPoint->getBlock())
5005  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
5006 
5007  tempTerminator->eraseFromParent();
5008  builder.restoreIP(*contInsertPoint);
5009  }
5010 
5011  return llvm::Error::success();
5012  };
5013 
5014  auto privCB = [](InsertPointTy allocaIP, InsertPointTy codeGenIP,
5015  llvm::Value &, llvm::Value &val, llvm::Value *&replVal) {
5016  // tell OpenMPIRBuilder not to do anything. We handled Privatisation in
5017  // bodyGenCB.
5018  replVal = &val;
5019  return codeGenIP;
5020  };
5021 
5022  // TODO: Perform finalization actions for variables. This has to be
5023  // called for variables which have destructors/finalizers.
5024  auto finiCB = [&](InsertPointTy codeGenIP) -> llvm::Error {
5025  InsertPointTy oldIP = builder.saveIP();
5026  builder.restoreIP(codeGenIP);
5027 
5028  // if the reduction has a cleanup region, inline it here to finalize the
5029  // reduction variables
5030  SmallVector<Region *> reductionCleanupRegions;
5031  llvm::transform(reductionDecls, std::back_inserter(reductionCleanupRegions),
5032  [](omp::DeclareReductionOp reductionDecl) {
5033  return &reductionDecl.getCleanupRegion();
5034  });
5035  if (failed(inlineOmpRegionCleanup(
5036  reductionCleanupRegions, privateReductionVariables,
5037  moduleTranslation, builder, "omp.reduction.cleanup")))
5038  return llvm::createStringError(
5039  "failed to inline `cleanup` region of `omp.declare_reduction`");
5040 
5041  if (failed(cleanupPrivateVars(opInst, builder, moduleTranslation,
5042  opInst.getLoc(), privateVarsInfo)))
5043  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
5044 
5045  // If we could be performing cancellation, add the cancellation barrier on
5046  // the way out of the outlined region.
5047  if (isCancellable) {
5048  auto IPOrErr = ompBuilder->createBarrier(
5049  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription(builder),
5050  llvm::omp::Directive::OMPD_unknown,
5051  /* ForceSimpleCall */ false,
5052  /* CheckCancelFlag */ false);
5053  if (!IPOrErr)
5054  return IPOrErr.takeError();
5055  }
5056 
5057  builder.restoreIP(oldIP);
5058  return llvm::Error::success();
5059  };
5060 
5061  llvm::Value *ifCond = nullptr;
5062  if (auto ifVar = opInst.getIfExpr())
5063  ifCond = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(ifVar);
5064  llvm::Value *numThreads = nullptr;
5065  if (!opInst.getNumThreadsVars().empty())
5066  numThreads = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(opInst.getNumThreads(0));
5067  auto pbKind = llvm::omp::OMP_PROC_BIND_default;
5068  if (auto bind = opInst.getProcBindKind())
5069  pbKind = getProcBindKind(*bind);
5070 
5071  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::BasicBlock *> deallocBlocks;
5072  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy allocaIP =
5073  findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation, &deallocBlocks);
5074  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
5075 
5076  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterIP =
5077  ompBuilder->createParallel(ompLoc, allocaIP, deallocBlocks, bodyGenCB,
5078  privCB, finiCB, ifCond, numThreads, pbKind,
5079  isCancellable);
5080 
5081  if (failed(handleError(afterIP, *opInst)))
5082  return failure();
5083 
5084  builder.restoreIP(*afterIP);
5085  return success();
5086 }
5087 
5088 /// Convert Order attribute to llvm::omp::OrderKind.
5089 static llvm::omp::OrderKind
5090 convertOrderKind(std::optional<omp::ClauseOrderKind> o) {
5091  if (!o)
5092  return llvm::omp::OrderKind::OMP_ORDER_unknown;
5093  switch (*o) {
5094  case omp::ClauseOrderKind::Concurrent:
5095  return llvm::omp::OrderKind::OMP_ORDER_concurrent;
5096  }
5097  llvm_unreachable("Unknown ClauseOrderKind kind");
5098 }
5099 
5100 /// Converts an OpenMP simd loop into LLVM IR using OpenMPIRBuilder.
5101 static LogicalResult
5102 convertOmpSimd(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
5103  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
5104  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
5105  auto simdOp = cast<omp::SimdOp>(opInst);
5106 
5107  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(opInst)))
5108  return failure();
5109 
5110  PrivateVarsInfo privateVarsInfo(simdOp);
5111 
5112  MutableArrayRef<BlockArgument> reductionArgs =
5113  cast<omp::BlockArgOpenMPOpInterface>(opInst).getReductionBlockArgs();
5114  DenseMap<Value, llvm::Value *> reductionVariableMap;
5115  SmallVector<llvm::Value *> privateReductionVariables(
5116  simdOp.getNumReductionVars());
5117  SmallVector<DeferredStore> deferredStores;
5118  SmallVector<omp::DeclareReductionOp> reductionDecls;
5119  collectReductionDecls(simdOp, reductionDecls);
5120  llvm::ArrayRef<bool> isByRef = getIsByRef(simdOp.getReductionByref());
5121  assert(isByRef.size() == simdOp.getNumReductionVars());
5122 
5123  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy allocaIP =
5124  findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation);
5125 
5126  llvm::Expected<llvm::BasicBlock *> afterAllocas = allocatePrivateVars(
5127  simdOp, builder, moduleTranslation, privateVarsInfo, allocaIP);
5128  if (handleError(afterAllocas, opInst).failed())
5129  return failure();
5130 
5131  // Initialize linear variables and linear step
5132  LinearClauseProcessor linearClauseProcessor;
5133  if (linearClauseProcessor.initLinearIV(simdOp).failed())
5134  return failure();
5135 
5136  if (!simdOp.getLinearVars().empty()) {
5137  auto linearVarTypes = simdOp.getLinearVarTypes().value();
5138  for (mlir::Attribute linearVarType : linearVarTypes)
5139  linearClauseProcessor.registerType(moduleTranslation, linearVarType);
5140  for (auto [idx, linearVar] : llvm::enumerate(simdOp.getLinearVars())) {
5141  bool isImplicit = false;
5142  for (auto [mlirPrivVar, llvmPrivateVar] : llvm::zip_equal(
5143  privateVarsInfo.mlirVars, privateVarsInfo.llvmVars)) {
5144  // If the linear variable is implicit, reuse the already
5145  // existing llvm::Value
5146  if (linearVar == mlirPrivVar) {
5147  isImplicit = true;
5148  linearClauseProcessor.createLinearVar(builder, moduleTranslation,
5149  llvmPrivateVar, idx);
5150  break;
5151  }
5152  }
5153 
5154  if (!isImplicit)
5155  linearClauseProcessor.createLinearVar(
5156  builder, moduleTranslation,
5157  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(linearVar), idx);
5158  }
5159  for (mlir::Value linearStep : simdOp.getLinearStepVars())
5160  linearClauseProcessor.initLinearStep(moduleTranslation, linearStep);
5161  }
5162 
5163  if (failed(allocReductionVars(simdOp, reductionArgs, builder,
5164  moduleTranslation, allocaIP, reductionDecls,
5165  privateReductionVariables, reductionVariableMap,
5166  deferredStores, isByRef)))
5167  return failure();
5168 
5169  if (handleError(initPrivateVars(builder, moduleTranslation, privateVarsInfo),
5170  opInst)
5171  .failed())
5172  return failure();
5173 
5174  // No call to copyFirstPrivateVars because FIRSTPRIVATE is not allowed for
5175  // SIMD.
5176 
5177  assert(afterAllocas.get()->getSinglePredecessor());
5178  if (failed(initReductionVars(simdOp, reductionArgs, builder,
5179  moduleTranslation,
5180  afterAllocas.get()->getSinglePredecessor(),
5181  reductionDecls, privateReductionVariables,
5182  reductionVariableMap, isByRef, deferredStores)))
5183  return failure();
5184 
5185  llvm::ConstantInt *simdlen = nullptr;
5186  if (std::optional<uint64_t> simdlenVar = simdOp.getSimdlen())
5187  simdlen = builder.getInt64(simdlenVar.value());
5188 
5189  llvm::ConstantInt *safelen = nullptr;
5190  if (std::optional<uint64_t> safelenVar = simdOp.getSafelen())
5191  safelen = builder.getInt64(safelenVar.value());
5192 
5193  llvm::MapVector<llvm::Value *, llvm::Value *> alignedVars;
5194  llvm::omp::OrderKind order = convertOrderKind(simdOp.getOrder());
5195 
5196  llvm::BasicBlock *sourceBlock = builder.GetInsertBlock();
5197  std::optional<ArrayAttr> alignmentValues = simdOp.getAlignments();
5198  mlir::OperandRange operands = simdOp.getAlignedVars();
5199  for (size_t i = 0; i < operands.size(); ++i) {
5200  llvm::Value *alignment = nullptr;
5201  llvm::Value *llvmVal = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(operands[i]);
5202  llvm::Type *ty = llvmVal->getType();
5203 
5204  auto intAttr = cast<IntegerAttr>((*alignmentValues)[i]);
5205  alignment = builder.getInt64(intAttr.getInt());
5206  assert(ty->isPointerTy() && "Invalid type for aligned variable");
5207  assert(alignment && "Invalid alignment value");
5208 
5209  // Check if the alignment value is not a power of 2. If so, skip emitting
5210  // alignment.
5211  if (!intAttr.getValue().isPowerOf2())
5212  continue;
5213 
5214  auto curInsert = builder.saveIP();
5215  builder.SetInsertPoint(sourceBlock);
5216  llvmVal = builder.CreateLoad(ty, llvmVal);
5217  builder.restoreIP(curInsert);
5218  alignedVars[llvmVal] = alignment;
5219  }
5220 
5221  llvm::Expected<llvm::BasicBlock *> regionBlock = convertOmpOpRegions(
5222  simdOp.getRegion(), "omp.simd.region", builder, moduleTranslation);
5223 
5224  if (failed(handleError(regionBlock, opInst)))
5225  return failure();
5226 
5227  llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *loopInfo = findCurrentLoopInfo(moduleTranslation);
5228  // Emit Initialization for linear variables
5229  if (simdOp.getLinearVars().size()) {
5230  linearClauseProcessor.initLinearVar(builder, moduleTranslation,
5231  loopInfo->getPreheader());
5232 
5233  linearClauseProcessor.updateLinearVar(builder, loopInfo->getBody(),
5234  loopInfo->getIndVar());
5235  }
5236  builder.SetInsertPoint(*regionBlock, (*regionBlock)->begin());
5237 
5238  for (size_t index = 0; index < simdOp.getLinearVars().size(); index++)
5239  linearClauseProcessor.rewriteInPlace(builder, loopInfo->getBody(),
5240  loopInfo->getLatch(), index);
5241 
5242  ompBuilder->applySimd(loopInfo, alignedVars,
5243  simdOp.getIfExpr()
5244  ? moduleTranslation.lookupValue(simdOp.getIfExpr())
5245  : nullptr,
5246  order, simdlen, safelen);
5247 
5248  linearClauseProcessor.updateLinearIV(builder, moduleTranslation);
5249  linearClauseProcessor.emitStoresForLinearVar(builder);
5250 
5251  // We now need to reduce the per-simd-lane reduction variable into the
5252  // original variable. This works a bit differently to other reductions (e.g.
5253  // wsloop) because we don't need to call into the OpenMP runtime to handle
5254  // threads: everything happened in this one thread.
5255  for (auto [i, tuple] : llvm::enumerate(
5256  llvm::zip(reductionDecls, isByRef, simdOp.getReductionVars(),
5257  privateReductionVariables))) {
5258  auto [decl, byRef, reductionVar, privateReductionVar] = tuple;
5259 
5260  OwningReductionGen gen = makeReductionGen(decl, builder, moduleTranslation);
5261  llvm::Value *originalVariable = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(reductionVar);
5262  llvm::Type *reductionType = moduleTranslation.convertType(decl.getType());
5263 
5264  // We have one less load for by-ref case because that load is now inside of
5265  // the reduction region.
5266  llvm::Value *redValue = originalVariable;
5267  if (!byRef)
5268  redValue =
5269  builder.CreateLoad(reductionType, redValue, "red.value." + Twine(i));
5270  llvm::Value *privateRedValue = builder.CreateLoad(
5271  reductionType, privateReductionVar, "red.private.value." + Twine(i));
5272  llvm::Value *reduced;
5273 
5274  auto res = gen(builder.saveIP(), redValue, privateRedValue, reduced);
5275  if (failed(handleError(res, opInst)))
5276  return failure();
5277  builder.restoreIP(res.get());
5278 
5279  // For by-ref case, the store is inside of the reduction region.
5280  if (!byRef)
5281  builder.CreateStore(reduced, originalVariable);
5282  }
5283 
5284  // After the construct, deallocate private reduction variables.
5285  SmallVector<Region *> reductionRegions;
5286  llvm::transform(reductionDecls, std::back_inserter(reductionRegions),
5287  [](omp::DeclareReductionOp reductionDecl) {
5288  return &reductionDecl.getCleanupRegion();
5289  });
5290  if (failed(inlineOmpRegionCleanup(reductionRegions, privateReductionVariables,
5291  moduleTranslation, builder,
5292  "omp.reduction.cleanup")))
5293  return failure();
5294 
5295  return cleanupPrivateVars(simdOp, builder, moduleTranslation, simdOp.getLoc(),
5296  privateVarsInfo);
5297 }
5298 
5299 /// Converts an OpenMP loop nest into LLVM IR using OpenMPIRBuilder.
5300 static LogicalResult
5301 convertOmpLoopNest(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
5302  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
5303  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
5304  auto loopOp = cast<omp::LoopNestOp>(opInst);
5305 
5306  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(opInst)))
5307  return failure();
5308 
5309  // Set up the source location value for OpenMP runtime.
5310  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
5311 
5312  // Generator of the canonical loop body.
5313  SmallVector<llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *> loopInfos;
5314  SmallVector<llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy> bodyInsertPoints;
5315  auto bodyGen = [&](llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy ip,
5316  llvm::Value *iv) -> llvm::Error {
5317  // Make sure further conversions know about the induction variable.
5318  moduleTranslation.mapValue(
5319  loopOp.getRegion().front().getArgument(loopInfos.size()), iv);
5320 
5321  // Capture the body insertion point for use in nested loops. BodyIP of the
5322  // CanonicalLoopInfo always points to the beginning of the entry block of
5323  // the body.
5324  bodyInsertPoints.push_back(ip);
5325 
5326  if (loopInfos.size() != loopOp.getNumLoops() - 1)
5327  return llvm::Error::success();
5328 
5329  // Convert the body of the loop.
5330  builder.restoreIP(ip);
5331  llvm::Expected<llvm::BasicBlock *> regionBlock = convertOmpOpRegions(
5332  loopOp.getRegion(), "omp.loop_nest.region", builder, moduleTranslation);
5333  if (!regionBlock)
5334  return regionBlock.takeError();
5335 
5336  builder.SetInsertPoint(*regionBlock, (*regionBlock)->begin());
5337  return llvm::Error::success();
5338  };
5339 
5340  // Delegate actual loop construction to the OpenMP IRBuilder.
5341  // TODO: this currently assumes omp.loop_nest is semantically similar to SCF
5342  // loop, i.e. it has a positive step, uses signed integer semantics.
5343  // Reconsider this code when the nested loop operation clearly supports more
5344  // cases.
5345  for (unsigned i = 0, e = loopOp.getNumLoops(); i < e; ++i) {
5346  llvm::Value *lowerBound =
5347  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(loopOp.getLoopLowerBounds()[i]);
5348  llvm::Value *upperBound =
5349  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(loopOp.getLoopUpperBounds()[i]);
5350  llvm::Value *step = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(loopOp.getLoopSteps()[i]);
5351 
5352  // Make sure loop trip count are emitted in the preheader of the outermost
5353  // loop at the latest so that they are all available for the new collapsed
5354  // loop will be created below.
5355  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription loc = ompLoc;
5356  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy computeIP = ompLoc.IP;
5357  if (i != 0) {
5358  loc = llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription(bodyInsertPoints.back(),
5359  ompLoc.DL);
5360  computeIP = loopInfos.front()->getPreheaderIP();
5361  }
5362 
5363  llvm::Expected<llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *> loopResult =
5364  ompBuilder->createCanonicalLoop(
5365  loc, bodyGen, lowerBound, upperBound, step,
5366  /*IsSigned=*/true, loopOp.getLoopInclusive(), computeIP);
5367 
5368  if (failed(handleError(loopResult, *loopOp)))
5369  return failure();
5370 
5371  loopInfos.push_back(*loopResult);
5372  }
5373 
5374  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy afterIP =
5375  loopInfos.front()->getAfterIP();
5376 
5377  // Do tiling.
5378  if (const auto &tiles = loopOp.getTileSizes()) {
5379  llvm::Type *ivType = loopInfos.front()->getIndVarType();
5380  SmallVector<llvm::Value *> tileSizes;
5381 
5382  for (auto tile : tiles.value()) {
5383  llvm::Value *tileVal = llvm::ConstantInt::get(ivType, tile);
5384  tileSizes.push_back(tileVal);
5385  }
5386 
5387  std::vector<llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *> newLoops =
5388  ompBuilder->tileLoops(ompLoc.DL, loopInfos, tileSizes);
5389 
5390  // Update afterIP to get the correct insertion point after
5391  // tiling.
5392  llvm::BasicBlock *afterBB = newLoops.front()->getAfter();
5393  llvm::BasicBlock *afterAfterBB = afterBB->getSingleSuccessor();
5394  afterIP = {afterAfterBB, afterAfterBB->begin()};
5395 
5396  // Update the loop infos.
5397  loopInfos.clear();
5398  for (const auto &newLoop : newLoops)
5399  loopInfos.push_back(newLoop);
5400  } // Tiling done.
5401 
5402  // Do collapse.
5403  const auto &numCollapse = loopOp.getCollapseNumLoops();
5404  SmallVector<llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *> collapseLoopInfos(
5405  loopInfos.begin(), loopInfos.begin() + (numCollapse));
5406 
5407  auto newTopLoopInfo =
5408  ompBuilder->collapseLoops(ompLoc.DL, collapseLoopInfos, {});
5409 
5410  assert(newTopLoopInfo && "New top loop information is missing");
5411  moduleTranslation.stackWalk<OpenMPLoopInfoStackFrame>(
5412  [&](OpenMPLoopInfoStackFrame &frame) {
5413  frame.loopInfo = newTopLoopInfo;
5414  return WalkResult::interrupt();
5415  });
5416 
5417  // Continue building IR after the loop. Note that the LoopInfo returned by
5418  // `collapseLoops` points inside the outermost loop and is intended for
5419  // potential further loop transformations. Use the insertion point stored
5420  // before collapsing loops instead.
5421  builder.restoreIP(afterIP);
5422  return success();
5423 }
5424 
5425 /// Convert an omp.canonical_loop to LLVM-IR
5426 static LogicalResult
5427 convertOmpCanonicalLoopOp(omp::CanonicalLoopOp op, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
5428  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
5429  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
5430 
5431  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription loopLoc(builder);
5432  Value loopIV = op.getInductionVar();
5433  Value loopTC = op.getTripCount();
5434 
5435  llvm::Value *llvmTC = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(loopTC);
5436 
5437  llvm::Expected<llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *> llvmOrError =
5438  ompBuilder->createCanonicalLoop(
5439  loopLoc,
5440  [&](llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy ip, llvm::Value *llvmIV) {
5441  // Register the mapping of MLIR induction variable to LLVM-IR
5442  // induction variable
5443  moduleTranslation.mapValue(loopIV, llvmIV);
5444 
5445  builder.restoreIP(ip);
5446  llvm::Expected<llvm::BasicBlock *> bodyGenStatus =
5447  convertOmpOpRegions(op.getRegion(), "omp.loop.region", builder,
5448  moduleTranslation);
5449 
5450  return bodyGenStatus.takeError();
5451  },
5452  llvmTC, "omp.loop");
5453  if (!llvmOrError)
5454  return op.emitError(llvm::toString(llvmOrError.takeError()));
5455 
5456  llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *llvmCLI = *llvmOrError;
5457  llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPoint afterIP = llvmCLI->getAfterIP();
5458  builder.restoreIP(afterIP);
5459 
5460  // Register the mapping of MLIR loop to LLVM-IR OpenMPIRBuilder loop
5461  if (Value cli = op.getCli())
5462  moduleTranslation.mapOmpLoop(cli, llvmCLI);
5463 
5464  return success();
5465 }

5467 /// Apply a `#pragma omp unroll` / "!$omp unroll" transformation using the
5468 /// OpenMPIRBuilder.
5469 static LogicalResult
5470 applyUnrollHeuristic(omp::UnrollHeuristicOp op, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
5471  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
5472  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
5473 
5474  Value applyee = op.getApplyee();
5475  assert(applyee && "Loop to apply unrolling on required");
5476 
5477  llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *consBuilderCLI =
5478  moduleTranslation.lookupOMPLoop(applyee);
5479  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription loc(builder);
5480  ompBuilder->unrollLoopHeuristic(loc.DL, consBuilderCLI);
5481 
5482  moduleTranslation.invalidateOmpLoop(applyee);
5483  return success();
5484 }

5505 /// Apply a `#pragma omp unroll partial` / `!$omp unroll partial`
5506 /// transformation using the OpenMPIRBuilder.
5507 static LogicalResult
5508 applyUnrollPartial(omp::UnrollPartialOp op, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
5509  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
5510  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
5511 
5512  Value applyee = op.getApplyee();
5513  assert(applyee && "Loop to apply unrolling on required");
5514 
5515  llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *consBuilderCLI =
5516  moduleTranslation.lookupOMPLoop(applyee);
5517  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription loc(builder);
5518 
5519  // No generatee is supported yet, so the unrolled loop's CanonicalLoopInfo is
5520  // not requested and unrolling is deferred to LLVM's LoopUnroll pass.
5521  int32_t factor = static_cast<int32_t>(op.getUnrollFactor());
5522  ompBuilder->unrollLoopPartial(loc.DL, consBuilderCLI, factor,
5523  /*UnrolledCLI=*/nullptr);
5524 
5525  moduleTranslation.invalidateOmpLoop(applyee);
5526  return success();
5527 }
