5529 /// Apply a `#pragma omp tile` / `!$omp tile` transformation using the
5530 /// OpenMPIRBuilder.
5531 static LogicalResult applyTile(omp::TileOp op, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
5532  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
5533  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
5534  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription loc(builder);
5535 
5536  SmallVector<llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *> translatedLoops;
5537  SmallVector<llvm::Value *> translatedSizes;
5538 
5539  for (Value size : op.getSizes()) {
5540  llvm::Value *translatedSize = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(size);
5541  assert(translatedSize &&
5542  "sizes clause arguments must already be translated");
5543  translatedSizes.push_back(translatedSize);
5544  }
5545 
5546  for (Value applyee : op.getApplyees()) {
5547  llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *consBuilderCLI =
5548  moduleTranslation.lookupOMPLoop(applyee);
5549  assert(applyee && "Canonical loop must already been translated");
5550  translatedLoops.push_back(consBuilderCLI);
5551  }
5552 
5553  auto generatedLoops =
5554  ompBuilder->tileLoops(loc.DL, translatedLoops, translatedSizes);
5555  if (!op.getGeneratees().empty()) {
5556  for (auto [mlirLoop, genLoop] :
5557  zip_equal(op.getGeneratees(), generatedLoops))
5558  moduleTranslation.mapOmpLoop(mlirLoop, genLoop);
5559  }
5560 
5561  // CLIs can only be consumed once
5562  for (Value applyee : op.getApplyees())
5563  moduleTranslation.invalidateOmpLoop(applyee);
5564 
5565  return success();
5566 }
5567 
5568 /// Apply a `#pragma omp fuse` / `!$omp fuse` transformation using the
5569 /// OpenMPIRBuilder.
5570 static LogicalResult applyFuse(omp::FuseOp op, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
5571  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
5572  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
5573  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription loc(builder);
5574 
5575  // Select what CLIs are going to be fused
5576  SmallVector<llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *> beforeFuse, toFuse, afterFuse;
5577  for (size_t i = 0; i < op.getApplyees().size(); i++) {
5578  Value applyee = op.getApplyees()[i];
5579  llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *consBuilderCLI =
5580  moduleTranslation.lookupOMPLoop(applyee);
5581  assert(applyee && "Canonical loop must already been translated");
5582  if (op.getFirst().has_value() && i < op.getFirst().value() - 1)
5583  beforeFuse.push_back(consBuilderCLI);
5584  else if (op.getCount().has_value() &&
5585  i >= op.getFirst().value() + op.getCount().value() - 1)
5586  afterFuse.push_back(consBuilderCLI);
5587  else
5588  toFuse.push_back(consBuilderCLI);
5589  }
5590  assert(
5591  (op.getGeneratees().empty() ||
5592  beforeFuse.size() + afterFuse.size() + 1 == op.getGeneratees().size()) &&
5593  "Wrong number of generatees");
5594 
5595  // do the fuse
5596  auto generatedLoop = ompBuilder->fuseLoops(loc.DL, toFuse);
5597  if (!op.getGeneratees().empty()) {
5598  size_t i = 0;
5599  for (; i < beforeFuse.size(); i++)
5600  moduleTranslation.mapOmpLoop(op.getGeneratees()[i], beforeFuse[i]);
5601  moduleTranslation.mapOmpLoop(op.getGeneratees()[i++], generatedLoop);
5602  for (; i < afterFuse.size(); i++)
5603  moduleTranslation.mapOmpLoop(op.getGeneratees()[i], afterFuse[i]);
5604  }
5605 
5606  // CLIs can only be consumed once
5607  for (Value applyee : op.getApplyees())
5608  moduleTranslation.invalidateOmpLoop(applyee);
5609 
5610  return success();
5611 }
5612 
5613 /// Convert an Atomic Ordering attribute to llvm::AtomicOrdering.
5614 static llvm::AtomicOrdering
5615 convertAtomicOrdering(std::optional<omp::ClauseMemoryOrderKind> ao) {
5616  if (!ao)
5617  return llvm::AtomicOrdering::Monotonic; // Default Memory Ordering
5618 
5619  switch (*ao) {
5620  case omp::ClauseMemoryOrderKind::Seq_cst:
5621  return llvm::AtomicOrdering::SequentiallyConsistent;
5622  case omp::ClauseMemoryOrderKind::Acq_rel:
5623  return llvm::AtomicOrdering::AcquireRelease;
5624  case omp::ClauseMemoryOrderKind::Acquire:
5625  return llvm::AtomicOrdering::Acquire;
5626  case omp::ClauseMemoryOrderKind::Release:
5627  return llvm::AtomicOrdering::Release;
5628  case omp::ClauseMemoryOrderKind::Relaxed:
5629  return llvm::AtomicOrdering::Monotonic;
5630  }
5631  llvm_unreachable("Unknown ClauseMemoryOrderKind kind");
5632 }
5633 
5634 /// Compute the cmpxchg failure ordering for an atomic compare op: use the
5635 /// `fail` clause ordering when present (the verifier guarantees it is a valid
5636 /// cmpxchg failure ordering), otherwise the strongest failure ordering derived
5637 /// from the success ordering (which matches the OpenMPIRBuilder default).
5638 static llvm::AtomicOrdering
5639 getAtomicCompareFailureOrdering(omp::AtomicCompareOp atomicCompareOp,
5640  llvm::AtomicOrdering atomicOrdering) {
5641  if (atomicCompareOp.getFailMemoryOrder())
5642  return convertAtomicOrdering(atomicCompareOp.getFailMemoryOrder());
5643  return llvm::AtomicCmpXchgInst::getStrongestFailureOrdering(atomicOrdering);
5644 }

5646 /// Convert omp.atomic.read operation to LLVM IR.
5647 static LogicalResult
5648 convertOmpAtomicRead(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
5649  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
5650  auto readOp = cast<omp::AtomicReadOp>(opInst);
5651  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(opInst)))
5652  return failure();
5653 
5654  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
5655  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy allocaIP =
5656  findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation);
5657 
5658  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
5659 
5660  llvm::AtomicOrdering AO = convertAtomicOrdering(readOp.getMemoryOrder());
5661  llvm::Value *x = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(readOp.getX());
5662  llvm::Value *v = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(readOp.getV());
5663 
5664  llvm::Type *elementType =
5665  moduleTranslation.convertType(readOp.getElementType());
5666 
5667  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue V = {v, elementType, false, false};
5668  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue X = {x, elementType, false, false};
5669  builder.restoreIP(ompBuilder->createAtomicRead(ompLoc, X, V, AO, allocaIP));
5670  return success();
5671 }

5673 /// Converts an omp.atomic.write operation to LLVM IR.
5674 static LogicalResult
5675 convertOmpAtomicWrite(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
5676  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
5677  auto writeOp = cast<omp::AtomicWriteOp>(opInst);
5678  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(opInst)))
5679  return failure();
5680 
5681  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
5682  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy allocaIP =
5683  findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation);
5684 
5685  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
5686  llvm::AtomicOrdering ao = convertAtomicOrdering(writeOp.getMemoryOrder());
5687  llvm::Value *expr = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(writeOp.getExpr());
5688  llvm::Value *dest = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(writeOp.getX());
5689  llvm::Type *ty = moduleTranslation.convertType(writeOp.getExpr().getType());
5690  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue x = {dest, ty, /*isSigned=*/false,
5691  /*isVolatile=*/false};
5692  builder.restoreIP(
5693  ompBuilder->createAtomicWrite(ompLoc, x, expr, ao, allocaIP));
5694  return success();
5695 }

5697 /// Converts an LLVM dialect binary operation to the corresponding enum value
5698 /// for `atomicrmw` supported binary operation.
5699 static llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp convertBinOpToAtomic(Operation &op) {
5700  return llvm::TypeSwitch<Operation *, llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp>(&op)
5701  .Case([&](LLVM::AddOp) { return llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::Add; })
5702  .Case([&](LLVM::SubOp) { return llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::Sub; })
5703  .Case([&](LLVM::AndOp) { return llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::And; })
5704  .Case([&](LLVM::OrOp) { return llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::Or; })
5705  .Case([&](LLVM::XOrOp) { return llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::Xor; })
5706  .Case([&](LLVM::UMaxOp) { return llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::UMax; })
5707  .Case([&](LLVM::UMinOp) { return llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::UMin; })
5708  .Case([&](LLVM::FAddOp) { return llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::FAdd; })
5709  .Case([&](LLVM::FSubOp) { return llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::FSub; })
5710  .Default(llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::BAD_BINOP);
5711 }

5713 static void extractAtomicControlFlags(omp::AtomicUpdateOp atomicUpdateOp,
5714  bool &isIgnoreDenormalMode,
5715  bool &isFineGrainedMemory,
5716  bool &isRemoteMemory) {
5717  isIgnoreDenormalMode = false;
5718  isFineGrainedMemory = false;
5719  isRemoteMemory = false;
5720  if (atomicUpdateOp && atomicUpdateOp.getAtomicControlAttr()) {
5721  mlir::omp::AtomicControlAttr atomicControlAttr =
5722  atomicUpdateOp.getAtomicControlAttr();
5723  isIgnoreDenormalMode = atomicControlAttr.getIgnoreDenormalMode();
5724  isFineGrainedMemory = atomicControlAttr.getFineGrainedMemory();
5725  isRemoteMemory = atomicControlAttr.getRemoteMemory();
5726  }
5727 }

5729 /// Converts an OpenMP atomic update operation using OpenMPIRBuilder.
5730 static LogicalResult
5731 convertOmpAtomicUpdate(omp::AtomicUpdateOp &opInst,
5732  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
5733  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
5734  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
5735  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(*opInst)))
5736  return failure();
5737 
5738  // Convert values and types.
5739  auto &innerOpList = opInst.getRegion().front().getOperations();
5740  bool isXBinopExpr{false};
5741  llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp binop;
5742  mlir::Value mlirExpr;
5743  llvm::Value *llvmExpr = nullptr;
5744  llvm::Value *llvmX = nullptr;
5745  llvm::Type *llvmXElementType = nullptr;
5746  if (innerOpList.size() == 2) {
5747  // The two operations here are the update and the terminator.
5748  // Since we can identify the update operation, there is a possibility
5749  // that we can generate the atomicrmw instruction.
5750  mlir::Operation &innerOp = *opInst.getRegion().front().begin();
5751  if (!llvm::is_contained(innerOp.getOperands(),
5752  opInst.getRegion().getArgument(0))) {
5753  return opInst.emitError("no atomic update operation with region argument"
5754  " as operand found inside atomic.update region");
5755  }
5756  binop = convertBinOpToAtomic(innerOp);
5757  isXBinopExpr = innerOp.getOperand(0) == opInst.getRegion().getArgument(0);
5758  mlirExpr = (isXBinopExpr ? innerOp.getOperand(1) : innerOp.getOperand(0));
5759  llvmExpr = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(mlirExpr);
5760  } else {
5761  // Since the update region includes more than one operation
5762  // we will resort to generating a cmpxchg loop.
5763  binop = llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::BAD_BINOP;
5764  }
5765  llvmX = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(opInst.getX());
5766  llvmXElementType = moduleTranslation.convertType(
5767  opInst.getRegion().getArgument(0).getType());
5768  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue llvmAtomicX = {llvmX, llvmXElementType,
5769  /*isSigned=*/false,
5770  /*isVolatile=*/false};
5771 
5772  llvm::AtomicOrdering atomicOrdering =
5773  convertAtomicOrdering(opInst.getMemoryOrder());
5774 
5775  // Generate update code.
5776  auto updateFn =
5777  [&opInst, &moduleTranslation](
5778  llvm::Value *atomicx,
5779  llvm::IRBuilder<> &builder) -> llvm::Expected<llvm::Value *> {
5780  Block &bb = *opInst.getRegion().begin();
5781  moduleTranslation.mapValue(*opInst.getRegion().args_begin(), atomicx);
5782  moduleTranslation.mapBlock(&bb, builder.GetInsertBlock());
5783  if (failed(moduleTranslation.convertBlock(bb, true, builder)))
5784  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
5785 
5786  omp::YieldOp yieldop = dyn_cast<omp::YieldOp>(bb.getTerminator());
5787  assert(yieldop && yieldop.getResults().size() == 1 &&
5788  "terminator must be omp.yield op and it must have exactly one "
5789  "argument");
5790  return moduleTranslation.lookupValue(yieldop.getResults()[0]);
5791  };
5792 
5793  bool isIgnoreDenormalMode;
5794  bool isFineGrainedMemory;
5795  bool isRemoteMemory;
5796  extractAtomicControlFlags(opInst, isIgnoreDenormalMode, isFineGrainedMemory,
5797  isRemoteMemory);
5798  // Handle ambiguous alloca, if any.
5799  auto allocaIP = findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation);
5800  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
5801  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterIP =
5802  ompBuilder->createAtomicUpdate(ompLoc, allocaIP, llvmAtomicX, llvmExpr,
5803  atomicOrdering, binop, updateFn,
5804  isXBinopExpr, isIgnoreDenormalMode,
5805  isFineGrainedMemory, isRemoteMemory);
5806 
5807  if (failed(handleError(afterIP, *opInst)))
5808  return failure();
5809 
5810  builder.restoreIP(*afterIP);
5811  return success();
5812 }
5813 
5814 /// Helper to extract the OMPAtomicCompareOp from an integer comparison
5815 /// predicate. Returns std::nullopt for unsupported predicates.
5816 static std::optional<llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp>
5817 convertICmpPredicateToAtomicCompareOp(LLVM::ICmpPredicate predicate) {
5818  switch (predicate) {
5819  case LLVM::ICmpPredicate::eq:
5820  return llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::EQ;
5821  case LLVM::ICmpPredicate::slt:
5822  case LLVM::ICmpPredicate::ult:
5823  return llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::MIN;
5824  case LLVM::ICmpPredicate::sgt:
5825  case LLVM::ICmpPredicate::ugt:
5826  return llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::MAX;
5827  default:
5828  return std::nullopt;
5829  }
5830 }
5831 
5832 /// Helper to extract the OMPAtomicCompareOp from a floating-point comparison
5833 /// predicate. Returns std::nullopt for unsupported predicates.
5834 static std::optional<llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp>
5835 convertFCmpPredicateToAtomicCompareOp(LLVM::FCmpPredicate predicate) {
5836  switch (predicate) {
5837  case LLVM::FCmpPredicate::oeq:
5838  case LLVM::FCmpPredicate::ueq:
5839  return llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::EQ;
5840  case LLVM::FCmpPredicate::olt:
5841  case LLVM::FCmpPredicate::ult:
5842  return llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::MIN;
5843  case LLVM::FCmpPredicate::ogt:
5844  case LLVM::FCmpPredicate::ugt:
5845  return llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::MAX;
5846  default:
5847  return std::nullopt;
5848  }
5849 }

5851 /// Result of matching the decomposed complex equality pattern inside an atomic
5852 /// compare region.
5853 struct ComplexComparePattern {
5854  bool isComplex = false;
5855  bool isNE = false; // `or` of the field compares => NE (unsupported).
5856  mlir::Value eAggregate; // The complex expected value (`e`).
5857  bool isXBinopExpr = false; // True if x is the first fcmp operand.
5858 };
5859 
5860 /// Detect a decomposed complex equality comparison in an atomic compare region:
5861 /// %re_x = llvm.extractvalue %xval[0]
5862 /// %re_e = llvm.extractvalue %eStruct[0]
5863 /// %cmp_re = llvm.fcmp "oeq" %re_x, %re_e
5864 /// %im_x = llvm.extractvalue %xval[1]
5865 /// %im_e = llvm.extractvalue %eStruct[1]
5866 /// %cmp_im = llvm.fcmp "oeq" %im_x, %im_e
5867 /// %cmp = llvm.and %cmp_re, %cmp_im (llvm.or would be NE)
5868 /// It is recognised by an and/or whose operands are both fcmps operating on
5869 /// extractvalues, one chain rooted at the block argument (x) and the other at
5870 /// the expected complex value (e).
5871 static ComplexComparePattern detectComplexCompareEq(Block &block) {
5872  ComplexComparePattern result;
5873  auto traceToAggregate = [](mlir::Value v) -> mlir::Value {
5874  if (auto extractOp = v.getDefiningOp<LLVM::ExtractValueOp>())
5875  return extractOp.getContainer();
5876  return nullptr;
5877  };
5878  for (Operation &op : block.getOperations()) {
5879  if (!isa<LLVM::AndOp, LLVM::OrOp>(op))
5880  continue;
5881  auto lhsFcmp = op.getOperand(0).getDefiningOp<LLVM::FCmpOp>();
5882  auto rhsFcmp = op.getOperand(1).getDefiningOp<LLVM::FCmpOp>();
5883  if (!lhsFcmp || !rhsFcmp)
5884  continue;
5885  mlir::Value lhsAgg0 = traceToAggregate(lhsFcmp.getOperand(0));
5886  mlir::Value lhsAgg1 = traceToAggregate(lhsFcmp.getOperand(1));
5887  bool lhsXIsOp0 = (lhsAgg0 == block.getArgument(0));
5888  bool lhsXIsOp1 = (lhsAgg1 == block.getArgument(0));
5889  if (!lhsXIsOp0 && !lhsXIsOp1)
5890  continue;
5891  mlir::Value eAggregate = lhsXIsOp0 ? lhsAgg1 : lhsAgg0;
5892  if (!eAggregate)
5893  continue;
5894  result.isComplex = true;
5895  result.isNE = isa<LLVM::OrOp>(op);
5896  result.eAggregate = eAggregate;
5897  result.isXBinopExpr = lhsXIsOp0;
5898  break;
5899  }
5900  return result;
5901 }
5902 
5903 /// Emit an IEEE-754-correct `cmpxchg` for a complex (struct-typed) atomic
5904 /// compare with `fcmp oeq`. The old value of X is returned (as the complex
5905 /// struct type) in \p oldComplex and the success flag (i1) in \p cmpOk.
5906 /// \p failOrdering is the memory ordering used when the compare-exchange does
5907 /// not store; it must be a valid cmpxchg failure ordering.
5908 static void emitComplexAtomicCmpXchg(llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
5909  llvm::Value *llvmX, llvm::Type *complexTy,
5910  llvm::Value *eVal, llvm::Value *dVal,
5911  llvm::AtomicOrdering atomicOrdering,
5912  llvm::AtomicOrdering failOrdering,
5913  bool isWeak, llvm::Value *&oldComplex,
5914  llvm::Value *&cmpOk) {
5915  const llvm::DataLayout &DL =
5916  builder.GetInsertBlock()->getModule()->getDataLayout();
5917  unsigned totalBits = DL.getTypeStoreSizeInBits(complexTy).getFixedValue();
5918  llvm::IntegerType *intTy =
5919  llvm::IntegerType::get(builder.getContext(), totalBits);
5920  llvm::Align complexAlign = DL.getABITypeAlign(complexTy);
5921  llvm::Align intAlign = DL.getABITypeAlign(intTy);
5922  llvm::Align maxAlign = std::max(complexAlign, intAlign);
5923 
5924  // Spill D to obtain its integer bit pattern for the swap value.
5925  llvm::AllocaInst *dAlloca =
5926  builder.CreateAlloca(complexTy, nullptr, "cmplx.d");
5927  dAlloca->setAlignment(maxAlign);
5928  builder.CreateAlignedStore(dVal, dAlloca, maxAlign);
5929  llvm::Value *dInt =
5930  builder.CreateAlignedLoad(intTy, dAlloca, maxAlign, "cmplx.d.int");
5931 
5932  // Load X atomically and reinterpret as complex. Use the failure ordering: on
5933  // a failed component comparison we branch around the cmpxchg, so this load is
5934  // the only memory op on that path.
5935  llvm::LoadInst *xCurr =
5936  builder.CreateAlignedLoad(intTy, llvmX, maxAlign, "cmplx.x.load");
5937  xCurr->setAtomic(failOrdering);
5938  llvm::AllocaInst *xAlloca =
5939  builder.CreateAlloca(complexTy, nullptr, "cmplx.x");
5940  xAlloca->setAlignment(maxAlign);
5941  builder.CreateAlignedStore(xCurr, xAlloca, maxAlign);
5942  llvm::Value *xStruct =
5943  builder.CreateAlignedLoad(complexTy, xAlloca, maxAlign, "cmplx.x.val");
5944 
5945  // Component-wise IEEE-754 equality: `fcmp oeq` yields false for NaN (so a
5946  // NaN component correctly makes the compare fail) and true for +0.0 vs -0.0
5947  // (so a zero-sign difference does not spuriously fail the compare).
5948  llvm::Value *reX = builder.CreateExtractValue(xStruct, 0);
5949  llvm::Value *imX = builder.CreateExtractValue(xStruct, 1);
5950  llvm::Value *reE = builder.CreateExtractValue(eVal, 0);
5951  llvm::Value *imE = builder.CreateExtractValue(eVal, 1);
5952  llvm::Value *reEq = builder.CreateFCmpOEQ(reX, reE, "cmplx.re.eq");
5953  llvm::Value *imEq = builder.CreateFCmpOEQ(imX, imE, "cmplx.im.eq");
5954  llvm::Value *fpEqual = builder.CreateAnd(reEq, imEq, "cmplx.eq");
5955 
5956  // When the components compare equal, attempt the swap using X's own loaded
5957  // bit pattern as the comparand; otherwise the compare fails and X is left
5958  // unchanged (the captured old value is the value just loaded).
5959  llvm::BasicBlock *curBB = builder.GetInsertBlock();
5960  llvm::Function *fn = curBB->getParent();
5961  llvm::BasicBlock *swapBB =
5962  llvm::BasicBlock::Create(builder.getContext(), "cmplx.atomic.swap", fn);
5963  llvm::BasicBlock *exitBB =
5964  llvm::BasicBlock::Create(builder.getContext(), "cmplx.atomic.exit", fn);
5965  builder.CreateCondBr(fpEqual, swapBB, exitBB);
5966 
5967  builder.SetInsertPoint(swapBB);
5968  llvm::AtomicCmpXchgInst *cmpXchg = builder.CreateAtomicCmpXchg(
5969  llvmX, xCurr, dInt, maxAlign, atomicOrdering, failOrdering);
5970  cmpXchg->setWeak(isWeak);
5971  llvm::Value *oldSwap = builder.CreateExtractValue(cmpXchg, 0);
5972  llvm::Value *okSwap = builder.CreateExtractValue(cmpXchg, 1);
5973  builder.CreateBr(exitBB);
5974 
5975  // Merge the swap and no-swap paths.
5976  builder.SetInsertPoint(exitBB);
5977  llvm::PHINode *oldIntPHI = builder.CreatePHI(intTy, 2, "cmplx.old.int");
5978  oldIntPHI->addIncoming(oldSwap, swapBB);
5979  oldIntPHI->addIncoming(xCurr, curBB);
5980  llvm::PHINode *okPHI = builder.CreatePHI(builder.getInt1Ty(), 2, "cmplx.ok");
5981  okPHI->addIncoming(okSwap, swapBB);
5982  okPHI->addIncoming(builder.getFalse(), curBB);
5983 
5984  // Reinterpret the old integer value as the complex struct via memory.
5985  llvm::AllocaInst *oldAlloca =
5986  builder.CreateAlloca(complexTy, nullptr, "cmplx.old");
5987  oldAlloca->setAlignment(maxAlign);
5988  builder.CreateAlignedStore(oldIntPHI, oldAlloca, maxAlign);
5989  oldComplex = builder.CreateAlignedLoad(complexTy, oldAlloca, maxAlign,
5990  "cmplx.old.val");
5991  cmpOk = okPHI;
5992 }
5993 
5994 /// Holds the extracted comparison pattern information from an atomic compare
5995 /// region.
5996 struct AtomicComparePatternInfo {
5997  llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp compareOp = llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::EQ;
5998  llvm::Value *eVal = nullptr;
5999  llvm::Value *dVal = nullptr;
6000  bool isXBinopExpr = false;
6001  bool isSigned = false;
6002 };
6003 /// Extract comparison predicate, expected value (e), desired value (d), and
6004 /// related flags from an atomic compare region block by scanning for
6005 /// icmp/fcmp/select/min/max operations.
6006 static LogicalResult extractAtomicComparePattern(
6007  Block &block,
6008  llvm::function_ref<llvm::Value *(mlir::Value)> materializeValue,
6009  omp::AtomicCompareOp atomicCompareOp, AtomicComparePatternInfo &info) {
6010  // Complex equality is a decomposed per-field pattern (extractvalue + fcmp +
6011  // and) rather than a single scalar compare. Detect it first so the scalar
6012  // icmp/fcmp handling below does not mistake a real/imaginary field for the
6013  // whole expected value.
6014  if (ComplexComparePattern cplx = detectComplexCompareEq(block);
6015  cplx.isComplex) {
6016  if (cplx.isNE)
6017  return atomicCompareOp.emitError(
6018  "unsupported comparison predicate (NE) for complex atomic compare");
6019  info.compareOp = llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::EQ;
6020  info.isXBinopExpr = cplx.isXBinopExpr;
6021  info.eVal = materializeValue(cplx.eAggregate);
6022  for (Operation &op : block.getOperations()) {
6023  if (auto selectOp = dyn_cast<LLVM::SelectOp>(op)) {
6024  info.dVal = materializeValue(selectOp.getTrueValue());
6025  break;
6026  }
6027  }
6028  return success();
6029  }
6030 
6031  for (Operation &op : block.getOperations()) {
6032  // Pre-filter: skip icmps that don't involve the block argument
6033  // (e.g., truthiness extractions from logical-to-integer conversion).
6034  if (auto icmpOp = dyn_cast<LLVM::ICmpOp>(op);
6035  icmpOp && icmpOp.getOperand(0) != block.getArgument(0) &&
6036  icmpOp.getOperand(1) != block.getArgument(0))
6037  continue;
6038 
6039  LogicalResult result =
6040  llvm::TypeSwitch<Operation *, LogicalResult>(&op)
6041  .Case<LLVM::ICmpOp>([&](LLVM::ICmpOp icmpOp) -> LogicalResult {
6042  auto maybeOp =
6043  convertICmpPredicateToAtomicCompareOp(icmpOp.getPredicate());
6044  if (!maybeOp)
6045  return atomicCompareOp.emitError(
6046  "unsupported comparison predicate in atomic compare");
6047  info.compareOp = *maybeOp;
6048  LLVM::ICmpPredicate pred = icmpOp.getPredicate();
6049  info.isSigned = (pred == LLVM::ICmpPredicate::slt ||
6050  pred == LLVM::ICmpPredicate::sgt ||
6051  pred == LLVM::ICmpPredicate::sle ||
6052  pred == LLVM::ICmpPredicate::sge);
6053  info.isXBinopExpr =
6054  (icmpOp.getOperand(0) == block.getArgument(0));
6055  mlir::Value eOperand = info.isXBinopExpr ? icmpOp.getOperand(1)
6056  : icmpOp.getOperand(0);
6057  info.eVal = materializeValue(eOperand);
6058  return success();
6059  })
6060  .Case<LLVM::FCmpOp>([&](LLVM::FCmpOp fcmpOp) -> LogicalResult {
6061  auto maybeOp =
6062  convertFCmpPredicateToAtomicCompareOp(fcmpOp.getPredicate());
6063  if (!maybeOp)
6064  return atomicCompareOp.emitError(
6065  "unsupported comparison predicate in atomic compare");
6066  info.compareOp = *maybeOp;
6067  info.isXBinopExpr =
6068  (fcmpOp.getOperand(0) == block.getArgument(0));
6069  mlir::Value eOperand = info.isXBinopExpr ? fcmpOp.getOperand(1)
6070  : fcmpOp.getOperand(0);
6071  info.eVal = materializeValue(eOperand);
6072  return success();
6073  })
6074  .Case<LLVM::SelectOp>([&](LLVM::SelectOp selectOp) {
6075  if (!info.dVal)
6076  info.dVal = materializeValue(selectOp.getTrueValue());
6077  return success();
6078  })
6079  .Case<mlir::arith::MaxSIOp, mlir::arith::MinSIOp,
6080  mlir::arith::MaxUIOp, mlir::arith::MinUIOp,
6081  mlir::arith::MaximumFOp, mlir::arith::MinimumFOp,
6082  LLVM::SMaxOp, LLVM::SMinOp, LLVM::UMaxOp, LLVM::UMinOp,
6083  LLVM::MaxNumOp, LLVM::MinNumOp>([&](Operation *) {
6084  // Canonicalized min/max ops (arith or LLVM intrinsic form).
6085  // max(x,e) came from slt/ult/olt -> OMPAtomicCompareOp::MIN
6086  // min(x,e) came from sgt/ugt/ogt -> OMPAtomicCompareOp::MAX
6087  // (OMPIRBuilder inverts: MIN->atomicrmw max, MAX->atomicrmw min)
6088  bool isMax = isa<mlir::arith::MaxSIOp, mlir::arith::MaxUIOp,
6089  mlir::arith::MaximumFOp, LLVM::SMaxOp,
6090  LLVM::UMaxOp, LLVM::MaxNumOp>(op);
6091  info.compareOp = isMax ? llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::MIN
6092  : llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::MAX;
6093  info.isSigned = isa<mlir::arith::MaxSIOp, mlir::arith::MinSIOp,
6094  LLVM::SMaxOp, LLVM::SMinOp>(op);
6095  info.isXBinopExpr = (op.getOperand(0) == block.getArgument(0));
6096  mlir::Value eOperand =
6097  info.isXBinopExpr ? op.getOperand(1) : op.getOperand(0);
6098  info.eVal = materializeValue(eOperand);
6099  info.dVal = info.eVal;
6100  return success();
6101  })
6102  .Default([](Operation *) { return success(); });
6103 
6104  if (failed(result))
6105  return result;
6106  }
6107  return success();
6108 }
6109 
6110 static LogicalResult
6111 convertOmpAtomicCapture(omp::AtomicCaptureOp atomicCaptureOp,
6112  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
6113  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
6114  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
6115  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(*atomicCaptureOp)))
6116  return failure();
6117 
6118  omp::AtomicUpdateOp atomicUpdateOp = atomicCaptureOp.getAtomicUpdateOp();
6119  omp::AtomicWriteOp atomicWriteOp = atomicCaptureOp.getAtomicWriteOp();
6120  omp::AtomicCompareOp atomicCompareOp = atomicCaptureOp.getAtomicCompareOp();
6121 
6122  // If the capture contains an atomic.compare, delegate to
6123  // createAtomicCompare with the capture variable (V) set.
6124  if (atomicCompareOp) {
6125  omp::AtomicReadOp atomicReadOp = atomicCaptureOp.getAtomicReadOp();
6126  assert(atomicReadOp && "expected atomic.read in capture+compare");
6127 
6128  Region &region = atomicCompareOp.getRegion();
6129  Block &block = region.front();
6130 
6131  llvm::Type *llvmXElementType =
6132  moduleTranslation.convertType(block.getArgument(0).getType());
6133  llvm::Value *llvmX = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(atomicCompareOp.getX());
6134  llvm::Value *llvmV = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(atomicReadOp.getV());
6135 
6136  bool isSigned = false;
6137  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue llvmAtomicX = {
6138  llvmX, llvmXElementType, isSigned, /*IsVolatile=*/false};
6139  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue llvmAtomicV = {
6140  llvmV, llvmXElementType, /*isSigned=*/false, /*IsVolatile=*/false};
6141  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue llvmAtomicR = {nullptr, nullptr, false,
6142  false};
6143 
6144  llvm::AtomicOrdering atomicOrdering =
6145  convertAtomicOrdering(atomicCaptureOp.getMemoryOrder());
6146 
6147  // Pre-translate non-pattern operations inside the compare region.
6148  auto isAtomicComparePatternOp = [](Operation &op) {
6149  return llvm::isa<LLVM::ICmpOp, LLVM::FCmpOp, LLVM::SelectOp, LLVM::AndOp,
6150  LLVM::OrOp, LLVM::SMaxOp, LLVM::SMinOp, LLVM::UMaxOp,
6151  LLVM::UMinOp, LLVM::MaxNumOp, LLVM::MinNumOp,
6152  mlir::arith::MaxSIOp, mlir::arith::MinSIOp,
6153  mlir::arith::MaxUIOp, mlir::arith::MinUIOp,
6154  mlir::arith::MaximumFOp, mlir::arith::MinimumFOp>(op);
6155  };
6156  for (Operation &op : block.without_terminator()) {
6157  if (isAtomicComparePatternOp(op))
6158  continue;
6159  bool allOperandsMapped =
6160  llvm::all_of(op.getOperands(), [&](mlir::Value v) {
6161  return moduleTranslation.lookupValue(v) != nullptr;
6162  });
6163  if (!allOperandsMapped)
6164  continue;
6165  if (failed(moduleTranslation.convertOperation(op, builder)))
6166  return atomicCompareOp.emitError(
6167  "failed to translate operation inside atomic compare region");
6168  }
6169 
6170  auto materializeValue = [&](mlir::Value val) -> llvm::Value * {
6171  if (llvm::Value *existing = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(val))
6172  return existing;
6173  if (auto loadOp = val.getDefiningOp<LLVM::LoadOp>()) {
6174  if (loadOp->getParentRegion() == &region) {
6175  llvm::Value *loadAddr =
6176  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(loadOp.getAddr());
6177  if (!loadAddr)
6178  return nullptr;
6179  llvm::Type *loadType =
6180  moduleTranslation.convertType(loadOp.getResult().getType());
6181  return builder.CreateLoad(loadType, loadAddr);
6182  }
6183  }
6184  return nullptr;
6185  };
6186 
6187  // Extract comparison predicate, eVal, and dVal from the region.
6188  AtomicComparePatternInfo patternInfo;
6189  if (failed(extractAtomicComparePattern(block, materializeValue,
6190  atomicCompareOp, patternInfo)))
6191  return failure();
6192 
6193  llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp compareOp = patternInfo.compareOp;
6194  llvm::Value *eVal = patternInfo.eVal;
6195  llvm::Value *dVal = patternInfo.dVal;
6196  bool isXBinopExpr = patternInfo.isXBinopExpr;
6197  isSigned = patternInfo.isSigned;
6198 
6199  if (!eVal)
6200  return atomicCompareOp.emitError(
6201  "failed to extract expected value (e) from atomic compare region");
6202  if (!dVal) {
6203  auto yieldOp = cast<omp::YieldOp>(block.getTerminator());
6204  if (yieldOp.getResults().empty())
6205  return atomicCompareOp.emitError(
6206  "failed to extract desired value (d) from atomic compare region");
6207  dVal = materializeValue(yieldOp.getResults()[0]);
6208  }
6209 
6210  llvmAtomicX.IsSigned = isSigned;
6211 
6212  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
6213  bool isReadFirst = isa<omp::AtomicReadOp>(atomicCaptureOp.getFirstOp());
6214  bool isPostfixCapture = !isReadFirst;
6215  bool isFailOnly = atomicCaptureOp.getFailOnly();
6216 
6217  // Complex equality capture: x is struct-typed, which the OMPIRBuilder
6218  // cannot handle, so emit an IEEE-754-correct cmpxchg (as in the non-capture
6219  // complex path) and reconstruct the captured value from its result. The
6220  // helper compares components with `fcmp oeq` so `-0.0 == +0.0` and `NaN`
6221  // are handled as in the scalar float path. Complex only supports the ==
6222  // comparison.
6223  if (llvmXElementType->isStructTy()) {
6224  llvm::Value *oldComplex = nullptr;
6225  llvm::Value *cmpOk = nullptr;
6226  llvm::AtomicOrdering failOrdering =
6227  getAtomicCompareFailureOrdering(atomicCompareOp, atomicOrdering);
6228  emitComplexAtomicCmpXchg(builder, llvmX, llvmXElementType, eVal, dVal,
6229  atomicOrdering, failOrdering,
6230  atomicCompareOp.getWeak(), oldComplex, cmpOk);
6231 
6232  if (isFailOnly) {
6233  // v is written only when the compare fails (cmpOk == false).
6234  llvm::Value *cmpFailed = builder.CreateNot(cmpOk);
6235  llvm::BasicBlock *curBB = builder.GetInsertBlock();
6236  llvm::Function *fn = curBB->getParent();
6237  llvm::BasicBlock *contBB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(
6238  builder.getContext(), "omp.atomic.cont", fn);
6239  llvm::BasicBlock *exitBB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(
6240  builder.getContext(), "omp.atomic.exit", fn);
6241  builder.CreateCondBr(cmpFailed, contBB, exitBB);
6242  builder.SetInsertPoint(contBB);
6243  builder.CreateStore(oldComplex, llvmAtomicV.Var,
6244  llvmAtomicV.IsVolatile);
6245  builder.CreateBr(exitBB);
6246  builder.SetInsertPoint(exitBB);
6247  } else if (isPostfixCapture) {
6248  // v gets the new value of x: d on success, old x otherwise.
6249  llvm::Value *newComplex = builder.CreateSelect(cmpOk, dVal, oldComplex);
6250  builder.CreateStore(newComplex, llvmAtomicV.Var,
6251  llvmAtomicV.IsVolatile);
6252  } else {
6253  // Prefix: v gets the old value of x.
6254  builder.CreateStore(oldComplex, llvmAtomicV.Var,
6255  llvmAtomicV.IsVolatile);
6256  }
6257 
6258  // Emit flush after atomic compare if needed (release/acq_rel/seq_cst).
6259  if (atomicOrdering == llvm::AtomicOrdering::Release ||
6260  atomicOrdering == llvm::AtomicOrdering::AcquireRelease ||
6261  atomicOrdering == llvm::AtomicOrdering::SequentiallyConsistent) {
6262  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription flushLoc(builder);
6263  ompBuilder->createFlush(flushLoc);
6264  }
6265  return success();
6266  }
6267 
6268  // Min/max (<, >) comparisons lower to an atomicrmw. The OMPIRBuilder has no
6269  // notion of a failed compare for an atomicrmw, so the fail-only capture
6270  // form (v written only when the compare fails) has no valid mapping and is
6271  // Min/max (<, >) comparisons lower to an atomicrmw. The OMPIRBuilder has no
6272  // notion of a failed compare for an atomicrmw (it asserts on IsFailOnly),
6273  // so for min/max the fail-only capture is reconstructed manually below.
6274  bool isMinMax = compareOp != llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::EQ;
6275 
6276  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue llvmAtomicVForCall = llvmAtomicV;
6277  // Capture into V is reconstructed manually below for:
6278  // * postfix capture (v gets the new value of x): equality from the
6279  // cmpxchg result, min/max from the atomicrmw result;
6280  // * min/max fail-only capture (the OMPIRBuilder cannot express it).
6281  // Bypass V in the OMPIRBuilder for those cases so it does not also emit its
6282  // own (for min/max, incorrect or unsupported) capture store.
6283  bool minMaxManualCapture = isMinMax && (isPostfixCapture || isFailOnly);
6284  bool eqPostfixManualCapture = !isMinMax && isPostfixCapture && !isFailOnly;
6285  if (minMaxManualCapture || eqPostfixManualCapture)
6286  llvmAtomicVForCall = {nullptr, nullptr, false, false};
6287 
6288  // The OMPIRBuilder only understands IsFailOnly for the equality (cmpxchg)
6289  // path; for min/max it would assert. Min/max fail-only is handled here.
6290  bool builderFailOnly = isFailOnly && !isMinMax;
6291 
6292  // IsPostfixUpdate selects which value the OMPIRBuilder captures into V:
6293  // * min/max prefix and equality prefix: a direct store of the old value
6294  // (IsPostfixUpdate=true).
6295  // * equality fail-only: a conditional store (IsPostfixUpdate=false).
6296  // Manually-reconstructed captures bypass V above.
6297  bool isPostfixUpdate = !builderFailOnly;
6298 
6299  bool isWeak = atomicCompareOp.getWeak();
6300  bool savedHandleFPNegZero = ompBuilder->setHandleFPNegZero(true);
6301  llvm::AtomicOrdering failureOrdering =
6302  getAtomicCompareFailureOrdering(atomicCompareOp, atomicOrdering);
6303  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterIP =
6304  ompBuilder->createAtomicCompare(
6305  ompLoc, llvmAtomicX, llvmAtomicVForCall, llvmAtomicR, eVal, dVal,
6306  atomicOrdering, compareOp, isXBinopExpr, isPostfixUpdate,
6307  builderFailOnly, failureOrdering, isWeak);
6308  ompBuilder->setHandleFPNegZero(savedHandleFPNegZero);
6309 
6310  if (failed(handleError(afterIP, *atomicCaptureOp)))
6311  return failure();
6312 
6313  builder.restoreIP(*afterIP);
6314 
6315  // Min/max capture is reconstructed from the atomicrmw the OMPIRBuilder
6316  // emits (its result is the old value of x). V was bypassed above.
6317  // * postfix: v gets the new value min/max(old, e);
6318  // * fail-only: v gets the old value, but only when the compare failed
6319  // (i.e. the atomicrmw did not change x).
6320  // (Prefix min/max captures the old value directly through V, so nothing
6321  // extra is needed there.)
6322  if (isMinMax && (isPostfixCapture || isFailOnly)) {
6323  llvm::BasicBlock *curBB = builder.GetInsertBlock();
6324  llvm::AtomicRMWInst *rmw = nullptr;
6325  for (auto &inst : llvm::reverse(*curBB)) {
6326  if (auto *r = dyn_cast<llvm::AtomicRMWInst>(&inst)) {
6327  rmw = r;
6328  break;
6329  }
6330  }
6331  assert(rmw && "expected atomicrmw for min/max compare capture");
6332  llvm::Value *oldVal = rmw;
6333  llvm::Value *rhs = rmw->getValOperand();
6334 
6335  if (isFailOnly) {
6336  // The compare "failed" (the else branch runs) exactly when the
6337  // atomicrmw did not change x. Recompute the original update condition
6338  // on the old value and negate it. v is stored only in that case.
6339  llvm::CmpInst::Predicate updatePred;
6340  switch (rmw->getOperation()) {
6341  case llvm::AtomicRMWInst::Min:
6342  updatePred = llvm::CmpInst::ICMP_SGT;
6343  break;
6344  case llvm::AtomicRMWInst::Max:
6345  updatePred = llvm::CmpInst::ICMP_SLT;
6346  break;
6347  case llvm::AtomicRMWInst::UMin:
6348  updatePred = llvm::CmpInst::ICMP_UGT;
6349  break;
6350  case llvm::AtomicRMWInst::UMax:
6351  updatePred = llvm::CmpInst::ICMP_ULT;
6352  break;
6353  case llvm::AtomicRMWInst::FMin:
6354  updatePred = llvm::CmpInst::FCMP_OGT;
6355  break;
6356  case llvm::AtomicRMWInst::FMax:
6357  updatePred = llvm::CmpInst::FCMP_OLT;
6358  break;
6359  default:
6360  llvm_unreachable(
6361  "unexpected atomicrmw op for min/max compare capture");
6362  }
6363  llvm::Value *updated = builder.CreateCmp(updatePred, oldVal, rhs);
6364  llvm::Value *failed = builder.CreateNot(updated);
6365  llvm::Function *fn = curBB->getParent();
6366  llvm::BasicBlock *contBB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(
6367  builder.getContext(), "omp.atomic.cont", fn);
6368  llvm::BasicBlock *exitBB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(
6369  builder.getContext(), "omp.atomic.exit", fn);
6370  builder.CreateCondBr(failed, contBB, exitBB);
6371  builder.SetInsertPoint(contBB);
6372  builder.CreateStore(oldVal, llvmAtomicV.Var, llvmAtomicV.IsVolatile);
6373  builder.CreateBr(exitBB);
6374  builder.SetInsertPoint(exitBB);
6375  } else {
6376  llvm::Intrinsic::ID id;
6377  switch (rmw->getOperation()) {
6378  case llvm::AtomicRMWInst::Min:
6379  id = llvm::Intrinsic::smin;
6380  break;
6381  case llvm::AtomicRMWInst::Max:
6382  id = llvm::Intrinsic::smax;
6383  break;
6384  case llvm::AtomicRMWInst::UMin:
6385  id = llvm::Intrinsic::umin;
6386  break;
6387  case llvm::AtomicRMWInst::UMax:
6388  id = llvm::Intrinsic::umax;
6389  break;
6390  case llvm::AtomicRMWInst::FMin:
6391  id = llvm::Intrinsic::minnum;
6392  break;
6393  case llvm::AtomicRMWInst::FMax:
6394  id = llvm::Intrinsic::maxnum;
6395  break;
6396  default:
6397  llvm_unreachable(
6398  "unexpected atomicrmw op for min/max compare capture");
6399  }
6400  llvm::Value *newVal = builder.CreateBinaryIntrinsic(id, oldVal, rhs);
6401  builder.CreateStore(newVal, llvmAtomicV.Var, llvmAtomicV.IsVolatile);
6402  }
6403  }
6404 
6405  // Equality postfix: v = select(success, D, old) — reconstructs the new
6406  // value of x from the cmpxchg result.
6407  if (!isMinMax && isPostfixCapture && !isFailOnly) {
6408  llvm::BasicBlock *curBB = builder.GetInsertBlock();
6409  llvm::Value *oldVal = nullptr;
6410  llvm::Value *successVal = nullptr;
6411 
6412  // Integer path (and non-HandleFPNegZero FP path): a single cmpxchg
6413  // lives in the current block.
6414  for (auto &inst : llvm::reverse(*curBB)) {
6415  if (isa<llvm::AtomicCmpXchgInst>(&inst)) {
6416  oldVal = builder.CreateExtractValue(&inst, /*Idxs=*/0);
6417  successVal = builder.CreateExtractValue(&inst, /*Idxs=*/1);
6418  break;
6419  }
6420  }
6421 
6422  // FP HandleFPNegZero path: the OMPIRBuilder emits a multi-block
6423  // structure (NaN / ±0.0 handling) with cmpxchg in predecessor
6424  // blocks. Results are merged via PHI nodes in the current (exit)
6425  // block: an i1 PHI for success and a bitcast of an integer PHI
6426  // for the old FP value.
6427  if (!oldVal) {
6428  for (auto &inst : *curBB) {
6429  auto *phi = dyn_cast<llvm::PHINode>(&inst);
6430  if (!phi)
6431  break;
6432  if (phi->getType()->isIntegerTy(1))
6433  successVal = phi;
6434  }
6435  for (auto &inst : *curBB) {
6436  if (auto *bc = dyn_cast<llvm::BitCastInst>(&inst)) {
6437  oldVal = bc;
6438  break;
6439  }
6440  }
6441  }
6442 
6443  assert(oldVal && "expected cmpxchg or PHI+bitcast for compare capture");
6444  assert(successVal && "expected success flag for compare capture");
6445  llvm::Value *newVal = builder.CreateSelect(successVal, dVal, oldVal);
6446  builder.CreateStore(newVal, llvmAtomicV.Var, llvmAtomicV.IsVolatile);
6447  }
6448 
6449  return success();
6450  }
6451 
6452  mlir::Value mlirExpr;
6453  bool isXBinopExpr = false, isPostfixUpdate = false;
6454  llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp binop = llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::BAD_BINOP;
6455 
6456  assert((atomicUpdateOp || atomicWriteOp) &&
6457  "internal op must be an atomic.update or atomic.write op");
6458 
6459  if (atomicWriteOp) {
6460  isPostfixUpdate = true;
6461  mlirExpr = atomicWriteOp.getExpr();
6462  } else {
6463  isPostfixUpdate = atomicCaptureOp.getSecondOp() ==
6464  atomicCaptureOp.getAtomicUpdateOp().getOperation();
6465  auto &innerOpList = atomicUpdateOp.getRegion().front().getOperations();
6466  // Find the binary update operation that uses the region argument
6467  // and get the expression to update
6468  if (innerOpList.size() == 2) {
6469  mlir::Operation &innerOp = *atomicUpdateOp.getRegion().front().begin();
6470  if (!llvm::is_contained(innerOp.getOperands(),
6471  atomicUpdateOp.getRegion().getArgument(0))) {
6472  return atomicUpdateOp.emitError(
6473  "no atomic update operation with region argument"
6474  " as operand found inside atomic.update region");
6475  }
6476  binop = convertBinOpToAtomic(innerOp);
6477  isXBinopExpr =
6478  innerOp.getOperand(0) == atomicUpdateOp.getRegion().getArgument(0);
6479  mlirExpr = (isXBinopExpr ? innerOp.getOperand(1) : innerOp.getOperand(0));
6480  } else {
6481  binop = llvm::AtomicRMWInst::BinOp::BAD_BINOP;
6482  }
6483  }
6484 
6485  llvm::Value *llvmExpr = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(mlirExpr);
6486  llvm::Value *llvmX =
6487  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(atomicCaptureOp.getAtomicReadOp().getX());
6488  llvm::Value *llvmV =
6489  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(atomicCaptureOp.getAtomicReadOp().getV());
6490  llvm::Type *llvmXElementType = moduleTranslation.convertType(
6491  atomicCaptureOp.getAtomicReadOp().getElementType());
6492  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue llvmAtomicX = {llvmX, llvmXElementType,
6493  /*isSigned=*/false,
6494  /*isVolatile=*/false};
6495  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue llvmAtomicV = {llvmV, llvmXElementType,
6496  /*isSigned=*/false,
6497  /*isVolatile=*/false};
6498 
6499  llvm::AtomicOrdering atomicOrdering =
6500  convertAtomicOrdering(atomicCaptureOp.getMemoryOrder());
6501 
6502  auto updateFn =
6503  [&](llvm::Value *atomicx,
6504  llvm::IRBuilder<> &builder) -> llvm::Expected<llvm::Value *> {
6505  if (atomicWriteOp)
6506  return moduleTranslation.lookupValue(atomicWriteOp.getExpr());
6507  Block &bb = *atomicUpdateOp.getRegion().begin();
6508  moduleTranslation.mapValue(*atomicUpdateOp.getRegion().args_begin(),
6509  atomicx);
6510  moduleTranslation.mapBlock(&bb, builder.GetInsertBlock());
6511  if (failed(moduleTranslation.convertBlock(bb, true, builder)))
6512  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
6513 
6514  omp::YieldOp yieldop = dyn_cast<omp::YieldOp>(bb.getTerminator());
6515  assert(yieldop && yieldop.getResults().size() == 1 &&
6516  "terminator must be omp.yield op and it must have exactly one "
6517  "argument");
6518  return moduleTranslation.lookupValue(yieldop.getResults()[0]);
6519  };
6520 
6521  bool isIgnoreDenormalMode;
6522  bool isFineGrainedMemory;
6523  bool isRemoteMemory;
6524  extractAtomicControlFlags(atomicUpdateOp, isIgnoreDenormalMode,
6525  isFineGrainedMemory, isRemoteMemory);
6526  // Handle ambiguous alloca, if any.
6527  auto allocaIP = findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation);
6528  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
6529  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterIP =
6530  ompBuilder->createAtomicCapture(
6531  ompLoc, allocaIP, llvmAtomicX, llvmAtomicV, llvmExpr, atomicOrdering,
6532  binop, updateFn, atomicUpdateOp, isPostfixUpdate, isXBinopExpr,
6533  isIgnoreDenormalMode, isFineGrainedMemory, isRemoteMemory);
6534 
6535  if (failed(handleError(afterIP, *atomicCaptureOp)))
6536  return failure();
6537 
6538  builder.restoreIP(*afterIP);
6539  return success();
6540 }
6541 
6542 /// Converts an omp.atomic.compare operation to LLVM IR.
6543 ///
6544 /// if (x == e) x = d
6545 /// The region contains a comparison + select pattern:
6546 /// ^bb0(%xval: T):
6547 /// %cmp = llvm.icmp/fcmp <pred> %xval, %e : T
6548 /// %sel = llvm.select %cmp, %d, %xval : i1, T
6549 /// omp.yield(%sel : T)
6550 ///
6551 /// From MLIR extract:
6552 /// 1) comparison operator
6553 /// 2) expected value (e)
6554 /// 3) desired value (d)
6555 /// These are passed to OpenMPIRBuilder::createAtomicCompare which generates
6556 /// the actual cmpxchg / atomicrmw instruction.
6557 ///
6558 static LogicalResult
6559 convertOmpAtomicCompare(omp::AtomicCompareOp atomicCompareOp,
6560  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
6561  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
6562  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
6563  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(*atomicCompareOp)))
6564  return failure();
6565 
6566  Region &region = atomicCompareOp.getRegion();
6567  Block &block = region.front();
6568 
6569  // Determine element type from the region block argument
6570  llvm::Type *llvmXElementType =
6571  moduleTranslation.convertType(block.getArgument(0).getType());
6572  if (!llvmXElementType)
6573  return atomicCompareOp.emitError(
6574  "unable to determine element type for atomic compare");
6575 
6576  llvm::Value *llvmX = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(atomicCompareOp.getX());
6577 
6578  // IsSigned is determined from the comparison predicate in the region.
6579  // Signed ICmp predicates (slt/sgt) set this to true; unsigned (ult/ugt)
6580  // leave it false. For EQ and float comparisons, signedness is irrelevant.
6581  bool isSigned = false;
6582  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue llvmAtomicX = {llvmX, llvmXElementType,
6583  isSigned,
6584  /*IsVolatile=*/false};
6585 
6586  llvm::AtomicOrdering atomicOrdering =
6587  convertAtomicOrdering(atomicCompareOp.getMemoryOrder());
6588 
6589  auto isAtomicComparePatternOp = [](Operation &op) {
6590  return llvm::isa<LLVM::ICmpOp, LLVM::FCmpOp, LLVM::SelectOp, LLVM::AndOp,
6591  LLVM::OrOp, LLVM::SMaxOp, LLVM::SMinOp, LLVM::UMaxOp,
6592  LLVM::UMinOp, LLVM::MaxNumOp, LLVM::MinNumOp,
6593  mlir::arith::MaxSIOp, mlir::arith::MinSIOp,
6594  mlir::arith::MaxUIOp, mlir::arith::MinUIOp,
6595  mlir::arith::MaximumFOp, mlir::arith::MinimumFOp>(op);
6596  };
6597 
6598  // Pre-translate operations inside the region that compute e and d (e.g.,
6599  // GEP, loads for dereferencing Fortran pointers) but are not part of the
6600  // atomic compare-and-swap pattern (icmp/fcmp, select, and/or).
6601  //
6602  // 1) Validity: The OpenMP spec requires e and d to be evaluated before the
6603  // atomic operation, so emitting their computation here is correct.
6604  // 2) Memory effects: These ops only depend on values defined outside the
6605  // region. They cannot observe the block argument (%xval), which is the
6606  // value loaded atomically by cmpxchg and does not exist yet.
6607  // 3) Invariant enforcement: The `allOperandsMapped` check below skips any
6608  // op whose operands include the unmapped block argument, guaranteeing
6609  // only region-external-dependent ops are pre-translated.
6610  for (Operation &op : block.without_terminator()) {
6611  // Skip operations that form the atomic compare pattern — these are
6612  // not emitted as individual instructions but are analyzed below to
6613  // extract the comparison predicate, expected value (e), and desired
6614  // value (d) for generating a single cmpxchg/atomicrmw.
6615  if (isAtomicComparePatternOp(op))
6616  continue;
6617 
6618  // Avoid translating ops that depend on the unmapped block argument.
6619  bool allOperandsMapped = llvm::all_of(op.getOperands(), [&](mlir::Value v) {
6620  return moduleTranslation.lookupValue(v) != nullptr;
6621  });
6622  if (!allOperandsMapped)
6623  continue;
6624 
6625  if (failed(moduleTranslation.convertOperation(op, builder)))
6626  return atomicCompareOp.emitError(
6627  "failed to translate operation inside atomic compare region");
6628  }
6629 
6630  // Look up a value that may have been pre-translated or defined outside the
6631  // region.
6632  auto materializeValue = [&](mlir::Value val) -> llvm::Value * {
6633  // Check if the value is already mapped (pre-translated or defined outside).
6634  if (llvm::Value *existing = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(val))
6635  return existing;
6636  // Fallback for a single LoadOp whose address is mapped but whose result
6637  // was not pre-translated.
6638  if (auto loadOp = val.getDefiningOp<LLVM::LoadOp>()) {
6639  if (loadOp->getParentRegion() == &region) {
6640  llvm::Value *loadAddr = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(loadOp.getAddr());
6641  if (!loadAddr)
6642  return nullptr;
6643  llvm::Type *loadType =
6644  moduleTranslation.convertType(loadOp.getResult().getType());
6645  return builder.CreateLoad(loadType, loadAddr);
6646  }
6647  }
6648  return nullptr;
6649  };
6650 
6651  // Walk the region to extract comparison predicate, eVal, and dVal.
6652  // if (x == eVal) x = dVal
6653  llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp compareOp = llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::EQ;
6654  llvm::Value *eVal = nullptr;
6655  llvm::Value *dVal = nullptr;
6656  bool isXBinopExpr = false;
6657 
6658  // Check for a decomposed complex comparison pattern (extractvalue + fcmp +
6659  // and/or of the real/imaginary fields).
6660  ComplexComparePattern cplx = detectComplexCompareEq(block);
6661  bool isComplexPattern = cplx.isComplex;
6662  if (isComplexPattern) {
6663  if (cplx.isNE)
6664  // OrOp corresponds to NE, which is not a valid atomic compare op.
6665  return atomicCompareOp.emitError(
6666  "unsupported comparison predicate (NE) for complex atomic compare");
6667  compareOp = llvm::omp::OMPAtomicCompareOp::EQ;
6668  isXBinopExpr = cplx.isXBinopExpr;
6669  eVal = materializeValue(cplx.eAggregate);
6670  }
6671 
6672  if (isComplexPattern) {
6673  // dVal from SelectOp or YieldOp.
6674  for (Operation &op : block.getOperations()) {
6675  if (auto selectOp = dyn_cast<LLVM::SelectOp>(op)) {
6676  dVal = materializeValue(selectOp.getTrueValue());
6677  break;
6678  }
6679  }
6680  if (!dVal) {
6681  auto yieldOp = cast<omp::YieldOp>(block.getTerminator());
6682  if (yieldOp.getResults().empty())
6683  return atomicCompareOp.emitError(
6684  "failed to extract desired value (d) from atomic compare region");
6685  dVal = materializeValue(yieldOp.getResults()[0]);
6686  }
6687 
6688  llvm::Value *oldComplex = nullptr;
6689  llvm::Value *cmpOk = nullptr;
6690  llvm::AtomicOrdering failOrdering =
6691  getAtomicCompareFailureOrdering(atomicCompareOp, atomicOrdering);
6692  emitComplexAtomicCmpXchg(builder, llvmX, llvmXElementType, eVal, dVal,
6693  atomicOrdering, failOrdering,
6694  atomicCompareOp.getWeak(), oldComplex, cmpOk);
6695  (void)oldComplex;
6696  (void)cmpOk;
6697 
6698  // Emit flush after atomic compare if needed (for release, acq_rel,
6699  // seq_cst orderings).
6700  if (atomicOrdering == llvm::AtomicOrdering::Release ||
6701  atomicOrdering == llvm::AtomicOrdering::AcquireRelease ||
6702  atomicOrdering == llvm::AtomicOrdering::SequentiallyConsistent) {
6703  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
6704  ompBuilder->createFlush(ompLoc);
6705  }
6706  return success();
6707  } else {
6708  AtomicComparePatternInfo patternInfo;
6709  if (failed(extractAtomicComparePattern(block, materializeValue,
6710  atomicCompareOp, patternInfo)))
6711  return failure();
6712  compareOp = patternInfo.compareOp;
6713  eVal = patternInfo.eVal;
6714  dVal = patternInfo.dVal;
6715  isXBinopExpr = patternInfo.isXBinopExpr;
6716  isSigned = patternInfo.isSigned;
6717  }
6718 
6719  if (!eVal)
6720  return atomicCompareOp.emitError(
6721  "failed to extract expected value (e) from atomic compare region");
6722  if (!dVal) {
6723  // Fall back to the yield operand.
6724  auto yieldOp = cast<omp::YieldOp>(block.getTerminator());
6725  if (yieldOp.getResults().empty())
6726  return atomicCompareOp.emitError(
6727  "failed to extract desired value (d) from atomic compare region");
6728  dVal = materializeValue(yieldOp.getResults()[0]);
6729  }
6730 
6731  llvmAtomicX.IsSigned = isSigned;
6732 
6733  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue vOpVal = {nullptr, nullptr, false,
6734  false};
6735  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::AtomicOpValue rOpVal = {nullptr, nullptr, false,
6736  false};
6737  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
6738 
6739  bool isWeak = atomicCompareOp.getWeak();
6740 
6741  bool savedHandleFPNegZero = ompBuilder->setHandleFPNegZero(true);
6742  llvm::AtomicOrdering failureOrdering =
6743  getAtomicCompareFailureOrdering(atomicCompareOp, atomicOrdering);
6744  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterIP =
6745  ompBuilder->createAtomicCompare(
6746  ompLoc, llvmAtomicX, vOpVal, rOpVal, eVal, dVal, atomicOrdering,
6747  compareOp, isXBinopExpr, /*IsPostfixUpdate=*/false,
6748  /*IsFailOnly=*/false, failureOrdering, isWeak);
6749  ompBuilder->setHandleFPNegZero(savedHandleFPNegZero);
6750 
6751  if (failed(handleError(afterIP, *atomicCompareOp)))
6752  return failure();
6753 
6754  builder.restoreIP(*afterIP);
6755  return success();
6756 }
6757 
6758 static llvm::omp::Directive convertCancellationConstructType(
6759  omp::ClauseCancellationConstructType directive) {
6760  switch (directive) {
6761  case omp::ClauseCancellationConstructType::Loop:
6762  return llvm::omp::Directive::OMPD_for;
6763  case omp::ClauseCancellationConstructType::Parallel:
6764  return llvm::omp::Directive::OMPD_parallel;
6765  case omp::ClauseCancellationConstructType::Sections:
6766  return llvm::omp::Directive::OMPD_sections;
6767  case omp::ClauseCancellationConstructType::Taskgroup:
6768  return llvm::omp::Directive::OMPD_taskgroup;
6769  }
6770  llvm_unreachable("Unhandled cancellation construct type");
6771 }

6773 static LogicalResult
6774 convertOmpCancel(omp::CancelOp op, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
6775  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
6776  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(*op.getOperation())))
6777  return failure();
6778 
6779  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
6780  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
6781 
6782  llvm::Value *ifCond = nullptr;
6783  if (Value ifVar = op.getIfExpr())
6784  ifCond = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(ifVar);
6785 
6786  llvm::omp::Directive cancelledDirective =
6787  convertCancellationConstructType(op.getCancelDirective());
6788 
6789  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterIP =
6790  ompBuilder->createCancel(ompLoc, ifCond, cancelledDirective);
6791 
6792  if (failed(handleError(afterIP, *op.getOperation())))
6793  return failure();
6794 
6795  builder.restoreIP(afterIP.get());
6796 
6797  return success();
6798 }

6800 static LogicalResult
6801 convertOmpCancellationPoint(omp::CancellationPointOp op,
6802  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,

6824 /// Converts an OpenMP Threadprivate operation into LLVM IR using
6825 /// OpenMPIRBuilder.
6826 static LogicalResult
6827 convertOmpThreadprivate(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
6828  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
6829  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
6830  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
6831  auto threadprivateOp = cast<omp::ThreadprivateOp>(opInst);
6832 
6833  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(opInst)))
6834  return failure();
6835 
6836  Value symAddr = threadprivateOp.getSymAddr();
6837  auto *symOp = symAddr.getDefiningOp();
6838 
6839  if (auto asCast = dyn_cast<LLVM::AddrSpaceCastOp>(symOp))
6840  symOp = asCast.getOperand().getDefiningOp();
6841 
6842  if (!isa<LLVM::AddressOfOp>(symOp))
6843  return opInst.emitError("Addressing symbol not found");
6844  LLVM::AddressOfOp addressOfOp = dyn_cast<LLVM::AddressOfOp>(symOp);
6845 
6846  LLVM::GlobalOp global =
6847  addressOfOp.getGlobal(moduleTranslation.symbolTable());
6848  llvm::GlobalValue *globalValue = moduleTranslation.lookupGlobal(global);
6849  llvm::Type *type = globalValue->getValueType();
6850  llvm::TypeSize typeSize =
6851  builder.GetInsertBlock()->getModule()->getDataLayout().getTypeStoreSize(
6852  type);
6853  llvm::ConstantInt *size = builder.getInt64(typeSize.getFixedValue());
6854  llvm::Value *callInst = ompBuilder->createCachedThreadPrivate(
6855  ompLoc, globalValue, size, global.getSymName() + ".cache");
6856  moduleTranslation.mapValue(opInst.getResult(0), callInst);
6857 
6858  return success();
6859 }

6862 convertToDeviceClauseKind(mlir::omp::DeclareTargetDeviceType deviceClause) {
6863  switch (deviceClause) {

6866  break;
6867  case mlir::omp::DeclareTargetDeviceType::nohost:

6877 static llvm::OffloadEntriesInfoManager::OMPTargetGlobalVarEntryKind
6878 convertToCaptureClauseKind(

6893 static Operation *getGlobalOpFromValue(Value value) {
6894  Operation *op = value.getDefiningOp();
6895  if (auto addrCast = dyn_cast_if_present<LLVM::AddrSpaceCastOp>(op))
6896  op = addrCast->getOperand(0).getDefiningOp();
6897  if (auto addressOfOp = dyn_cast_if_present<LLVM::AddressOfOp>(op)) {
6898  auto modOp = addressOfOp->getParentOfType<mlir::ModuleOp>();
6899  return modOp.lookupSymbol(addressOfOp.getGlobalName());
6900  }
6901  return nullptr;
6902 }
6903 
6904 static Value getBaseValueForTypeLookup(Value value) {
6905  while (Operation *op = value.getDefiningOp()) {
6906  if (auto addrCast = dyn_cast_if_present<LLVM::AddrSpaceCastOp>(op))
6907  value = addrCast.getOperand();
6908  // Traces through hlfir.declare, fir.declare to reach the base address and
6909  // use for type lookup.
6910  else if (op->getName().getIdentifier() &&
6911  (op->getName().getIdentifier().str() == "hlfir.declare" ||
6912  op->getName().getIdentifier().str() == "fir.declare")) {
6913  if (op->getNumOperands() > 0)
6914  value = op->getOperand(0);
6915  else
6916  break;
6917  } else {
6918  break;
6919  }
6920  }
6921  return value;
6922 }
6923 
6924 static llvm::SmallString<64>
6925 getDeclareTargetRefPtrSuffix(LLVM::GlobalOp globalOp,
6926  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder &ompBuilder,
6927  llvm::vfs::FileSystem &vfs) {
6928  llvm::SmallString<64> suffix;
6929  llvm::raw_svector_ostream os(suffix);
6930  if (globalOp.getVisibility() == mlir::SymbolTable::Visibility::Private) {
6931  auto loc = globalOp->getLoc()->findInstanceOf<FileLineColLoc>();
6932  auto fileInfoCallBack = [&loc]() {
6933  return std::pair<std::string, uint64_t>(
6934  llvm::StringRef(loc.getFilename()), loc.getLine());
6935  };
6936 
6937  os << llvm::format(
6938  "_%x",
6939  ompBuilder.getTargetEntryUniqueInfo(fileInfoCallBack, vfs).FileID);
6940  }
6941  os << "_decl_tgt_ref_ptr";
6942 
6943  return suffix;
6944 }
6945 
6946 static bool isDeclareTargetLink(Value value) {
6947  if (auto declareTargetGlobal =
6948  dyn_cast_if_present<omp::DeclareTargetInterface>(
6949  getGlobalOpFromValue(value)))
6950  if (declareTargetGlobal.getDeclareTargetCaptureClause() ==
6951  omp::DeclareTargetCaptureClause::link)
6952  return true;
6953  return false;
6954 }
6955 
6956 static bool isDeclareTargetTo(Value value) {
6957  if (auto declareTargetGlobal =
6958  dyn_cast_if_present<omp::DeclareTargetInterface>(
6959  getGlobalOpFromValue(value)))
6960  if (declareTargetGlobal.getDeclareTargetCaptureClause() ==
6961  omp::DeclareTargetCaptureClause::to ||
6962  declareTargetGlobal.getDeclareTargetCaptureClause() ==
6963  omp::DeclareTargetCaptureClause::enter)
6964  return true;
6965  return false;
6966 }
6967 
6968 // Returns the reference pointer generated by the lowering of the declare
6969 // target operation in cases where the link clause is used or the to clause is
6970 // used in USM mode.
6971 static llvm::Value *
6972 getRefPtrIfDeclareTarget(Value value,
6973  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
6974  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
6975  if (auto gOp =
6976  dyn_cast_or_null<LLVM::GlobalOp>(getGlobalOpFromValue(value))) {
6977  // In this case, we must utilise the reference pointer generated by
6978  // the declare target operation, similar to Clang
6979  if (isDeclareTargetLink(value) ||
6980  (isDeclareTargetTo(value) &&
6981  ompBuilder->Config.hasRequiresUnifiedSharedMemory())) {
6982  llvm::SmallString<64> suffix = getDeclareTargetRefPtrSuffix(
6983  gOp, *ompBuilder, moduleTranslation.getFileSystem());
6984 
6985  if (gOp.getSymName().contains(suffix))
6986  return moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule()->getNamedValue(
6987  gOp.getSymName());
6988 
6989  return moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule()->getNamedValue(
6990  (gOp.getSymName().str() + suffix.str()).str());
6991  }
6992  }
6993  return nullptr;
6994 }

6996 namespace {
6997 // Append customMappers information to existing MapInfosTy
6998 struct MapInfosTy : llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::MapInfosTy {
6999  SmallVector<Operation *, 4> Mappers;
7000 
7001  /// Append arrays in \a CurInfo.
7002  void append(MapInfosTy &curInfo) {
7003  Mappers.append(curInfo.Mappers.begin(), curInfo.Mappers.end());
7004  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::MapInfosTy::append(curInfo);
7005  }
7006 };
7007 // A small helper structure to contain data gathered
7008 // for map lowering and coalese it into one area and
7009 // avoiding extra computations such as searches in the
7010 // llvm module for lowered mapped variables or checking
7011 // if something is declare target (and retrieving the
7012 // value) more than neccessary.
7013 struct MapInfoData : MapInfosTy {
7014  llvm::SmallVector<bool, 4> IsDeclareTarget;
7015  llvm::SmallVector<bool, 4> IsAMember;
7016  // Identify if mapping was added by mapClause or use_device clauses.
7017  llvm::SmallVector<bool, 4> IsAMapping;
7018  llvm::SmallVector<mlir::Operation *, 4> MapClause;
7019  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *, 4> OriginalValue;
7020  // Stripped off array/pointer to get the underlying
7021  // element type
7022  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Type *, 4> BaseType;
7023 
7024  /// Append arrays in \a CurInfo.
7025  void append(MapInfoData &CurInfo) {
7026  IsDeclareTarget.append(CurInfo.IsDeclareTarget.begin(),
7027  CurInfo.IsDeclareTarget.end());
7028  MapClause.append(CurInfo.MapClause.begin(), CurInfo.MapClause.end());
7029  OriginalValue.append(CurInfo.OriginalValue.begin(),
7030  CurInfo.OriginalValue.end());
7031  BaseType.append(CurInfo.BaseType.begin(), CurInfo.BaseType.end());
7032  MapInfosTy::append(CurInfo);
7033  }
7034 };

7036 enum class TargetDirectiveEnumTy : uint32_t {
7037  None = 0,
7038  Target = 1,
7039  TargetData = 2,
7040  TargetEnterData = 3,
7041  TargetExitData = 4,
7042  TargetUpdate = 5
7043 };
7044 
7045 static TargetDirectiveEnumTy getTargetDirectiveEnumTyFromOp(Operation *op) {
7046  return llvm::TypeSwitch<Operation *, TargetDirectiveEnumTy>(op)
7047  .Case([](omp::TargetDataOp) { return TargetDirectiveEnumTy::TargetData; })
7048  .Case([](omp::TargetEnterDataOp) {
7049  return TargetDirectiveEnumTy::TargetEnterData;
7050  })
7051  .Case([&](omp::TargetExitDataOp) {
7052  return TargetDirectiveEnumTy::TargetExitData;
7053  })
7054  .Case([&](omp::TargetUpdateOp) {
7055  return TargetDirectiveEnumTy::TargetUpdate;
7056  })
7057  .Case([&](omp::TargetOp) { return TargetDirectiveEnumTy::Target; })
7058  .Default([&](Operation *op) { return TargetDirectiveEnumTy::None; });
7059 }
7060 
7061 } // namespace
