7063 static uint64_t getArrayElementSizeInBits(LLVM::LLVMArrayType arrTy,
7064  DataLayout &dl) {
7065  if (auto nestedArrTy = llvm::dyn_cast_if_present<LLVM::LLVMArrayType>(
7066  arrTy.getElementType()))
7067  return getArrayElementSizeInBits(nestedArrTy, dl);
7068  return dl.getTypeSizeInBits(arrTy.getElementType());
7069 }
7070 
7071 // The intent is to verify if the mapped data being passed is a
7072 // pointer -> pointee that requires special handling in certain cases,
7073 // e.g. applying the OMP_MAP_PTR_AND_OBJ map type.
7074 //
7075 // There may be a better way to verify this, but unfortunately with
7076 // opaque pointers we lose the ability to easily check if something is
7077 // a pointer whilst maintaining access to the underlying type.
7078 static bool checkIfPointerMap(omp::MapInfoOp mapOp) {
7079  // If we have a varPtrPtr field assigned then the underlying type is a pointer
7080  if (mapOp.getVarPtrPtr())
7081  return true;
7082 
7083  // If the map data is declare target with a link clause, then it's represented
7084  // as a pointer when we lower it to LLVM-IR even if at the MLIR level it has
7085  // no relation to pointers.
7086  if (isDeclareTargetLink(mapOp.getVarPtr()))
7087  return true;
7088 
7089  return false;
7090 }
7091 
7092 // A privatizeable attach map is a pointer/descriptor that is privatized and
7093 // passed directly as a kernel argument (target_param) rather than undergoing
7094 // the standard attach/parent mapping. These are handled specially in a couple
7095 // of places in map lowering.
7096 static bool isPrivatizeableAttachMap(omp::ClauseMapFlags mapType) {
7097  return bitEnumContainsAll(mapType, omp::ClauseMapFlags::priv |
7098  omp::ClauseMapFlags::target_param |
7099  omp::ClauseMapFlags::attach);
7100 }
7101 
7102 // This function calculates the size to be offloaded for a specified type, given
7103 // its associated map clause (which can contain bounds information which affects
7104 // the total size), this size is calculated based on the underlying element type
7105 // e.g. given a 1-D array of ints, we will calculate the size from the integer
7106 // type * number of elements in the array. This size can be used in other
7107 // calculations but is ultimately used as an argument to the OpenMP runtimes
7108 // kernel argument structure which is generated through the combinedInfo data
7109 // structures.
7110 // This function is somewhat equivalent to Clang's getExprTypeSize inside of
7111 // CGOpenMPRuntime.cpp.
7112 static llvm::Value *getSizeInBytes(DataLayout &dl, const mlir::Type &type,
7113  Operation *clauseOp,
7114  llvm::Value *basePointer,
7115  llvm::Type *baseType,
7116  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
7117  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
7118  if (auto memberClause =
7119  mlir::dyn_cast_if_present<mlir::omp::MapInfoOp>(clauseOp)) {
7120  // This calculates the size to transfer based on bounds and the underlying
7121  // element type, provided bounds have been specified (Fortran
7122  // pointers/allocatables/target and arrays that have sections specified fall
7123  // into this as well)
7124  if (!memberClause.getBounds().empty()) {
7125  llvm::Value *elementCount = builder.getInt64(1);
7126  for (auto bounds : memberClause.getBounds()) {
7127  if (auto boundOp = mlir::dyn_cast_if_present<mlir::omp::MapBoundsOp>(
7128  bounds.getDefiningOp())) {
7129  // The below calculation for the size to be mapped calculated from the
7130  // map.info's bounds is: (elemCount * [UB - LB] + 1), later we
7131  // multiply by the underlying element types byte size to get the full
7132  // size to be offloaded based on the bounds
7133  elementCount = builder.CreateMul(
7134  elementCount,
7135  builder.CreateAdd(
7136  builder.CreateSub(
7137  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(boundOp.getUpperBound()),
7138  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(boundOp.getLowerBound())),
7139  builder.getInt64(1)));
7140  }
7141  }
7142 
7143  // utilising getTypeSizeInBits instead of getTypeSize as getTypeSize gives
7144  // the size in inconsistent byte or bit format.
7145  uint64_t underlyingTypeSzInBits = dl.getTypeSizeInBits(type);
7146  if (auto arrTy = llvm::dyn_cast_if_present<LLVM::LLVMArrayType>(type))
7147  underlyingTypeSzInBits = getArrayElementSizeInBits(arrTy, dl);
7148 
7149  // The size in bytes x number of elements, the sizeInBytes stored is
7150  // the underyling types size, e.g. if ptr<i32>, it'll be the i32's
7151  // size, so we do some on the fly runtime math to get the size in
7152  // bytes from the extent (ub - lb) * sizeInBytes. NOTE: This may need
7153  // some adjustment for members with more complex types.
7154  llvm::Value *sizeCalc = builder.CreateMul(
7155  elementCount, builder.getInt64(underlyingTypeSzInBits / 8),
7156  "element_count");
7157 
7158  // This is a part of a "complicated" bit of size calculation logic that is
7159  // in place to handle a couple of scenarios, one specific to Fortran and
7160  // the other a more general OpenMP issue. The other piece of the
7161  // calculation can be found as the final size calculation within the
7162  // processIndividualMap function. Ideally we would move it here, but due
7163  // to the complexity of calculating the final base address of some
7164  // constructs (required for a nullary check), it's left as the final step.
7165  // So, in the below 2 cases, the nullary check is in processIndividualMap
7166  // and the size equality check is here. The cases this modifications help
7167  // cover are:
7168  //
7169  // 1) If an argument has a null base pointer, then the size must be set to
7170  // 0 to avoid the runtime exploding/complaining about an illegal
7171  // pointer map. The size returning non-zero is feasible in certain
7172  // cases if for example someone has specified there own bounds/range.
7173  // 2) We wish to support a very specific OpenMP Fortran edge-case where a
7174  // size zero array can be legally presence checked and found to be on
7175  // device when it has been mapped. In these rare occasions the
7176  // allocatable/pointer will have a size of 1 allocated for the
7177  // underlying data, but this wall not be represented within the size of
7178  // the descriptor, so we get a non-nullary pointer and a size of 0,
7179  // allowing us to specify a size of 1 in these cases registering it on
7180  // the device mapping table as present.
7181  //
7182  // The default fall through case is just returning the size calculation
7183  // above, if we are not nullary and the size we calculate is non-zero,
7184  // which is basically any pointer type that is allocated in someway
7185  // (providing you are not running on a rare system that allows malloc's of
7186  // size 0 with whatever caveats that may come with).
7187  //
7188  // Later in the nullary check in processIndividualMap it just devolves to
7189  // selecting a size of 0 if we are nullary, if we are not, we will return
7190  // either 1 or the calculated size, depending on the outcome of this
7191  // select.
7192  if (checkIfPointerMap(memberClause)) {
7193  return builder.CreateSelect(
7194  builder.CreateICmpEQ(sizeCalc, builder.getInt64(0)),
7195  builder.getInt64(1), sizeCalc);
7196  }
7197 
7198  return sizeCalc;
7199  }
7200  }
7201 
7202  return builder.getInt64(dl.getTypeSizeInBits(type) / 8);
7203 }
7204 
7205 // Convert the MLIR map flag set to the runtime map flag set for embedding
7206 // in LLVM-IR. This is important as the two bit-flag lists do not correspond
7207 // 1-to-1 as there's flags the runtime doesn't care about and vice versa.
7208 // Certain flags are discarded here such as RefPtee and co.
7209 static llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags
7210 convertClauseMapFlags(omp::ClauseMapFlags mlirFlags) {
7211  const bool hasExplicitMap =
7212  (mlirFlags & ~omp::ClauseMapFlags::is_device_ptr) !=
7213  omp::ClauseMapFlags::none;
7214 
7215  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags mapType =
7216  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_NONE;
7217 
7218  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::to))
7219  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_TO;
7220 
7221  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::from))
7222  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_FROM;
7223 
7224  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::always))
7225  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_ALWAYS;
7226 
7227  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::del))
7228  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_DELETE;
7229 
7230  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::return_param))
7231  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_RETURN_PARAM;
7232 
7233  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::priv))
7234  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_PRIVATE;
7235 
7236  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::literal))
7237  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_LITERAL;
7238 
7239  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::implicit))
7240  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_IMPLICIT;
7241 
7242  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::close))
7243  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_CLOSE;
7244 
7245  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::present))
7246  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_PRESENT;
7247 
7248  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::ompx_hold))
7249  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_OMPX_HOLD;
7250 
7251  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::attach))
7252  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_ATTACH;
7253 
7254  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::target_param))
7255  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_TARGET_PARAM;
7256 
7257  if (bitEnumContainsAll(mlirFlags, omp::ClauseMapFlags::is_device_ptr)) {
7258  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_TARGET_PARAM;
7259  if (!hasExplicitMap)
7260  mapType |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_LITERAL;
7261  }
7262 
7263  return mapType;
7264 }
7265 
7266 static void collectMapDataFromMapOperands(
7267  MapInfoData &mapData, SmallVectorImpl<Value> &mapVars,
7268  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation, DataLayout &dl,
7269  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder, ArrayRef<Value> useDevPtrOperands = {},
7270  ArrayRef<Value> useDevAddrOperands = {},
7271  ArrayRef<Value> hasDevAddrOperands = {}) {
7272 
7273  auto checkRefPtrOrPteeMapWithAttach = [](omp::ClauseMapFlags mapType) {
7274  bool hasRefType =
7275  bitEnumContainsAll(mapType, omp::ClauseMapFlags::ref_ptr) ||
7276  bitEnumContainsAll(mapType, omp::ClauseMapFlags::ref_ptee);
7277  return hasRefType &&
7278  bitEnumContainsAll(mapType, omp::ClauseMapFlags::attach);
7279  };
7280 
7281  auto checkIsAMember = [](const auto &mapVars, auto mapOp) {
7282  // Check if this is a member mapping and correctly assign that it is, if
7283  // it is a member of a larger object.
7284  // TODO: Need better handling of members, and distinguishing of members
7285  // that are implicitly allocated on device vs explicitly passed in as
7286  // arguments.
7287  // TODO: May require some further additions to support nested record
7288  // types, i.e. member maps that can have member maps.
7289  for (Value mapValue : mapVars) {
7290  auto map = cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapValue.getDefiningOp());
7291  for (auto member : map.getMembers())
7292  if (member == mapOp)
7293  return true;
7294  }
7295  return false;
7296  };
7297 
7298  // Process MapOperands
7299  for (Value mapValue : mapVars) {
7300  auto mapOp = cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapValue.getDefiningOp());
7301  bool isAttachStyleMap =
7302  checkRefPtrOrPteeMapWithAttach(mapOp.getMapType()) ||
7303  isPrivatizeableAttachMap(mapOp.getMapType());
7304  Value offloadPtr = (mapOp.getVarPtrPtr() && !isAttachStyleMap)
7305  ? mapOp.getVarPtrPtr()
7306  : mapOp.getVarPtr();
7307  mapData.OriginalValue.push_back(moduleTranslation.lookupValue(offloadPtr));
7308  mapData.Pointers.push_back(
7309  isAttachStyleMap ? moduleTranslation.lookupValue(mapOp.getVarPtrPtr())
7310  : mapData.OriginalValue.back());
7311 
7312  if (llvm::Value *refPtr =
7313  getRefPtrIfDeclareTarget(offloadPtr, moduleTranslation)) {
7314  mapData.IsDeclareTarget.push_back(true);
7315  mapData.BasePointers.push_back(refPtr);
7316  } else if (isDeclareTargetTo(offloadPtr)) {
7317  mapData.IsDeclareTarget.push_back(true);
7318  mapData.BasePointers.push_back(mapData.OriginalValue.back());
7319  } else { // regular mapped variable
7320  mapData.IsDeclareTarget.push_back(false);
7321  mapData.BasePointers.push_back(mapData.OriginalValue.back());
7322  }
7323 
7324  // In every situation we currently have if we have a varPtrPtr present
7325  // we wish to utilise it's type for the base type, main cases are
7326  // currently Fortran descriptor base address maps and attach maps.
7327  mapData.BaseType.push_back(moduleTranslation.convertType(
7328  mapOp.getVarPtrPtr() ? mapOp.getVarPtrPtrType().value()
7329  : mapOp.getVarPtrType()));
7330 
7331  // For the attach map cases, it's a little odd, as we effectively have to
7332  // utilise the base address (including all bounds offsets) for the pointer
7333  // field, the pointer address for the base address field, and the pointer
7334  // not the data (base addresses) size. So we end up with a mix of base
7335  // types and sizes we wish to insert here.
7336  mlir::Type sizeType = (isAttachStyleMap || !mapOp.getVarPtrPtr())
7337  ? mapOp.getVarPtrType()
7338  : mapOp.getVarPtrPtrType().value();
7339  mapData.Sizes.push_back(getSizeInBytes(
7340  dl, sizeType, isAttachStyleMap ? nullptr : mapOp,
7341  mapData.Pointers.back(), moduleTranslation.convertType(sizeType),
7342  builder, moduleTranslation));
7343  mapData.MapClause.push_back(mapOp.getOperation());
7344  mapData.Types.push_back(convertClauseMapFlags(mapOp.getMapType()));
7345  // TODO: set HasAttachPtr from Flang for pointee-storage entries.
7346  mapData.HasAttachPtr.push_back(false);
7347  mapData.Names.push_back(LLVM::createMappingInformation(
7348  mapOp.getLoc(), *moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()));
7349  mapData.DevicePointers.push_back(llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::None);
7350  if (mapOp.getMapperId())
7351  mapData.Mappers.push_back(
7352  SymbolTable::lookupNearestSymbolFrom<omp::DeclareMapperOp>(
7353  mapOp, mapOp.getMapperIdAttr()));
7354  else
7355  mapData.Mappers.push_back(nullptr);
7356  mapData.IsAMapping.push_back(true);
7357  mapData.IsAMember.push_back(checkIsAMember(mapVars, mapOp));
7358  }
7359 
7360  auto findMapInfo = [&mapData](llvm::Value *val,
7361  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy devInfoTy,
7362  size_t memberCount) {
7363  unsigned index = 0;
7364  bool found = false;
7365  for (llvm::Value *basePtr : mapData.OriginalValue) {
7366  auto mapOp = cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapData.MapClause[index]);
7367  // TODO: Currently we define an equivalent mapping as
7368  // the same base pointer and an equivalent member count, but
7369  // that is a loose definition. We may have to extend to check
7370  // for other fields (varPtrPtr/individual members being mapped).
7371  // Note: Attach maps are not the same as a normal data transfer
7372  // they specify to the runtime to perform an attach map and they
7373  // (at least at the moment) are never something we would aim to
7374  // return in a use_dev_* clause, so they are skipped in terms of
7375  // duplicate maps.
7376  bool isAttachMap =
7377  (mapData.Types[index] &
7378  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_ATTACH) ==
7379  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_ATTACH;
7380  if (!isAttachMap && basePtr == val && mapData.IsAMapping[index] &&
7381  memberCount == mapOp.getMembers().size()) {
7382  found = true;
7383  mapData.Types[index] |=
7384  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_RETURN_PARAM;
7385  mapData.DevicePointers[index] = devInfoTy;
7386  }
7387  index++;
7388  }
7389  return found;
7390  };
7391 
7392  // Process useDevPtr(Addr)Operands
7393  auto addDevInfos = [&](const llvm::ArrayRef<Value> &useDevOperands,
7394  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy devInfoTy) {
7395  for (Value mapValue : useDevOperands) {
7396  auto mapOp = cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapValue.getDefiningOp());
7397  Value offloadPtr =
7398  mapOp.getVarPtrPtr() ? mapOp.getVarPtrPtr() : mapOp.getVarPtr();
7399  llvm::Value *origValue = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(offloadPtr);
7400 
7401  // Check if map info is already present for this entry.
7402  if (!findMapInfo(origValue, devInfoTy, mapOp.getMembers().size())) {
7403  mapData.OriginalValue.push_back(origValue);
7404  mapData.Pointers.push_back(mapData.OriginalValue.back());
7405  mapData.IsDeclareTarget.push_back(false);
7406  mapData.BasePointers.push_back(mapData.OriginalValue.back());
7407  mlir::Type baseTy = mapOp.getVarPtrPtr()
7408  ? mapOp.getVarPtrPtrType().value()
7409  : mapOp.getVarPtrType();
7410  mapData.BaseType.push_back(moduleTranslation.convertType(baseTy));
7411  mapData.Sizes.push_back(builder.getInt64(0));
7412  mapData.MapClause.push_back(mapOp.getOperation());
7413  mapData.Types.push_back(
7414  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_RETURN_PARAM);
7415  // TODO: set HasAttachPtr from Flang for pointee-storage entries.
7416  mapData.HasAttachPtr.push_back(false);
7417  mapData.Names.push_back(LLVM::createMappingInformation(
7418  mapOp.getLoc(), *moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()));
7419  mapData.DevicePointers.push_back(devInfoTy);
7420  mapData.Mappers.push_back(nullptr);
7421  mapData.IsAMapping.push_back(false);
7422  mapData.IsAMember.push_back(checkIsAMember(useDevOperands, mapOp));
7423  }
7424  }
7425  };
7426 
7427  addDevInfos(useDevAddrOperands, llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::Address);
7428  addDevInfos(useDevPtrOperands, llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::Pointer);
7429 
7430  for (Value mapValue : hasDevAddrOperands) {
7431  auto mapOp = cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapValue.getDefiningOp());
7432  Value offloadPtr =
7433  mapOp.getVarPtrPtr() ? mapOp.getVarPtrPtr() : mapOp.getVarPtr();
7434  llvm::Value *origValue = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(offloadPtr);
7435  auto mapType = convertClauseMapFlags(mapOp.getMapType());
7436  auto mapTypeAlways = llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_ALWAYS;
7437  bool isDevicePtr =
7438  (mapOp.getMapType() & omp::ClauseMapFlags::is_device_ptr) !=
7439  omp::ClauseMapFlags::none;
7440 
7441  mapData.OriginalValue.push_back(origValue);
7442  mapData.BasePointers.push_back(origValue);
7443  mapData.Pointers.push_back(origValue);
7444  mapData.IsDeclareTarget.push_back(false);
7445 
7446  mlir::Type baseTy = mapOp.getVarPtrPtr() ? mapOp.getVarPtrPtrType().value()
7447  : mapOp.getVarPtrType();
7448  mapData.BaseType.push_back(moduleTranslation.convertType(baseTy));
7449  mapData.Sizes.push_back(builder.getInt64(dl.getTypeSize(baseTy)));
7450 
7451  mapData.MapClause.push_back(mapOp.getOperation());
7452  if (llvm::to_underlying(mapType & mapTypeAlways)) {
7453  // Descriptors are mapped with the ALWAYS flag, since they can get
7454  // rematerialized, so the address of the decriptor for a given object
7455  // may change from one place to another.
7456  mapData.Types.push_back(mapType);
7457  // TODO: set HasAttachPtr from Flang for pointee-storage entries.
7458  mapData.HasAttachPtr.push_back(false);
7459  // Technically it's possible for a non-descriptor mapping to have
7460  // both has-device-addr and ALWAYS, so lookup the mapper in case it
7461  // exists.
7462  if (mapOp.getMapperId()) {
7463  mapData.Mappers.push_back(
7464  SymbolTable::lookupNearestSymbolFrom<omp::DeclareMapperOp>(
7465  mapOp, mapOp.getMapperIdAttr()));
7466  } else {
7467  mapData.Mappers.push_back(nullptr);
7468  }
7469  } else {
7470  // For is_device_ptr we need the map type to propagate so the runtime
7471  // can materialize the device-side copy of the pointer container.
7472  mapData.Types.push_back(
7473  isDevicePtr ? mapType
7474  : llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_LITERAL);
7475  // TODO: set HasAttachPtr from Flang for pointee-storage entries.
7476  mapData.HasAttachPtr.push_back(false);
7477  mapData.Mappers.push_back(nullptr);
7478  }
7479  mapData.Names.push_back(LLVM::createMappingInformation(
7480  mapOp.getLoc(), *moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()));
7481  mapData.DevicePointers.push_back(
7482  isDevicePtr ? llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::Pointer
7483  : llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::Address);
7484  mapData.IsAMapping.push_back(false);
7485  mapData.IsAMember.push_back(checkIsAMember(hasDevAddrOperands, mapOp));
7486  }
7487 }
7488 
7489 static int getMapDataMemberIdx(MapInfoData &mapData, omp::MapInfoOp memberOp) {
7490  auto *res = llvm::find(mapData.MapClause, memberOp);
7491  assert(res != mapData.MapClause.end() &&
7492  "MapInfoOp for member not found in MapData, cannot return index");
7493  return std::distance(mapData.MapClause.begin(), res);
7494 }
7495 
7496 static void sortMapIndices(llvm::SmallVectorImpl<size_t> &indices,
7497  omp::MapInfoOp mapInfo, bool first = true) {
7498  ArrayAttr indexAttr = mapInfo.getMembersIndexAttr();
7499  llvm::SmallVector<size_t> occludedChildren;
7500  llvm::sort(
7501  indices.begin(), indices.end(), [&](const size_t a, const size_t b) {
7502  // Bail early if we are asked to look at the same index. If we do not
7503  // bail early, we can end up mistakenly adding indices to
7504  // occludedChildren. This can occur with some types of libc++ hardening.
7505  if (a == b)
7506  return false;
7507 
7508  auto memberIndicesA = cast<ArrayAttr>(indexAttr[a]);
7509  auto memberIndicesB = cast<ArrayAttr>(indexAttr[b]);
7510 
7511  for (auto it : llvm::zip(memberIndicesA, memberIndicesB)) {
7512  int64_t aIndex = mlir::cast<IntegerAttr>(std::get<0>(it)).getInt();
7513  int64_t bIndex = mlir::cast<IntegerAttr>(std::get<1>(it)).getInt();
7514 
7515  if (aIndex == bIndex)
7516  continue;
7517 
7518  if (aIndex < bIndex)
7519  return first;
7520 
7521  if (aIndex > bIndex)
7522  return !first;
7523  }
7524 
7525  // Iterated up until the end of the smallest member and
7526  // they were found to be equal up to that point, so select
7527  // the member with the lowest index count, so the "parent"
7528  bool memberAParent = memberIndicesA.size() < memberIndicesB.size();
7529  if (memberAParent)
7530  occludedChildren.push_back(b);
7531  else
7532  occludedChildren.push_back(a);
7533  return memberAParent;
7534  });
7535 
7536  for (auto v : occludedChildren)
7537  indices.erase(std::remove(indices.begin(), indices.end(), v),
7538  indices.end());
7539 }
7540 
7541 static omp::MapInfoOp getFirstOrLastMappedMemberPtr(omp::MapInfoOp mapInfo,
7542  bool first) {
7543  ArrayAttr indexAttr = mapInfo.getMembersIndexAttr();
7544  // Only 1 member has been mapped, we can return it.
7545  if (indexAttr.size() == 1)
7546  return cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapInfo.getMembers()[0].getDefiningOp());
7547  llvm::SmallVector<size_t> indices(indexAttr.size());
7548  std::iota(indices.begin(), indices.end(), 0);
7549  sortMapIndices(indices, mapInfo, first);
7550  return llvm::cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(
7551  mapInfo.getMembers()[indices.front()].getDefiningOp());
7552 }
7553 
7554 /// This function calculates the array/pointer offset for map data provided
7555 /// with bounds operations, e.g. when provided something like the following:
7556 ///
7557 /// Fortran
7558 /// map(tofrom: array(2:5, 3:2))
7559 ///
7560 /// We must calculate the initial pointer offset to pass across, this function
7561 /// performs this using bounds.
7562 ///
7563 /// TODO/WARNING: This only supports Fortran's column major indexing currently
7564 /// as is noted in the note below and comments in the function, we must extend
7565 /// this function when we add a C++ frontend.
7566 /// NOTE: which while specified in row-major order it currently needs to be
7567 /// flipped for Fortran's column order array allocation and access (as
7568 /// opposed to C++'s row-major, hence the backwards processing where order is
7569 /// important). This is likely important to keep in mind for the future when
7570 /// we incorporate a C++ frontend, both frontends will need to agree on the
7571 /// ordering of generated bounds operations (one may have to flip them) to
7572 /// make the below lowering frontend agnostic. The offload size
7573 /// calcualtion may also have to be adjusted for C++.
7574 static std::vector<llvm::Value *>
7575 calculateBoundsOffset(LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation,
7576  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder, bool isArrayTy,
7577  OperandRange bounds) {
7578  std::vector<llvm::Value *> idx;
7579  // There's no bounds to calculate an offset from, we can safely
7580  // ignore and return no indices.
7581  if (bounds.empty())
7582  return idx;
7583 
7584  // If we have an array type, then we have its type so can treat it as a
7585  // normal GEP instruction where the bounds operations are simply indexes
7586  // into the array. We currently do reverse order of the bounds, which
7587  // I believe leans more towards Fortran's column-major in memory.
7588  if (isArrayTy) {
7589  idx.push_back(builder.getInt64(0));
7590  for (int i = bounds.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
7591  if (auto boundOp = dyn_cast_if_present<omp::MapBoundsOp>(
7592  bounds[i].getDefiningOp())) {
7593  idx.push_back(moduleTranslation.lookupValue(boundOp.getLowerBound()));
7594  }
7595  }
7596  } else {
7597  // If we do not have an array type, but we have bounds, then we're dealing
7598  // with a pointer that's being treated like an array and we have the
7599  // underlying type e.g. an i32, or f64 etc, e.g. a fortran descriptor base
7600  // address (pointer pointing to the actual data) so we must caclulate the
7601  // offset using a single index which the following loop attempts to
7602  // compute using the standard column-major algorithm e.g for a 3D array:
7603  //
7604  // ((((c_idx * b_len) + b_idx) * a_len) + a_idx)
7605  //
7606  // It is of note that it's doing column-major rather than row-major at the
7607  // moment, but having a way for the frontend to indicate which major format
7608  // to use or standardizing/canonicalizing the order of the bounds to compute
7609  // the offset may be useful in the future when there's other frontends with
7610  // different formats.
7611  for (int i = bounds.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
7612  if (auto boundOp = dyn_cast_if_present<omp::MapBoundsOp>(
7613  bounds[i].getDefiningOp())) {
7614  if (i == ((int)bounds.size() - 1))
7615  idx.emplace_back(
7616  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(boundOp.getLowerBound()));
7617  else
7618  idx.back() = builder.CreateAdd(
7619  builder.CreateMul(idx.back(), moduleTranslation.lookupValue(
7620  boundOp.getExtent())),
7621  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(boundOp.getLowerBound()));
7622  }
7623  }
7624  }
7625 
7626  return idx;
7627 }
7628 
7629 static void getAsIntegers(ArrayAttr values, llvm::SmallVector<int64_t> &ints) {
7630  llvm::transform(values, std::back_inserter(ints), [](Attribute value) {
7631  return cast<IntegerAttr>(value).getInt();
7632  });
7633 }
7634 
7635 // Gathers members that are overlapping in the parent, excluding members that
7636 // themselves overlap, keeping the top-most (closest to parents level) map.
7637 static void
7638 getOverlappedMembers(llvm::SmallVectorImpl<size_t> &overlapMapDataIdxs,
7639  omp::MapInfoOp parentOp) {
7640  // No members mapped, no overlaps.
7641  if (parentOp.getMembers().empty())
7642  return;
7643 
7644  // Single member, we can insert and return early.
7645  if (parentOp.getMembers().size() == 1) {
7646  overlapMapDataIdxs.push_back(0);
7647  return;
7648  }
7649 
7650  ArrayAttr indexAttr = parentOp.getMembersIndexAttr();
7651  size_t numMembers = indexAttr.size();
7652 
7653  // Pre-convert all member indices to integer arrays for efficient comparison.
7654  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::SmallVector<int64_t>> memberIndices(numMembers);
7655  for (auto [i, indicesAttr] : llvm::enumerate(indexAttr))
7656  getAsIntegers(cast<ArrayAttr>(indicesAttr), memberIndices[i]);
7657 
7658  // For each member, check if it's superseded by another (shorter prefix)
7659  // member. If member j's indices are a prefix of member i's indices, then
7660  // i is a child of j and should be skipped. e.g. if member [0] is mapped,
7661  // we skip members [0,1], [0,2], etc.
7662  llvm::SmallDenseSet<size_t> skipIndices;
7663  for (size_t i = 0; i < numMembers; ++i) {
7664  const auto &iIndices = memberIndices[i];
7665  for (size_t j = 0; j < numMembers; ++j) {
7666  if (i == j)
7667  continue;
7668  const auto &jIndices = memberIndices[j];
7669  // If j's indices are a strict prefix of i's indices, skip i
7670  if (jIndices.size() < iIndices.size() &&
7671  std::equal(jIndices.begin(), jIndices.end(), iIndices.begin())) {
7672  skipIndices.insert(i);
7673  break; // No need to check other potential parents
7674  }
7675  }
7676  }
7677 
7678  // Collect indices of members that are not superseded by a parent.
7679  for (size_t i = 0; i < numMembers; ++i)
7680  if (!skipIndices.contains(i))
7681  overlapMapDataIdxs.push_back(i);
7682 }
7683 
7684 /// This function handles the insertion of a single item of map data from
7685 /// MapInfoData into the OMPIRBuilder's MapInfo list. Utilising this function
7686 /// means the map being inserted can be treated as a non-parent map entity,
7687 /// if the memberOfFlag is set then the map being inserted is treated as
7688 /// a member map of a larger entity. The insertion into the MapInfo list of
7689 /// the OMPIRBuilder can vary based on a number of factors, such as if it's
7690 /// a ref_ptr or ref_ptee map, if it's a member of a record, what construct
7691 /// the map belongs to and the various map type bit flags that are set for
7692 /// the map.
7693 static void
7694 processIndividualMap(llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
7695  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder &ompBuilder, MapInfoData &mapData,
7696  size_t mapDataIdx, MapInfosTy &combinedInfo,
7697  TargetDirectiveEnumTy targetDirective,
7698  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags memberOfFlag =
7699  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_NONE,
7700  bool isTargetParam = true, int mapDataParentIdx = -1) {
7701  auto mapFlag = mapData.Types[mapDataIdx];
7702  auto mapInfoOp = llvm::cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapData.MapClause[mapDataIdx]);
7703 
7704  bool isPtrTy = checkIfPointerMap(mapInfoOp);
7705  bool isAttachMap = ((convertClauseMapFlags(mapInfoOp.getMapType()) &
7706  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_ATTACH) ==
7707  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_ATTACH);
7708 
7709  // Declare target variables are not passed to the kernel, and for the moment
7710  // attach maps are not passed to the kernel. However, it is possible to create
7711  // attach maps that transfer data and thus can be kernel arguments, but our
7712  // existing frontend does not do this.
7713  if (isTargetParam &&
7714  (targetDirective == TargetDirectiveEnumTy::Target &&
7715  !mapData.IsDeclareTarget[mapDataIdx]) &&
7716  !isAttachMap)
7717  mapFlag |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_TARGET_PARAM;
7718 
7719  if (mapInfoOp.getMapCaptureType() == omp::VariableCaptureKind::ByCopy &&
7720  !isPtrTy)
7721  mapFlag |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_LITERAL;
7722 
7723  // If we have a pointer and it's part of a MEMBER_OF mapping we do not apply
7724  // MEMBER_OF, as the runtime currently has a work-around that utilises
7725  // MEMBER_OF to prevent reference updating in certain scenarios instead of
7726  // target_param. However, this causes a noticeable issue in cases where we
7727  // map some data (Fortran descriptor primarily at the moment), alter it on
7728  // the host, and then expect it to not be updated in a subsequent implicit map
7729  // (such as an implicit map on a target).
7730  if (memberOfFlag != llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_NONE) {
7731  if (!isPtrTy && !isAttachMap)
7732  ompBuilder.setCorrectMemberOfFlag(mapFlag, memberOfFlag);
7733 
7734  // The return parameter should be the over-riding parent in cases where we
7735  // have a return parameter that is echoed to all members, the main case of
7736  // this currently is with fortran descriptors. It may need more finessing
7737  // for C/C++ in the future or descriptors that are members of derived
7738  // types.
7739  mapFlag &= ~llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_RETURN_PARAM;
7740  }
7741 
7742  // We apply MAP_PTR_AND_OBJ when within a declare mapper object as it enforces
7743  // MEMBER_OF mappings on maps that are passed the initial nesting depth, which
7744  // includes pointed to data and attach members, both of which are technically
7745  // not part of the main object. This has the side effect of causing early
7746  // map-backs in certain cases where an implicit declare mapper has been
7747  // emitted for a target region. Applying MAP_PTR_AND_OBJ in these situations
7748  // circumvents this.
7749  if (isPtrTy && !isAttachMap && mapData.IsDeclareTarget[mapDataIdx])
7750  mapFlag |= llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_PTR_AND_OBJ;
7751 
7752  // if we're provided a mapDataParentIdx, then the data being mapped is
7753  // part of a larger object (in a parent <-> member mapping) and in this
7754  // case our BasePointer should be the parent. Except in the edge case
7755  // where we are mapping pointee data, where we try staying close to
7756  // what Clang currently does and utilise the regular base pointer of the
7757  // data.
7758  bool isRefPtee =
7759  !bitEnumContainsAll(mapInfoOp.getMapType(),
7760  omp::ClauseMapFlags::ref_ptr) &&
7761  bitEnumContainsAll(mapInfoOp.getMapType(), omp::ClauseMapFlags::ref_ptee);
7762  bool isRefPtrPtee = bitEnumContainsAll(mapInfoOp.getMapType(),
7763  omp::ClauseMapFlags::ref_ptr |
7764  omp::ClauseMapFlags::ref_ptee);
7765 
7766  if (!mapInfoOp->getParentOfType<omp::DeclareMapperOp>() &&
7767  mapDataParentIdx >= 0 && !(isRefPtee || (isRefPtrPtee && isPtrTy))) {
7768  combinedInfo.BasePointers.emplace_back(
7769  mapData.BasePointers[mapDataParentIdx]);
7770  } else {
7771  combinedInfo.BasePointers.emplace_back(mapData.BasePointers[mapDataIdx]);
7772  }
7773 
7774  combinedInfo.Pointers.emplace_back(mapData.Pointers[mapDataIdx]);
7775  combinedInfo.DevicePointers.emplace_back(
7776  memberOfFlag != llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_NONE
7777  ? llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::None
7778  : mapData.DevicePointers[mapDataIdx]);
7779  combinedInfo.Mappers.emplace_back(mapData.Mappers[mapDataIdx]);
7780  combinedInfo.Names.emplace_back(mapData.Names[mapDataIdx]);
7781  combinedInfo.Types.emplace_back(mapFlag);
7782  // TODO: set HasAttachPtr from Flang for pointee-storage entries.
7783  combinedInfo.HasAttachPtr.emplace_back(false);
7784  combinedInfo.Sizes.emplace_back(
7785  isPtrTy ? builder.CreateSelect(
7786  builder.CreateIsNull(mapData.Pointers[mapDataIdx]),
7787  builder.getInt64(0), mapData.Sizes[mapDataIdx])
7788  : mapData.Sizes[mapDataIdx]);
7789 }
7790 
7791 // This creates two insertions into the MapInfosTy data structure for the
7792 // "parent" of a set of members, (usually a container e.g.
7793 // class/structure/derived type) when subsequent members have also been
7794 // explicitly mapped on the same map clause. Certain types, such as Fortran
7795 // descriptors are mapped like this as well, however, the members are
7796 // implicit as far as a user is concerned, but we must explicitly map them
7797 // internally.
7798 //
7799 // This function also returns the memberOfFlag for this particular parent,
7800 // which is utilised in subsequent member mappings (by modifying there map type
7801 // with it) to indicate that a member is part of this parent and should be
7802 // treated by the runtime as such. Important to achieve the correct mapping.
7803 //
7804 // This function borrows a lot from Clang's emitCombinedEntry function
7805 // inside of CGOpenMPRuntime.cpp
7806 static void mapParentWithMembers(
7807  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
7808  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder &ompBuilder, DataLayout &dl, MapInfosTy &combinedInfo,
7809  MapInfoData &mapData, uint64_t mapDataIndex,
7810  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags memberOfFlag,
7811  TargetDirectiveEnumTy targetDirective) {
7812  using MapFlags = llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags;
7813  assert(!ompBuilder.Config.isTargetDevice() &&
7814  "function only supported for host device codegen");
7815  auto parentClause =
7816  llvm::cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapData.MapClause[mapDataIndex]);
7817  auto *parentMapper = mapData.Mappers[mapDataIndex];
7818 
7819  // Map the first segment of the parent. If a user-defined mapper is attached,
7820  // include the parent's to/from-style bits (and common modifiers) in this
7821  // base entry so the mapper receives correct copy semantics via its 'type'
7822  // parameter. Also keep TARGET_PARAM when required for kernel arguments.
7823  MapFlags baseFlag = (targetDirective == TargetDirectiveEnumTy::Target &&
7824  !mapData.IsDeclareTarget[mapDataIndex])
7825  ? MapFlags::OMP_MAP_TARGET_PARAM
7826  : MapFlags::OMP_MAP_NONE;
7827 
7828  if (parentMapper) {
7829  // Preserve relevant map-type bits from the parent clause. These include
7830  // the copy direction (TO/FROM), as well as commonly used modifiers that
7831  // should be visible to the mapper for correct behaviour.
7832  MapFlags parentFlags = mapData.Types[mapDataIndex];
7833  MapFlags preserve = MapFlags::OMP_MAP_TO | MapFlags::OMP_MAP_FROM |
7834  MapFlags::OMP_MAP_ALWAYS | MapFlags::OMP_MAP_CLOSE |
7835  MapFlags::OMP_MAP_PRESENT |
7836  MapFlags::OMP_MAP_OMPX_HOLD |
7837  MapFlags::OMP_MAP_IMPLICIT;
7838  baseFlag |= (parentFlags & preserve);
7839  } else {
7840  MapFlags parentFlags = mapData.Types[mapDataIndex];
7841  MapFlags preserve =
7842  MapFlags::OMP_MAP_PRESENT | MapFlags::OMP_MAP_RETURN_PARAM;
7843  baseFlag |= (parentFlags & preserve);
7844  }
7845 
7846  combinedInfo.Types.emplace_back(baseFlag);
7847  // TODO: set HasAttachPtr from Flang for pointee-storage entries.
7848  combinedInfo.HasAttachPtr.emplace_back(false);
7849  combinedInfo.DevicePointers.emplace_back(
7850  mapData.DevicePointers[mapDataIndex]);
7851  // Only attach the mapper to the base entry when we are mapping the whole
7852  // parent. Combined/segment entries must not carry a mapper; otherwise the
7853  // mapper can be invoked with a partial size, which is undefined behaviour.
7854  combinedInfo.Mappers.emplace_back(
7855  parentMapper && !parentClause.getPartialMap() ? parentMapper : nullptr);
7856  combinedInfo.Names.emplace_back(LLVM::createMappingInformation(
7857  mapData.MapClause[mapDataIndex]->getLoc(), ompBuilder));
7858  combinedInfo.BasePointers.emplace_back(mapData.BasePointers[mapDataIndex]);
7859 
7860  // Calculate size of the parent object being mapped based on the
7861  // addresses at runtime, highAddr - lowAddr = size. This of course
7862  // doesn't factor in allocated data like pointers, hence the further
7863  // processing of members specified by users, or in the case of
7864  // Fortran pointers and allocatables, the mapping of the pointed to
7865  // data by the descriptor (which itself, is a structure containing
7866  // runtime information on the dynamically allocated data).
7867  llvm::Value *lowAddr, *highAddr;
7868  if (!parentClause.getPartialMap()) {
7869  lowAddr = builder.CreatePointerCast(mapData.Pointers[mapDataIndex],
7870  builder.getPtrTy());
7871  highAddr = builder.CreatePointerCast(
7872  builder.CreateConstGEP1_32(mapData.BaseType[mapDataIndex],
7873  mapData.Pointers[mapDataIndex], 1),
7874  builder.getPtrTy());
7875  combinedInfo.Pointers.emplace_back(mapData.Pointers[mapDataIndex]);
7876  } else {
7877  auto mapOp = dyn_cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapData.MapClause[mapDataIndex]);
7878  int firstMemberIdx = getMapDataMemberIdx(
7879  mapData, getFirstOrLastMappedMemberPtr(mapOp, true));
7880  lowAddr = builder.CreatePointerCast(mapData.BasePointers[firstMemberIdx],
7881  builder.getPtrTy());
7882 
7883  int lastMemberIdx = getMapDataMemberIdx(
7884  mapData, getFirstOrLastMappedMemberPtr(mapOp, false));
7885  auto lastMemberMapInfo =
7886  cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapData.MapClause[lastMemberIdx]);
7887 
7888  // NOTE: Currently, for RefPtee the BaseType is set to the varPtrPtr field,
7889  // which is the pointer datas type and not the member within the structure
7890  // that it's part of, so we have to make sure we use the member type in this
7891  // case when calculating the parents size offsets.
7892  // TODO: May be good to extend MapInfoData to support tracking of both
7893  // VarPtr/VarPtrPtr BaseType's to better distinguish what's being used more
7894  // consistently.
7895  bool isRefPteeMap = bitEnumContainsAll(lastMemberMapInfo.getMapType(),
7896  omp::ClauseMapFlags::ref_ptee) &&
7897  !bitEnumContainsAll(lastMemberMapInfo.getMapType(),
7898  omp::ClauseMapFlags::ref_ptr);
7899  llvm::Type *castType = mapData.BaseType[lastMemberIdx];
7900  if (isRefPteeMap)
7901  castType =
7902  moduleTranslation.convertType(lastMemberMapInfo.getVarPtrType());
7903  highAddr = builder.CreatePointerCast(
7904  builder.CreateGEP(castType, mapData.BasePointers[lastMemberIdx],
7905  builder.getInt64(1)),
7906  builder.getPtrTy());
7907  combinedInfo.Pointers.emplace_back(mapData.BasePointers[firstMemberIdx]);
7908  }
7909 
7910  llvm::Value *size = builder.CreateIntCast(
7911  builder.CreatePtrDiff(builder.getInt8Ty(), highAddr, lowAddr),
7912  builder.getInt64Ty(),
7913  /*isSigned=*/false);
7914  combinedInfo.Sizes.push_back(size);
7915 
7916  // This creates the initial MEMBER_OF mapping that consists of
7917  // the parent/top level container (same as above effectively, except
7918  // with a fixed initial compile time size and separate maptype which
7919  // indicates the true mape type (tofrom etc.). This parent mapping is
7920  // only relevant if the structure in its totality is being mapped,
7921  // otherwise the above suffices.
7922  if (!parentClause.getPartialMap()) {
7923  // TODO: This will need to be expanded to include the whole host of logic
7924  // for the map flags that Clang currently supports (e.g. it should do some
7925  // further case specific flag modifications). For the moment, it handles
7926  // what we support as expected.
7927  MapFlags mapFlag = mapData.Types[mapDataIndex];
7928  bool hasMapClose = (MapFlags(mapFlag) & MapFlags::OMP_MAP_CLOSE) ==
7929  MapFlags::OMP_MAP_CLOSE;
7930  ompBuilder.setCorrectMemberOfFlag(mapFlag, memberOfFlag);
7931 
7932  llvm::SmallVector<size_t> overlapIdxs;
7933  // Find all of the members that "overlap", i.e. occlude other members that
7934  // were mapped alongside the parent, e.g. member [0], occludes [0,1] and
7935  // [0,2], but not [1,0].
7936  getOverlappedMembers(overlapIdxs, parentClause);
7937 
7938  // When we only have one overlap we skip the case that tries to segment the
7939  // mapping as best it can without creating holes, as the calculation is more
7940  // likely to have more overhead than anything we gain from mapping a smaller
7941  // chunk of data. This can be seen in cases where we are mapping Fortran
7942  // descriptors which are a special case of record type mapping.
7943  //
7944  // The cases for close and update are unique edge cases where the segmenting
7945  // does not play well with the runtime currently.
7946  if (targetDirective == TargetDirectiveEnumTy::TargetUpdate || hasMapClose ||
7947  overlapIdxs.size() == 1) {
7948  combinedInfo.Types.emplace_back(mapFlag);
7949  // TODO: set HasAttachPtr from Flang for pointee-storage entries.
7950  combinedInfo.HasAttachPtr.emplace_back(false);
7951  combinedInfo.DevicePointers.emplace_back(
7952  mapData.DevicePointers[mapDataIndex]);
7953  combinedInfo.Names.emplace_back(LLVM::createMappingInformation(
7954  mapData.MapClause[mapDataIndex]->getLoc(), ompBuilder));
7955  combinedInfo.BasePointers.emplace_back(
7956  mapData.BasePointers[mapDataIndex]);
7957  combinedInfo.Pointers.emplace_back(mapData.Pointers[mapDataIndex]);
7958  combinedInfo.Sizes.emplace_back(mapData.Sizes[mapDataIndex]);
7959  combinedInfo.Mappers.emplace_back(nullptr);
7960  } else {
7961  // We need to make sure the overlapped members are sorted in order of
7962  // lowest address to highest address.
7963  sortMapIndices(overlapIdxs, parentClause);
7964 
7965  lowAddr = builder.CreatePointerCast(mapData.Pointers[mapDataIndex],
7966  builder.getPtrTy());
7967  highAddr = builder.CreatePointerCast(
7968  builder.CreateConstGEP1_32(mapData.BaseType[mapDataIndex],
7969  mapData.Pointers[mapDataIndex], 1),
7970  builder.getPtrTy());
7971 
7972  // Currently, the return parameter should be the over-riding parent in
7973  // cases where we have a return parameter that is echoed to all members,
7974  // the main case of this currently is with fortran descriptors. It may
7975  // need more finessing for C/C++ in the future or descriptors that are
7976  // members of derived types.
7977  mapFlag &= ~llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_RETURN_PARAM;
7978 
7979  // TODO: We may want to skip arrays/array sections in this as Clang does.
7980  // It appears to be an optimisation rather than a necessity though,
7981  // but this requires further investigation. However, we would have to make
7982  // sure to not exclude maps with bounds that ARE pointers, as these are
7983  // processed as separate components, i.e. pointer + data.
7984  for (auto v : overlapIdxs) {
7985  auto mapDataOverlapIdx = getMapDataMemberIdx(
7986  mapData,
7987  cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(parentClause.getMembers()[v].getDefiningOp()));
7988  auto isPtrMap = checkIfPointerMap(
7989  llvm::cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapData.MapClause[mapDataOverlapIdx]));
7990  combinedInfo.Types.emplace_back(mapFlag);
7991  // TODO: set HasAttachPtr from Flang for pointee-storage entries.
7992  combinedInfo.HasAttachPtr.emplace_back(false);
7993  combinedInfo.DevicePointers.emplace_back(
7994  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::None);
7995  combinedInfo.Names.emplace_back(LLVM::createMappingInformation(
7996  mapData.MapClause[mapDataIndex]->getLoc(), ompBuilder));
7997  combinedInfo.BasePointers.emplace_back(
7998  mapData.BasePointers[mapDataIndex]);
7999  combinedInfo.Mappers.emplace_back(nullptr);
8000  combinedInfo.Pointers.emplace_back(lowAddr);
8001  auto sizeCalc = builder.CreateIntCast(
8002  builder.CreatePtrDiff(builder.getInt8Ty(),
8003  mapData.OriginalValue[mapDataOverlapIdx],
8004  lowAddr),
8005  builder.getInt64Ty(), /*isSigned=*/true);
8006  // In certain cases, we'll generate a size of 0 if we're not careful
8007  // (e.g. if lowAddr happens to be the first member), which isn't
8008  // correct, even if the runtimes is sometimes fine with it so, in these
8009  // scenarios we select the types size instead.
8010  auto sizeSel = builder.CreateSelect(
8011  builder.CreateICmpNE(builder.getInt64(0), sizeCalc), sizeCalc,
8012  isPtrMap ? llvm::ConstantExpr::getSizeOf(builder.getPtrTy())
8013  : mapData.Sizes[mapDataOverlapIdx]);
8014  combinedInfo.Sizes.emplace_back(sizeSel);
8015  lowAddr = builder.CreateConstGEP1_32(
8016  isPtrMap ? builder.getPtrTy() : mapData.BaseType[mapDataOverlapIdx],
8017  mapData.BasePointers[mapDataOverlapIdx], 1);
8018  }
8019 
8020  combinedInfo.Types.emplace_back(mapFlag);
8021  // TODO: set HasAttachPtr from Flang for pointee-storage entries.
8022  combinedInfo.HasAttachPtr.emplace_back(false);
8023  combinedInfo.DevicePointers.emplace_back(
8024  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::None);
8025  combinedInfo.Names.emplace_back(LLVM::createMappingInformation(
8026  mapData.MapClause[mapDataIndex]->getLoc(), ompBuilder));
8027  combinedInfo.BasePointers.emplace_back(
8028  mapData.BasePointers[mapDataIndex]);
8029  combinedInfo.Mappers.emplace_back(nullptr);
8030  combinedInfo.Pointers.emplace_back(lowAddr);
8031  combinedInfo.Sizes.emplace_back(builder.CreateIntCast(
8032  builder.CreatePtrDiff(builder.getInt8Ty(), highAddr, lowAddr),
8033  builder.getInt64Ty(), true));
8034  }
8035  }
8036 }
8037 
8038 static void processMapWithMembersOf(LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation,
8039  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
8040  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder &ompBuilder,
8041  DataLayout &dl, MapInfosTy &combinedInfo,
8042  MapInfoData &mapData, uint64_t mapDataIndex,
8043  TargetDirectiveEnumTy targetDirective) {
8044  assert(!ompBuilder.Config.isTargetDevice() &&
8045  "function only supported for host device codegen");
8046 
8047  auto parentClause =
8048  llvm::cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapData.MapClause[mapDataIndex]);
8049 
8050  // If we have a partial map (no parent referenced in the map clauses of the
8051  // directive, only members) and only a single member, we do not need to bind
8052  // the map of the member to the parent, we can pass the member separately.
8053  if (parentClause.getMembers().size() == 1 && parentClause.getPartialMap()) {
8054  auto memberClause = llvm::cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(
8055  parentClause.getMembers()[0].getDefiningOp());
8056  int memberDataIdx = getMapDataMemberIdx(mapData, memberClause);
8057  // Note: Clang treats arrays with explicit bounds that fall into this
8058  // category as a parent with map case, however, it seems this isn't a
8059  // requirement, and processing them as an individual map is fine. So,
8060  // we will handle them as individual maps for the moment, as it's
8061  // difficult for us to check this as we always require bounds to be
8062  // specified currently and it's also marginally more optimal (single
8063  // map rather than two). The difference may come from the fact that
8064  // Clang maps array without bounds as pointers (which we do not
8065  // currently do), whereas we treat them as arrays in all cases
8066  // currently.
8067  processIndividualMap(
8068  builder, ompBuilder, mapData, memberDataIdx, combinedInfo,
8069  targetDirective,
8070  /*MemberOfFlag=*/llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_NONE,
8071  /*isTargetParam=*/true, mapDataIndex);
8072  return;
8073  }
8074 
8075  auto collectMapInfoIdxs =
8076  [&](llvm::SmallVectorImpl<int64_t> &mapsAndInfoIdx) {
8077  auto parentClause =
8078  llvm::cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapData.MapClause[mapDataIndex]);
8079  mapsAndInfoIdx.push_back(getMapDataMemberIdx(mapData, parentClause));
8080  for (auto member : parentClause.getMembers())
8081  mapsAndInfoIdx.push_back(getMapDataMemberIdx(
8082  mapData, llvm::cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(member.getDefiningOp())));
8083  };
8084 
8085  llvm::SmallVector<int64_t> mapInfoIdx;
8086  collectMapInfoIdxs(mapInfoIdx);
8087 
8088  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags memberOfFlag =
8089  ompBuilder.getMemberOfFlag(combinedInfo.Types.size());
8090 
8091  // The first index is the parent map, the rest are its members. The parent
8092  // normally undergoes the standard parent-with-members mapping, contributing
8093  // the MEMBER_OF flag that binds each member to it. The one exception is a
8094  // privatizeable attach map (a privatized pointer/descriptor passed directly
8095  // as a kernel argument): here the parent is emitted as an individual map
8096  // instead, for the time being, as it's used only in pointer/allocatable to
8097  // array cases for the moment. This only ever applies to the parent, so it is
8098  // checked once here rather than inside the loop below.
8099  bool parentIsPrivatizeableAttach =
8100  isPrivatizeableAttachMap(parentClause.getMapType());
8101  for (auto [i, idx] : llvm::enumerate(mapInfoIdx)) {
8102  bool emitParentMap = i == 0 && !parentIsPrivatizeableAttach;
8103  if (emitParentMap) {
8104  mapParentWithMembers(moduleTranslation, builder, ompBuilder, dl,
8105  combinedInfo, mapData, idx, memberOfFlag,
8106  targetDirective);
8107  } else {
8108  processIndividualMap(
8109  builder, ompBuilder, mapData, idx, combinedInfo, targetDirective,
8110  parentIsPrivatizeableAttach
8111  ? llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_NONE
8112  : memberOfFlag,
8113  /*isTargetParam=*/false, mapDataIndex);
8114  }
8115  }
8116 }
8117 
8118 // This is a variation on Clang's GenerateOpenMPCapturedVars, which
8119 // generates different operation (e.g. load/store) combinations for
8120 // arguments to the kernel, based on map capture kinds which are then
8121 // utilised in the combinedInfo in place of the original Map value.
8122 static void
8123 createAlteredByCaptureMap(MapInfoData &mapData,
8124  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation,
8125  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder) {
8126  assert(!moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->Config.isTargetDevice() &&
8127  "function only supported for host device codegen");
8128  for (size_t i = 0; i < mapData.MapClause.size(); ++i) {
8129  auto mapOp = cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapData.MapClause[i]);
8130  bool isAttachMap =
8131  ((convertClauseMapFlags(mapOp.getMapType()) &
8132  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_ATTACH) ==
8133  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_ATTACH);
8134 
8135  // If it's declare target, skip it, it's handled separately. However, if
8136  // it's declare target, and an attach map, we want to calculate the exact
8137  // address offset so that we attach correctly.
8138  if (!mapData.IsDeclareTarget[i] ||
8139  (mapData.IsDeclareTarget[i] && isAttachMap)) {
8140  omp::VariableCaptureKind captureKind = mapOp.getMapCaptureType();
8141  bool isPtrTy = checkIfPointerMap(mapOp);
8142 
8143  // Currently handles array sectioning lowerbound case, but more
8144  // logic may be required in the future. Clang invokes EmitLValue,
8145  // which has specialised logic for special Clang types such as user
8146  // defines, so it is possible we will have to extend this for
8147  // structures or other complex types. As the general idea is that this
8148  // function mimics some of the logic from Clang that we require for
8149  // kernel argument passing from host -> device.
8150  switch (captureKind) {
8151  case omp::VariableCaptureKind::ByRef: {
8152  llvm::Value *newV = mapData.Pointers[i];
8153  std::vector<llvm::Value *> offsetIdx = calculateBoundsOffset(
8154  moduleTranslation, builder, mapData.BaseType[i]->isArrayTy(),
8155  mapOp.getBounds());
8156  if (isPtrTy)
8157  newV = builder.CreateLoad(builder.getPtrTy(), newV);
8158 
8159  if (!offsetIdx.empty())
8160  newV = builder.CreateInBoundsGEP(mapData.BaseType[i], newV, offsetIdx,
8161  "array_offset");
8162  mapData.Pointers[i] = newV;
8163  } break;
8164  case omp::VariableCaptureKind::ByCopy: {
8165  llvm::Type *type = mapData.BaseType[i];
8166  llvm::Value *newV;
8167  if (mapData.Pointers[i]->getType()->isPointerTy())
8168  newV = builder.CreateLoad(type, mapData.Pointers[i]);
8169  else
8170  newV = mapData.Pointers[i];
8171 
8172  if (!isPtrTy) {
8173  auto curInsert = builder.saveIP();
8174  llvm::DebugLoc DbgLoc = builder.getCurrentDebugLocation();
8175  builder.restoreIP(findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation));
8176  auto *memTempAlloc =
8177  builder.CreateAlloca(builder.getPtrTy(), nullptr, ".casted");
8178  builder.SetCurrentDebugLocation(DbgLoc);
8179  builder.restoreIP(curInsert);
8180 
8181  builder.CreateStore(newV, memTempAlloc);
8182  newV = builder.CreateLoad(builder.getPtrTy(), memTempAlloc);
8183  }
8184 
8185  mapData.Pointers[i] = newV;
8186  mapData.BasePointers[i] = newV;
8187  } break;
8188  case omp::VariableCaptureKind::This:
8189  case omp::VariableCaptureKind::VLAType:
8190  mapData.MapClause[i]->emitOpError("Unhandled capture kind");
8191  break;
8192  }
8193  }
8194  }
8195 }
8196 
8197 // Generate all map related information and fill the combinedInfo.
8198 static void genMapInfos(llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
8199  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation,
8200  DataLayout &dl, MapInfosTy &combinedInfo,
8201  MapInfoData &mapData,
8202  TargetDirectiveEnumTy targetDirective) {
8203  assert(!moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->Config.isTargetDevice() &&
8204  "function only supported for host device codegen");
8205  // We wish to modify some of the methods in which arguments are
8206  // passed based on their capture type by the target region, this can
8207  // involve generating new loads and stores, which changes the
8208  // MLIR value to LLVM value mapping, however, we only wish to do this
8209  // locally for the current function/target and also avoid altering
8210  // ModuleTranslation, so we remap the base pointer or pointer stored
8211  // in the map infos corresponding MapInfoData, which is later accessed
8212  // by genMapInfos and createTarget to help generate the kernel and
8213  // kernel arg structure. It primarily becomes relevant in cases like
8214  // bycopy, or byref range'd arrays. In the default case, we simply
8215  // pass thee pointer byref as both basePointer and pointer.
8216  createAlteredByCaptureMap(mapData, moduleTranslation, builder);
8217 
8218  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
8219 
8220  // We operate under the assumption that all vectors that are
8221  // required in MapInfoData are of equal lengths (either filled with
8222  // default constructed data or appropiate information) so we can
8223  // utilise the size from any component of MapInfoData, if we can't
8224  // something is missing from the initial MapInfoData construction.
8225  for (size_t i = 0; i < mapData.MapClause.size(); ++i) {
8226  if (mapData.IsAMember[i])
8227  continue;
8228 
8229  auto mapInfoOp = dyn_cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapData.MapClause[i]);
8230  if (!mapInfoOp.getMembers().empty()) {
8231  processMapWithMembersOf(moduleTranslation, builder, *ompBuilder, dl,
8232  combinedInfo, mapData, i, targetDirective);
8233  continue;
8234  }
8235 
8236  processIndividualMap(builder, *ompBuilder, mapData, i, combinedInfo,
8237  targetDirective);
8238  }
8239 }
8240 
8241 static llvm::Expected<llvm::Function *>
8242 emitUserDefinedMapper(Operation *declMapperOp, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
8243  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation,
8244  llvm::StringRef mapperFuncName,
8245  TargetDirectiveEnumTy targetDirective);
8246 
8247 static llvm::Expected<llvm::Function *>
8248 getOrCreateUserDefinedMapperFunc(Operation *op, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
8249  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation,
8250  TargetDirectiveEnumTy targetDirective) {
8251  assert(!moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->Config.isTargetDevice() &&
8252  "function only supported for host device codegen");
8253  auto declMapperOp = cast<omp::DeclareMapperOp>(op);
8254  std::string mapperFuncName =
8255  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->createPlatformSpecificName(
8256  {"omp_mapper", declMapperOp.getSymName()});
8257 
8258  if (auto *lookupFunc = moduleTranslation.lookupFunction(mapperFuncName))
8259  return lookupFunc;
8260 
8261  // Recursive types can cause re-entrant mapper emission. The mapper function
8262  // is created by OpenMPIRBuilder before the callbacks run, so it may already
8263  // exist in the LLVM module even though it is not yet registered in the
8264  // ModuleTranslation mapping table. Reuse and register it to break the
8265  // recursion.
8266  if (llvm::Function *existingFunc =
8267  moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule()->getFunction(mapperFuncName)) {
8268  moduleTranslation.mapFunction(mapperFuncName, existingFunc);
8269  return existingFunc;
8270  }
8271 
8272  return emitUserDefinedMapper(declMapperOp, builder, moduleTranslation,
8273  mapperFuncName, targetDirective);
8274 }
8275 
8276 static llvm::Expected<llvm::Function *>
8277 emitUserDefinedMapper(Operation *op, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
8278  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation,
8279  llvm::StringRef mapperFuncName,
8280  TargetDirectiveEnumTy targetDirective) {
8281  assert(!moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->Config.isTargetDevice() &&
8282  "function only supported for host device codegen");
8283  auto declMapperOp = cast<omp::DeclareMapperOp>(op);
8284  auto declMapperInfoOp = declMapperOp.getDeclareMapperInfo();
8285  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(*declMapperInfoOp)))
8286  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
8287 
8288  DataLayout dl = DataLayout(declMapperOp->getParentOfType<ModuleOp>());
8289  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
8290  llvm::Type *varType = moduleTranslation.convertType(declMapperOp.getType());
8291  SmallVector<Value> mapVars = declMapperInfoOp.getMapVars();
8292 
8293  using InsertPointTy = llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy;
8294 
8295  // Fill up the arrays with all the mapped variables.
8296  MapInfosTy combinedInfo;
8297  auto genMapInfoCB =
8298  [&](InsertPointTy codeGenIP, llvm::Value *ptrPHI,
8299  llvm::Value *unused2) -> llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::MapInfosOrErrorTy {
8300  builder.restoreIP(codeGenIP);
8301  moduleTranslation.mapValue(declMapperOp.getSymVal(), ptrPHI);
8302  moduleTranslation.mapBlock(&declMapperOp.getRegion().front(),
8303  builder.GetInsertBlock());
8304  if (failed(moduleTranslation.convertBlock(declMapperOp.getRegion().front(),
8305  /*ignoreArguments=*/true,
8306  builder)))
8307  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
8308  MapInfoData mapData;
8309  collectMapDataFromMapOperands(mapData, mapVars, moduleTranslation, dl,
8310  builder);
8311  genMapInfos(builder, moduleTranslation, dl, combinedInfo, mapData,
8312  targetDirective);
8313 
8314  // Drop the mapping that is no longer necessary so that the same region
8315  // can be processed multiple times.
8316  moduleTranslation.forgetMapping(declMapperOp.getRegion());
8317  return combinedInfo;
8318  };
8319 
8320  auto customMapperCB = [&](unsigned i) -> llvm::Expected<llvm::Function *> {
8321  if (!combinedInfo.Mappers[i])
8322  return nullptr;
8323  return getOrCreateUserDefinedMapperFunc(combinedInfo.Mappers[i], builder,
8324  moduleTranslation, targetDirective);
8325  };
8326 
8327  llvm::Expected<llvm::Function *> newFn = ompBuilder->emitUserDefinedMapper(
8328  genMapInfoCB, varType, mapperFuncName, customMapperCB,
8329  /*PreserveMemberOfFlags=*/true);
8330  if (!newFn)
8331  return newFn.takeError();
8332  if ([[maybe_unused]] llvm::Function *mappedFunc =
8333  moduleTranslation.lookupFunction(mapperFuncName)) {
8334  assert(mappedFunc == *newFn &&
8335  "mapper function mapping disagrees with emitted function");
8336  } else {
8337  moduleTranslation.mapFunction(mapperFuncName, *newFn);
8338  }
8339  return *newFn;
8340 }
8341 
8342 static LogicalResult
8343 convertOmpTargetData(Operation *op, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
8344  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
8345  llvm::Value *ifCond = nullptr;
8346  llvm::Value *deviceID = builder.getInt64(llvm::omp::OMP_DEVICEID_UNDEF);
8347  SmallVector<Value> mapVars;
8348  SmallVector<Value> useDevicePtrVars;
8349  SmallVector<Value> useDeviceAddrVars;
8350  llvm::omp::RuntimeFunction RTLFn;
8351  DataLayout DL = DataLayout(op->getParentOfType<ModuleOp>());
8352  TargetDirectiveEnumTy targetDirective = getTargetDirectiveEnumTyFromOp(op);
8353 
8354  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
8355  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::TargetDataInfo info(
8356  /*RequiresDevicePointerInfo=*/true,
8357  /*SeparateBeginEndCalls=*/true);
8358 
8359  if (ompBuilder->Config.isTargetDevice())
8360  return op->emitOpError() << "not allowed in a target device";
8361 
8362  bool isOffloadEntry = !ompBuilder->Config.TargetTriples.empty();
8363 
8364  auto getDeviceID = [&](mlir::Value dev) -> llvm::Value * {
8365  llvm::Value *v = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(dev);
8366  return builder.CreateIntCast(v, builder.getInt64Ty(), /*isSigned=*/true);
8367  };
8368 
8369  LogicalResult result =
8370  llvm::TypeSwitch<Operation *, LogicalResult>(op)
8371  .Case([&](omp::TargetDataOp dataOp) {
8372  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(*dataOp)))
8373  return failure();
8374 
8375  if (auto ifVar = dataOp.getIfExpr())
8376  ifCond = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(ifVar);
8377 
8378  if (mlir::Value devId = dataOp.getDevice())
8379  deviceID = getDeviceID(devId);
8380 
8381  mapVars = dataOp.getMapVars();
8382  useDevicePtrVars = dataOp.getUseDevicePtrVars();
8383  useDeviceAddrVars = dataOp.getUseDeviceAddrVars();
8384  return success();
8385  })
8386  .Case([&](omp::TargetEnterDataOp enterDataOp) -> LogicalResult {
8387  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(*enterDataOp)))
8388  return failure();
8389 
8390  if (auto ifVar = enterDataOp.getIfExpr())
8391  ifCond = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(ifVar);
8392 
8393  if (mlir::Value devId = enterDataOp.getDevice())
8394  deviceID = getDeviceID(devId);
8395 
8396  RTLFn =
8397  enterDataOp.getNowait()
8398  ? llvm::omp::OMPRTL___tgt_target_data_begin_nowait_mapper
8399  : llvm::omp::OMPRTL___tgt_target_data_begin_mapper;
8400  mapVars = enterDataOp.getMapVars();
8401  info.HasNoWait = enterDataOp.getNowait();
8402  return success();
8403  })
8404  .Case([&](omp::TargetExitDataOp exitDataOp) -> LogicalResult {
8405  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(*exitDataOp)))
8406  return failure();
8407 
8408  if (auto ifVar = exitDataOp.getIfExpr())
8409  ifCond = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(ifVar);
8410 
8411  if (mlir::Value devId = exitDataOp.getDevice())
8412  deviceID = getDeviceID(devId);
8413 
8414  RTLFn = exitDataOp.getNowait()
8415  ? llvm::omp::OMPRTL___tgt_target_data_end_nowait_mapper
8416  : llvm::omp::OMPRTL___tgt_target_data_end_mapper;
8417  mapVars = exitDataOp.getMapVars();
8418  info.HasNoWait = exitDataOp.getNowait();
8419  return success();
8420  })
8421  .Case([&](omp::TargetUpdateOp updateDataOp) -> LogicalResult {
8422  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(*updateDataOp)))
8423  return failure();
8424 
8425  if (auto ifVar = updateDataOp.getIfExpr())
8426  ifCond = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(ifVar);
8427 
8428  if (mlir::Value devId = updateDataOp.getDevice())
8429  deviceID = getDeviceID(devId);
8430 
8431  RTLFn =
8432  updateDataOp.getNowait()
8433  ? llvm::omp::OMPRTL___tgt_target_data_update_nowait_mapper
8434  : llvm::omp::OMPRTL___tgt_target_data_update_mapper;
8435  mapVars = updateDataOp.getMapVars();
8436  info.HasNoWait = updateDataOp.getNowait();
8437  return success();
8438  })
8439  .DefaultUnreachable("unexpected operation");
8440 
8441  if (failed(result))
8442  return failure();
8443  // Pretend we have IF(false) if we're not doing offload.
8444  if (!isOffloadEntry)
8445  ifCond = builder.getFalse();
8446 
8447  using InsertPointTy = llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy;
8448  MapInfoData mapData;
8449  collectMapDataFromMapOperands(mapData, mapVars, moduleTranslation, DL,
8450  builder, useDevicePtrVars, useDeviceAddrVars);
8451 
8452  // Fill up the arrays with all the mapped variables.
8453  MapInfosTy combinedInfo;
8454  auto genMapInfoCB = [&](InsertPointTy codeGenIP) -> MapInfosTy & {
8455  builder.restoreIP(codeGenIP);
8456  genMapInfos(builder, moduleTranslation, DL, combinedInfo, mapData,
8457  targetDirective);
8458  return combinedInfo;
8459  };
8460 
8461  // Define a lambda to apply mappings between use_device_addr and
8462  // use_device_ptr base pointers, and their associated block arguments.
8463  auto mapUseDevice =
8464  [&moduleTranslation](
8465  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy type,
8466  llvm::ArrayRef<BlockArgument> blockArgs,
8467  llvm::SmallVectorImpl<Value> &useDeviceVars, MapInfoData &mapInfoData,
8468  llvm::function_ref<llvm::Value *(llvm::Value *)> mapper = nullptr) {
8469  for (auto [arg, useDevVar] :
8470  llvm::zip_equal(blockArgs, useDeviceVars)) {
8471 
8472  auto getMapBasePtr = [](omp::MapInfoOp mapInfoOp) {
8473  return mapInfoOp.getVarPtrPtr() ? mapInfoOp.getVarPtrPtr()
8474  : mapInfoOp.getVarPtr();
8475  };
8476 
8477  auto useDevMap = cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(useDevVar.getDefiningOp());
8478  for (auto [mapClause, devicePointer, basePointer] : llvm::zip_equal(
8479  mapInfoData.MapClause, mapInfoData.DevicePointers,
8480  mapInfoData.BasePointers)) {
8481  auto mapOp = cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapClause);
8482  if (getMapBasePtr(mapOp) != getMapBasePtr(useDevMap) ||
8483  devicePointer != type)
8484  continue;
8485 
8486  if (llvm::Value *devPtrInfoMap =
8487  mapper ? mapper(basePointer) : basePointer) {
8488  moduleTranslation.mapValue(arg, devPtrInfoMap);
8489  break;
8490  }
8491  }
8492  }
8493  };
8494 
8495  using BodyGenTy = llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::BodyGenTy;
8496  auto bodyGenCB = [&](InsertPointTy codeGenIP, BodyGenTy bodyGenType)
8497  -> llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy {
8498  // We must always restoreIP regardless of doing anything the caller
8499  // does not restore it, leading to incorrect (no) branch generation.
8500  builder.restoreIP(codeGenIP);
8501  assert(isa<omp::TargetDataOp>(op) &&
8502  "BodyGen requested for non TargetDataOp");
8503  auto blockArgIface = cast<omp::BlockArgOpenMPOpInterface>(op);
8504  Region &region = cast<omp::TargetDataOp>(op).getRegion();
8505  switch (bodyGenType) {
8506  case BodyGenTy::Priv:
8507  // Check if any device ptr/addr info is available
8508  if (!info.DevicePtrInfoMap.empty()) {
8509  mapUseDevice(llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::Address,
8510  blockArgIface.getUseDeviceAddrBlockArgs(),
8511  useDeviceAddrVars, mapData,
8512  [&](llvm::Value *basePointer) -> llvm::Value * {
8513  if (!info.DevicePtrInfoMap[basePointer].second)
8514  return nullptr;
8515  return builder.CreateLoad(
8516  builder.getPtrTy(),
8517  info.DevicePtrInfoMap[basePointer].second);
8518  });
8519  mapUseDevice(llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::Pointer,
8520  blockArgIface.getUseDevicePtrBlockArgs(), useDevicePtrVars,
8521  mapData, [&](llvm::Value *basePointer) {
8522  return info.DevicePtrInfoMap[basePointer].second;
8523  });
8524 
8525  if (failed(inlineConvertOmpRegions(region, "omp.data.region", builder,
8526  moduleTranslation)))
8527  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
8528  }
8529  break;
8530  case BodyGenTy::DupNoPriv:
8531  if (info.DevicePtrInfoMap.empty()) {
8532  // For host device we still need to do the mapping for codegen,
8533  // otherwise it may try to lookup a missing value.
8534  mapUseDevice(llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::Address,
8535  blockArgIface.getUseDeviceAddrBlockArgs(),
8536  useDeviceAddrVars, mapData);
8537  mapUseDevice(llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::Pointer,
8538  blockArgIface.getUseDevicePtrBlockArgs(), useDevicePtrVars,
8539  mapData);
8540  }
8541  break;
8542  case BodyGenTy::NoPriv:
8543  // If device info is available then region has already been generated
8544  if (info.DevicePtrInfoMap.empty()) {
8545  if (failed(inlineConvertOmpRegions(region, "omp.data.region", builder,
8546  moduleTranslation)))
8547  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
8548  }
8549  break;
8550  }
8551  return builder.saveIP();
8552  };
8553 
8554  auto customMapperCB =
8555  [&](unsigned int i) -> llvm::Expected<llvm::Function *> {
8556  if (!combinedInfo.Mappers[i])
8557  return nullptr;
8558  info.HasMapper = true;
8559  return getOrCreateUserDefinedMapperFunc(combinedInfo.Mappers[i], builder,
8560  moduleTranslation, targetDirective);
8561  };
8562 
8563  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
8564  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::BasicBlock *> deallocBlocks;
8565  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy allocaIP =
8566  findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation, &deallocBlocks);
8567  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterIP = [&]() {
8568  if (isa<omp::TargetDataOp>(op))
8569  return ompBuilder->createTargetData(ompLoc, allocaIP, builder.saveIP(),
8570  deallocBlocks, deviceID, ifCond, info,
8571  genMapInfoCB, customMapperCB,
8572  /*MapperFunc=*/nullptr, bodyGenCB,
8573  /*DeviceAddrCB=*/nullptr);
8574  return ompBuilder->createTargetData(ompLoc, allocaIP, builder.saveIP(),
8575  deallocBlocks, deviceID, ifCond, info,
8576  genMapInfoCB, customMapperCB, &RTLFn);
8577  }();
8578 
8579  if (failed(handleError(afterIP, *op)))
8580  return failure();
8581 
8582  builder.restoreIP(*afterIP);
8583  return success();
8584 }
8585 
8586 static LogicalResult
8587 convertOmpDistribute(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
8588  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
8589  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
8590  auto distributeOp = cast<omp::DistributeOp>(opInst);
8591  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(opInst)))
8592  return failure();
8593 
8594  /// Process teams op reduction in distribute if the reduction is contained in
8595  /// this specific distribute op.
8596  omp::TeamsOp teamsOp = opInst.getParentOfType<omp::TeamsOp>();
8597  bool doDistributeReduction =
8598  teamsOp && getDistributeCapturingTeamsReduction(teamsOp) == distributeOp;
8599 
8600  DenseMap<Value, llvm::Value *> reductionVariableMap;
8601  unsigned numReductionVars = teamsOp ? teamsOp.getNumReductionVars() : 0;
8602  SmallVector<omp::DeclareReductionOp> reductionDecls;
8603  SmallVector<llvm::Value *> privateReductionVariables(numReductionVars);
8604  llvm::ArrayRef<bool> isByRef;
8605 
8606  if (doDistributeReduction) {
8607  isByRef = getIsByRef(teamsOp.getReductionByref());
8608  assert(isByRef.size() == teamsOp.getNumReductionVars());
8609 
8610  collectReductionDecls(teamsOp, reductionDecls);
8611  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy allocaIP =
8612  findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation);
8613 
8614  MutableArrayRef<BlockArgument> reductionArgs =
8615  llvm::cast<omp::BlockArgOpenMPOpInterface>(*teamsOp)
8616  .getReductionBlockArgs();
8617 
8618  if (failed(allocAndInitializeReductionVars(
8619  teamsOp, reductionArgs, builder, moduleTranslation, allocaIP,
8620  reductionDecls, privateReductionVariables, reductionVariableMap,
8621  isByRef)))
8622  return failure();
8623  }
8624 
8625  using InsertPointTy = llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy;
8626  auto bodyGenCB =
8627  [&](InsertPointTy allocaIP, InsertPointTy codeGenIP,
8628  llvm::ArrayRef<llvm::BasicBlock *> deallocBlocks) -> llvm::Error {
8629  // Save the alloca insertion point on ModuleTranslation stack for use in
8630  // nested regions.
8631  LLVM::ModuleTranslation::SaveStack<OpenMPAllocStackFrame> frame(
8632  moduleTranslation, allocaIP, deallocBlocks);
8633 
8634  // DistributeOp has only one region associated with it.
8635  builder.restoreIP(codeGenIP);
8636  PrivateVarsInfo privVarsInfo(distributeOp);
8637 
8638  llvm::Expected<llvm::BasicBlock *> afterAllocas = allocatePrivateVars(
8639  distributeOp, builder, moduleTranslation, privVarsInfo, allocaIP);
8640  if (handleError(afterAllocas, opInst).failed())
8641  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
8642 
8643  if (handleError(initPrivateVars(builder, moduleTranslation, privVarsInfo),
8644  opInst)
8645  .failed())
8646  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
8647 
8648  if (failed(copyFirstPrivateVars(
8649  distributeOp, builder, moduleTranslation, privVarsInfo.mlirVars,
8650  privVarsInfo.llvmVars, privVarsInfo.privatizers,
8651  distributeOp.getPrivateNeedsBarrier())))
8652  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
8653 
8654  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
8655  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
8656  llvm::Expected<llvm::BasicBlock *> regionBlock =
8657  convertOmpOpRegions(distributeOp.getRegion(), "omp.distribute.region",
8658  builder, moduleTranslation);
8659  if (!regionBlock)
8660  return regionBlock.takeError();
8661  builder.SetInsertPoint(*regionBlock, (*regionBlock)->begin());
8662 
8663  // Skip applying a workshare loop below when translating 'distribute
8664  // parallel do' (it's been already handled by this point while translating
8665  // the nested omp.wsloop).
8666  if (!isa_and_present<omp::WsloopOp>(distributeOp.getNestedWrapper())) {
8667  // TODO: Add support for clauses which are valid for DISTRIBUTE
8668  // constructs. Static schedule is the default.
8669  bool hasDistSchedule = distributeOp.getDistScheduleStatic();
8670  auto schedule = hasDistSchedule ? omp::ClauseScheduleKind::Distribute
8671  : omp::ClauseScheduleKind::Static;
8672  // dist_schedule clauses are ordered - otherise this should be false
8673  bool isOrdered = hasDistSchedule;
8674  std::optional<omp::ScheduleModifier> scheduleMod;
8675  bool isSimd = false;
8676  llvm::omp::WorksharingLoopType workshareLoopType =
8677  llvm::omp::WorksharingLoopType::DistributeStaticLoop;
8678  bool loopNeedsBarrier = false;
8679  llvm::Value *chunk = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(
8680  distributeOp.getDistScheduleChunkSize());
8681  llvm::CanonicalLoopInfo *loopInfo =
8682  findCurrentLoopInfo(moduleTranslation);
8683  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy wsloopIP =
8684  ompBuilder->applyWorkshareLoop(
8685  ompLoc.DL, loopInfo, allocaIP, loopNeedsBarrier,
8686  convertToScheduleKind(schedule), chunk, isSimd,
8687  scheduleMod == omp::ScheduleModifier::monotonic,
8688  scheduleMod == omp::ScheduleModifier::nonmonotonic, isOrdered,
8689  workshareLoopType, false, hasDistSchedule, chunk);
8690 
8691  if (!wsloopIP)
8692  return wsloopIP.takeError();
8693  }
8694  if (failed(cleanupPrivateVars(distributeOp, builder, moduleTranslation,
8695  distributeOp.getLoc(), privVarsInfo)))
8696  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
8697 
8698  return llvm::Error::success();
8699  };
8700 
8701  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::BasicBlock *> deallocBlocks;
8702  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy allocaIP =
8703  findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation, &deallocBlocks);
8704  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
8705  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterIP =
8706  ompBuilder->createDistribute(ompLoc, allocaIP, deallocBlocks, bodyGenCB);
8707 
8708  if (failed(handleError(afterIP, opInst)))
8709  return failure();
8710 
8711  builder.restoreIP(*afterIP);
8712 
8713  if (doDistributeReduction) {
8714  // Process the reductions if required.
8715  return createReductionsAndCleanup(
8716  teamsOp, builder, moduleTranslation, allocaIP, reductionDecls,
8717  privateReductionVariables, isByRef,
8718  /*isNoWait*/ false, /*isTeamsReduction*/ true);
8719  }
8720  return success();
8721 }
