8723 /// Lowers the FlagsAttr which is applied to the module when offloading. This
8724 /// attribute contains OpenMP RTL globals that can be passed as flags to the
8725 /// frontend, otherwise they are set to default
8726 static LogicalResult
8727 convertFlagsAttr(Operation *op, mlir::omp::FlagsAttr attribute,
8728  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
8729  auto offloadMod = dyn_cast<omp::OffloadModuleInterface>(op);
8730  if (!offloadMod)
8731  return op->emitOpError() << "omp flags attached to non offload module op";
8732 
8733  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
8734 
8735  if (offloadMod.getIsTargetDevice())
8736  ompBuilder->M.addModuleFlag(llvm::Module::Max, "openmp-device",
8737  attribute.getOpenmpDeviceVersion());
8738 
8739  // The flags below are only intended to be emitted for GPU offload targets.
8740  if (!offloadMod.getIsGPU())
8741  return success();
8742 
8743  if (attribute.getNoGpuLib())
8744  return success();
8745 
8746  ompBuilder->createGlobalFlag(attribute.getDebugKind(),
8747  "__omp_rtl_debug_kind");
8748  ompBuilder->createGlobalFlag(attribute.getAssumeTeamsOversubscription(),
8749  "__omp_rtl_assume_teams_oversubscription");
8750  ompBuilder->createGlobalFlag(attribute.getAssumeThreadsOversubscription(),
8751  "__omp_rtl_assume_threads_oversubscription");
8752  ompBuilder->createGlobalFlag(attribute.getAssumeNoThreadState(),
8753  "__omp_rtl_assume_no_thread_state");
8754  ompBuilder->createGlobalFlag(attribute.getAssumeNoNestedParallelism(),
8755  "__omp_rtl_assume_no_nested_parallelism");
8756  return success();
8757 }

8759 static void getTargetEntryUniqueInfo(llvm::TargetRegionEntryInfo &targetInfo,
8760  omp::TargetOp targetOp,
8761  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder &ompBuilder,
8762  llvm::vfs::FileSystem &vfs,
8763  llvm::StringRef parentName = "") {
8764  auto fileLoc = targetOp.getLoc()->findInstanceOf<FileLineColLoc>();
8765  assert(fileLoc && "No file found from location");
8766 
8767  auto fileInfoCallBack = [&fileLoc]() {
8768  return std::pair<std::string, uint64_t>(
8769  llvm::StringRef(fileLoc.getFilename()), fileLoc.getLine());
8770  };
8771 
8772  targetInfo =
8773  ompBuilder.getTargetEntryUniqueInfo(fileInfoCallBack, vfs, parentName);
8774 }

8776 // The createDeviceArgumentAccessor function generates
8777 // instructions for retrieving (acessing) kernel
8778 // arguments inside of the device kernel for use by
8779 // the kernel. This enables different semantics such as
8780 // the creation of temporary copies of data allowing
8781 // semantics like read-only/no host write back kernel
8782 // arguments.
8783 //
8784 // This currently implements a very light version of Clang's
8785 // EmitParmDecl's handling of direct argument handling as well
8786 // as a portion of the argument access generation based on
8787 // capture types found at the end of emitOutlinedFunctionPrologue
8788 // in Clang. The indirect path handling of EmitParmDecl's may be
8789 // required for future work, but a direct 1-to-1 copy doesn't seem
8790 // possible as the logic is rather scattered throughout Clang's
8791 // lowering and perhaps we wish to deviate slightly.
8792 //
8793 // \param mapData - A container containing vectors of information
8794 // corresponding to the input argument, which should have a
8795 // corresponding entry in the MapInfoData containers
8796 // OrigialValue's.
8797 // \param arg - This is the generated kernel function argument that
8798 // corresponds to the passed in input argument. We generated different
8799 // accesses of this Argument, based on capture type and other Input
8800 // related information.
8801 // \param input - This is the host side value that will be passed to
8802 // the kernel i.e. the kernel input, we rewrite all uses of this within
8803 // the kernel (as we generate the kernel body based on the target's region
8804 // which maintians references to the original input) to the retVal argument
8805 // apon exit of this function inside of the OMPIRBuilder. This interlinks
8806 // the kernel argument to future uses of it in the function providing
8807 // appropriate "glue" instructions inbetween.
8808 // \param retVal - This is the value that all uses of input inside of the
8809 // kernel will be re-written to, the goal of this function is to generate
8810 // an appropriate location for the kernel argument to be accessed from,
8811 // e.g. ByRef will result in a temporary allocation location and then
8812 // a store of the kernel argument into this allocated memory which
8813 // will then be loaded from, ByCopy will use the allocated memory
8814 // directly.
8815 static llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPoint createDeviceArgumentAccessor(
8816  omp::TargetOp targetOp, MapInfoData &mapData, llvm::Argument &arg,
8817  llvm::Value *input, llvm::Value *&retVal, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
8818  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder &ompBuilder,
8819  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation,
8820  llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPoint allocaIP,
8821  llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPoint codeGenIP,
8822  llvm::ArrayRef<llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPoint> deallocIPs) {
8823  assert(ompBuilder.Config.isTargetDevice() &&
8824  "function only supported for target device codegen");
8825  builder.restoreIP(allocaIP);
8826 
8827  omp::VariableCaptureKind capture = omp::VariableCaptureKind::ByRef;
8828  LLVM::TypeToLLVMIRTranslator typeToLLVMIRTranslator(
8829  ompBuilder.M.getContext());
8830  unsigned alignmentValue = 0;
8831  BlockArgument mlirArg;
8832  SmallVector<std::pair<Value, BlockArgument>> blockArgsPairs;
8833  cast<omp::BlockArgOpenMPOpInterface>(*targetOp).getBlockArgsPairs(
8834  blockArgsPairs);
8835  // Find the associated MapInfoData entry for the current input
8836  for (size_t i = 0; i < mapData.MapClause.size(); ++i) {
8837  if (mapData.OriginalValue[i] == input) {
8838  auto mapOp = cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapData.MapClause[i]);
8839  capture = mapOp.getMapCaptureType();
8840  // Get information of alignment of mapped object
8841  alignmentValue = typeToLLVMIRTranslator.getPreferredAlignment(
8842  mapOp.getVarPtrType(), ompBuilder.M.getDataLayout());
8843 
8844  // Find the corresponding entry block argument, which can be associated to
8845  // a map, use_device* or has_device* clause.
8846  for (auto &[val, arg] : blockArgsPairs) {
8847  if (mapOp.getResult() == val) {
8848  mlirArg = arg;
8849  break;
8850  }
8851  }
8852  assert(mlirArg && "expected to find entry block argument for map clause");
8853  break;
8854  }
8855  }
8856 
8857  unsigned int allocaAS = ompBuilder.M.getDataLayout().getAllocaAddrSpace();
8858  unsigned int defaultAS =
8859  ompBuilder.M.getDataLayout().getProgramAddressSpace();
8860 
8861  // Create the allocation for the argument.
8862  llvm::Value *v = nullptr;
8863  if (omp::opInSharedDeviceContext(*targetOp) &&
8864  omp::allocaUsesRequireSharedMem(mlirArg)) {
8865  // Use the beginning of the codeGenIP rather than the usual allocation point
8866  // for shared memory allocations because otherwise these would be done prior
8867  // to the target initialization call. Also, the exit block (where the
8868  // deallocation is placed) is only executed if the initialization call
8869  // succeeds.
8870  builder.SetInsertPoint(codeGenIP.getBlock()->getFirstInsertionPt());
8871  v = ompBuilder.createOMPAllocShared(builder, arg.getType());
8872 
8873  // Create deallocations in all provided deallocation points and then restore
8874  // the insertion point to right after the new allocations.
8875  llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPointGuard guard(builder);
8876  for (auto deallocIP : deallocIPs) {
8877  builder.SetInsertPoint(deallocIP.getBlock(), deallocIP.getPoint());
8878  ompBuilder.createOMPFreeShared(builder, v, arg.getType());
8879  }
8880  } else {
8881  // Use the current point, which was previously set to allocaIP.
8882  v = builder.CreateAlloca(arg.getType(), allocaAS);
8883 
8884  if (allocaAS != defaultAS && arg.getType()->isPointerTy())
8885  v = builder.CreateAddrSpaceCast(v, builder.getPtrTy(defaultAS));
8886  }
8887 
8888  builder.CreateStore(&arg, v);
8889 
8890  builder.restoreIP(codeGenIP);
8891 
8892  switch (capture) {
8893  case omp::VariableCaptureKind::ByCopy: {
8894  retVal = v;
8895  break;
8896  }
8897  case omp::VariableCaptureKind::ByRef: {
8898  llvm::LoadInst *loadInst = builder.CreateAlignedLoad(
8899  v->getType(), v,
8900  ompBuilder.M.getDataLayout().getPrefTypeAlign(v->getType()));
8901  // CreateAlignedLoad function creates similar LLVM IR:
8902  // %res = load ptr, ptr %input, align 8
8903  // This LLVM IR does not contain information about alignment
8904  // of the loaded value. We need to add !align metadata to unblock
8905  // optimizer. The existence of the !align metadata on the instruction
8906  // tells the optimizer that the value loaded is known to be aligned to
8907  // a boundary specified by the integer value in the metadata node.
8908  // Example:
8909  // %res = load ptr, ptr %input, align 8, !align !align_md_node
8910  // ^ ^
8911  // | |
8912  // alignment of %input address |
8913  // |
8914  // alignment of %res object
8915  if (v->getType()->isPointerTy() && alignmentValue) {
8916  llvm::MDBuilder MDB(builder.getContext());
8917  loadInst->setMetadata(
8918  llvm::LLVMContext::MD_align,
8919  llvm::MDNode::get(builder.getContext(),
8920  MDB.createConstant(llvm::ConstantInt::get(
8921  llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(builder.getContext()),
8922  alignmentValue))));
8923  }
8924  retVal = loadInst;
8925 
8926  break;
8927  }
8928  case omp::VariableCaptureKind::This:
8929  case omp::VariableCaptureKind::VLAType:
8930  // TODO: Consider returning error to use standard reporting for
8931  // unimplemented features.
8932  assert(false && "Currently unsupported capture kind");
8933  break;
8934  }
8935 
8936  return builder.saveIP();
8937 }
8938 
8939 /// Follow uses of `host_eval`-defined block arguments of the given `omp.target`
8940 /// operation and populate output variables with their corresponding host value
8941 /// (i.e. operand evaluated outside of the target region), based on their uses
8942 /// inside of the target region.
8943 ///
8944 /// Loop bounds and steps are only optionally populated, if output vectors are
8945 /// provided.
8946 static void
8947 extractHostEvalClauses(omp::TargetOp targetOp, Value &numThreads,
8948  Value &numTeamsLower, Value &numTeamsUpper,
8949  Value &threadLimit,
8950  llvm::SmallVectorImpl<Value> *lowerBounds = nullptr,
8951  llvm::SmallVectorImpl<Value> *upperBounds = nullptr,
8952  llvm::SmallVectorImpl<Value> *steps = nullptr) {
8953  auto blockArgIface = llvm::cast<omp::BlockArgOpenMPOpInterface>(*targetOp);
8954  for (auto item : llvm::zip_equal(targetOp.getHostEvalVars(),
8955  blockArgIface.getHostEvalBlockArgs())) {
8956  Value hostEvalVar = std::get<0>(item), blockArg = std::get<1>(item);
8957 
8958  for (Operation *user : blockArg.getUsers()) {
8959  llvm::TypeSwitch<Operation *>(user)
8960  .Case([&](omp::TeamsOp teamsOp) {
8961  if (teamsOp.getNumTeamsLower() == blockArg)
8962  numTeamsLower = hostEvalVar;
8963  else if (llvm::is_contained(teamsOp.getNumTeamsUpperVars(),
8964  blockArg))
8965  numTeamsUpper = hostEvalVar;
8966  else if (!teamsOp.getThreadLimitVars().empty() &&
8967  teamsOp.getThreadLimit(0) == blockArg)
8968  threadLimit = hostEvalVar;
8969  else
8970  llvm_unreachable("unsupported host_eval use");
8971  })
8972  .Case([&](omp::ParallelOp parallelOp) {
8973  if (!parallelOp.getNumThreadsVars().empty() &&
8974  parallelOp.getNumThreads(0) == blockArg)
8975  numThreads = hostEvalVar;
8976  else
8977  llvm_unreachable("unsupported host_eval use");
8978  })
8979  .Case([&](omp::LoopNestOp loopOp) {
8980  auto processBounds =
8981  [&](OperandRange opBounds,
8982  llvm::SmallVectorImpl<Value> *outBounds) -> bool {
8983  bool found = false;
8984  for (auto [i, lb] : llvm::enumerate(opBounds)) {
8985  if (lb == blockArg) {
8986  found = true;
8987  if (outBounds)
8988  (*outBounds)[i] = hostEvalVar;
8989  }
8990  }
8991  return found;
8992  };
8993  bool found =
8994  processBounds(loopOp.getLoopLowerBounds(), lowerBounds);
8995  found = processBounds(loopOp.getLoopUpperBounds(), upperBounds) ||
8996  found;
8997  found = processBounds(loopOp.getLoopSteps(), steps) || found;
8998  (void)found;
8999  assert(found && "unsupported host_eval use");
9000  })
9001  .DefaultUnreachable("unsupported host_eval use");
9002  }
9003  }
9004 }
9005 
9006 /// If \p op is of the given type parameter, return it casted to that type.
9007 /// Otherwise, if its immediate parent operation (or some other higher-level
9008 /// parent, if \p immediateParent is false) is of that type, return that parent
9009 /// casted to the given type.
9010 ///
9011 /// If \p op is \c null or neither it or its parent(s) are of the specified
9012 /// type, return a \c null operation.
9013 template <typename OpTy>
9014 static OpTy castOrGetParentOfType(Operation *op, bool immediateParent = false) {
9015  if (!op)
9016  return OpTy();
9017 
9018  if (OpTy casted = dyn_cast<OpTy>(op))
9019  return casted;
9020 
9021  if (immediateParent)
9022  return dyn_cast_if_present<OpTy>(op->getParentOp());
9023 
9024  return op->getParentOfType<OpTy>();
9025 }
9026 
9027 /// If the given \p value is defined by an \c llvm.mlir.constant operation and
9028 /// it is of an integer type, return its value.
9029 static std::optional<int64_t> extractConstInteger(Value value) {
9030  if (!value)
9031  return std::nullopt;
9032 
9033  if (auto constOp = value.getDefiningOp<LLVM::ConstantOp>())
9034  if (auto constAttr = dyn_cast<IntegerAttr>(constOp.getValue()))
9035  return constAttr.getInt();
9036 
9037  return std::nullopt;
9038 }
9039 
9040 static uint64_t getTypeByteSize(mlir::Type type, const DataLayout &dl) {
9041  uint64_t sizeInBits = dl.getTypeSizeInBits(type);
9042  uint64_t sizeInBytes = sizeInBits / 8;
9043  return sizeInBytes;
9044 }
9045 
9046 template <typename OpTy>
9047 static uint64_t getReductionDataSize(OpTy &op) {
9048  if (op.getNumReductionVars() > 0) {
9049  SmallVector<omp::DeclareReductionOp> reductions;
9050  collectReductionDecls(op, reductions);
9051 
9052  llvm::SmallVector<mlir::Type> members;
9053  members.reserve(reductions.size());
9054  for (omp::DeclareReductionOp &red : reductions) {
9055  // For by-ref reductions, use the actual element type rather than the
9056  // pointer type so that the buffer size matches the access pattern in
9057  // the copy/reduce callbacks generated by OMPIRBuilder.
9058  if (red.getByrefElementType())
9059  members.push_back(*red.getByrefElementType());
9060  else
9061  members.push_back(red.getType());
9062  }
9063  Operation *opp = op.getOperation();
9064  auto structType = mlir::LLVM::LLVMStructType::getLiteral(
9065  opp->getContext(), members, /*isPacked=*/false);
9066  DataLayout dl = DataLayout(opp->getParentOfType<ModuleOp>());
9067  return getTypeByteSize(structType, dl);
9068  }
9069  return 0;
9070 }
9071 
9072 /// Populate default `MinTeams`, `MaxTeams` and `MaxThreads` to their default
9073 /// values as stated by the corresponding clauses, if constant.
9074 ///
9075 /// These default values must be set before the creation of the outlined LLVM
9076 /// function for the target region, so that they can be used to initialize the
9077 /// corresponding global `ConfigurationEnvironmentTy` structure.
9078 static void
9079 initTargetDefaultAttrs(omp::TargetOp targetOp, Operation *capturedOp,
9080  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::TargetKernelDefaultAttrs &attrs,
9081  bool isTargetDevice, bool isGPU) {
9082  // TODO: Handle constant 'if' clauses.
9083 
9084  Value numThreads, numTeamsLower, numTeamsUpper, threadLimit;
9085  if (!isTargetDevice) {
9086  extractHostEvalClauses(targetOp, numThreads, numTeamsLower, numTeamsUpper,
9087  threadLimit);
9088  } else {
9089  // In the target device, values for these clauses are not passed as
9090  // host_eval, but instead evaluated prior to entry to the region. This
9091  // ensures values are mapped and available inside of the target region.
9092  if (auto teamsOp = castOrGetParentOfType<omp::TeamsOp>(capturedOp)) {
9093  numTeamsLower = teamsOp.getNumTeamsLower();
9094  // Handle num_teams upper bounds (only first value for now)
9095  if (!teamsOp.getNumTeamsUpperVars().empty())
9096  numTeamsUpper = teamsOp.getNumTeams(0);
9097  if (!teamsOp.getThreadLimitVars().empty())
9098  threadLimit = teamsOp.getThreadLimit(0);
9099  }
9100 
9101  if (auto parallelOp = castOrGetParentOfType<omp::ParallelOp>(capturedOp)) {
9102  if (!parallelOp.getNumThreadsVars().empty())
9103  numThreads = parallelOp.getNumThreads(0);
9104  }
9105  }
9106 
9107  // Handle clauses impacting the number of teams.
9108 
9109  int32_t minTeamsVal = 1, maxTeamsVal = -1;
9110  if (castOrGetParentOfType<omp::TeamsOp>(capturedOp)) {
9111  // TODO: Use `hostNumTeamsLower` to initialize `minTeamsVal`. For now,
9112  // match clang and set min and max to the same value.
9113  if (numTeamsUpper) {
9114  if (auto val = extractConstInteger(numTeamsUpper))
9115  minTeamsVal = maxTeamsVal = *val;
9116  } else {
9117  minTeamsVal = maxTeamsVal = 0;
9118  }
9119  } else if (castOrGetParentOfType<omp::ParallelOp>(capturedOp,
9120  /*immediateParent=*/true) ||
9121  castOrGetParentOfType<omp::SimdOp>(capturedOp,
9122  /*immediateParent=*/true)) {
9123  minTeamsVal = maxTeamsVal = 1;
9124  } else {
9125  minTeamsVal = maxTeamsVal = -1;
9126  }
9127 
9128  // Handle clauses impacting the number of threads.
9129 
9130  auto setMaxValueFromClause = [](Value clauseValue, int32_t &result) {
9131  if (!clauseValue)
9132  return;
9133 
9134  if (auto val = extractConstInteger(clauseValue))
9135  result = *val;
9136 
9137  // Found an applicable clause, so it's not undefined. Mark as unknown
9138  // because it's not constant.
9139  if (result < 0)
9140  result = 0;
9141  };
9142 
9143  // Extract 'thread_limit' clause from 'target' and 'teams' directives.
9144  int32_t targetThreadLimitVal = -1, teamsThreadLimitVal = -1;
9145  if (!targetOp.getThreadLimitVars().empty())
9146  setMaxValueFromClause(targetOp.getThreadLimit(0), targetThreadLimitVal);
9147  setMaxValueFromClause(threadLimit, teamsThreadLimitVal);
9148 
9149  // Extract 'max_threads' clause from 'parallel' or set to 1 if it's SIMD.
9150  int32_t maxThreadsVal = -1;
9151  if (castOrGetParentOfType<omp::ParallelOp>(capturedOp))
9152  setMaxValueFromClause(numThreads, maxThreadsVal);
9153  else if (castOrGetParentOfType<omp::SimdOp>(capturedOp,
9154  /*immediateParent=*/true))
9155  maxThreadsVal = 1;
9156 
9157  // For max values, < 0 means unset, == 0 means set but unknown. Select the
9158  // minimum value between 'max_threads' and 'thread_limit' clauses that were
9159  // set.
9160  int32_t combinedMaxThreadsVal = targetThreadLimitVal;
9161  if (combinedMaxThreadsVal < 0 ||
9162  (teamsThreadLimitVal >= 0 && teamsThreadLimitVal < combinedMaxThreadsVal))
9163  combinedMaxThreadsVal = teamsThreadLimitVal;
9164 
9165  if (combinedMaxThreadsVal < 0 ||
9166  (maxThreadsVal >= 0 && maxThreadsVal < combinedMaxThreadsVal))
9167  combinedMaxThreadsVal = maxThreadsVal;
9168 
9169  int32_t reductionDataSize = 0;
9170  if (isGPU && capturedOp) {
9171  if (auto teamsOp = castOrGetParentOfType<omp::TeamsOp>(capturedOp))
9172  reductionDataSize = getReductionDataSize(teamsOp);
9173  }
9174 
9175  // Update kernel bounds structure for the `OpenMPIRBuilder` to use.
9176  // Use the kernel_type attribute set by the frontend instead of analyzing IR.
9177  omp::TargetExecMode execMode = targetOp.getKernelType();
9178  switch (execMode) {
9179  case omp::TargetExecMode::bare:
9180  attrs.ExecFlags = llvm::omp::OMP_TGT_EXEC_MODE_BARE;
9181  break;
9182  case omp::TargetExecMode::generic:
9183  attrs.ExecFlags = llvm::omp::OMP_TGT_EXEC_MODE_GENERIC;
9184  break;
9185  case omp::TargetExecMode::spmd:
9186  attrs.ExecFlags = llvm::omp::OMP_TGT_EXEC_MODE_SPMD;
9187  break;
9188  case omp::TargetExecMode::spmd_no_loop:
9189  attrs.ExecFlags = llvm::omp::OMP_TGT_EXEC_MODE_SPMD_NO_LOOP;
9190  break;
9191  }
9192  attrs.MinTeams.front() = minTeamsVal;
9193  attrs.MaxTeams.front() = maxTeamsVal;
9194  attrs.MinThreads.front() = 1;
9195  attrs.MaxThreads.front() = combinedMaxThreadsVal;
9196  attrs.ReductionDataSize = reductionDataSize;
9197 }
9198 
9199 /// Gather LLVM runtime values for all clauses evaluated in the host that are
9200 /// passed to the kernel invocation.
9201 ///
9202 /// This function must be called only when compiling for the host. Also, it will
9203 /// only provide correct results if it's called after the body of \c targetOp
9204 /// has been fully generated.
9205 static void
9206 initTargetRuntimeAttrs(llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
9207  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation,
9208  omp::TargetOp targetOp, Operation *capturedOp,
9209  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::TargetKernelRuntimeAttrs &attrs) {
9210  omp::LoopNestOp loopOp = castOrGetParentOfType<omp::LoopNestOp>(capturedOp);
9211  unsigned numLoops = loopOp ? loopOp.getNumLoops() : 0;
9212 
9213  Value numThreads, numTeamsLower, numTeamsUpper, teamsThreadLimit;
9214  llvm::SmallVector<Value> lowerBounds(numLoops), upperBounds(numLoops),
9215  steps(numLoops);
9216  extractHostEvalClauses(targetOp, numThreads, numTeamsLower, numTeamsUpper,
9217  teamsThreadLimit, &lowerBounds, &upperBounds, &steps);
9218 
9219  // TODO: Handle constant 'if' clauses.
9220  if (!targetOp.getThreadLimitVars().empty()) {
9221  Value targetThreadLimit = targetOp.getThreadLimit(0);
9222  attrs.TargetThreadLimit.front() =
9223  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(targetThreadLimit);
9224  }
9225 
9226  // The __kmpc_push_num_teams_51 function expects int32 as the arguments. So,
9227  // truncate or sign extend lower and upper num_teams bounds as well as
9228  // thread_limit to match int32 ABI requirements for the OpenMP runtime.
9229  if (numTeamsLower)
9230  attrs.MinTeams.front() = builder.CreateSExtOrTrunc(
9231  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(numTeamsLower), builder.getInt32Ty());
9232 
9233  if (numTeamsUpper)
9234  attrs.MaxTeams.front() = builder.CreateSExtOrTrunc(
9235  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(numTeamsUpper), builder.getInt32Ty());
9236 
9237  if (teamsThreadLimit)
9238  attrs.TeamsThreadLimit.front() = builder.CreateSExtOrTrunc(
9239  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(teamsThreadLimit), builder.getInt32Ty());
9240 
9241  if (numThreads)
9242  attrs.MaxThreads.front() = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(numThreads);
9243 
9244  if (targetOp.hasHostEvalTripCount()) {
9245  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
9246  attrs.LoopTripCount = nullptr;
9247 
9248  // To calculate the trip count, we multiply together the trip counts of
9249  // every collapsed canonical loop. We don't need to create the loop nests
9250  // here, since we're only interested in the trip count.
9251  for (auto [loopLower, loopUpper, loopStep] :
9252  llvm::zip_equal(lowerBounds, upperBounds, steps)) {
9253  llvm::Value *lowerBound = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(loopLower);
9254  llvm::Value *upperBound = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(loopUpper);
9255  llvm::Value *step = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(loopStep);
9256 
9257  if (!lowerBound || !upperBound || !step) {
9258  attrs.LoopTripCount = nullptr;
9259  break;
9260  }
9261 
9262  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription loc(builder);
9263  llvm::Value *tripCount = ompBuilder->calculateCanonicalLoopTripCount(
9264  loc, lowerBound, upperBound, step, /*IsSigned=*/true,
9265  loopOp.getLoopInclusive());
9266 
9267  if (!attrs.LoopTripCount) {
9268  attrs.LoopTripCount = tripCount;
9269  continue;
9270  }
9271 
9272  // TODO: Enable UndefinedSanitizer to diagnose an overflow here.
9273  attrs.LoopTripCount = builder.CreateMul(attrs.LoopTripCount, tripCount,
9274  {}, /*HasNUW=*/true);
9275  }
9276  }
9277 
9278  attrs.DeviceID = builder.getInt64(llvm::omp::OMP_DEVICEID_UNDEF);
9279  if (mlir::Value devId = targetOp.getDevice()) {
9280  attrs.DeviceID = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(devId);
9281  attrs.DeviceID =
9282  builder.CreateSExtOrTrunc(attrs.DeviceID, builder.getInt64Ty());
9283  }
9284 }
9285 
9286 static llvm::omp::OMPDynGroupprivateFallbackType
9287 getDynGroupprivateFallbackType(omp::FallbackModifierAttr fallbackAttr) {
9288  omp::FallbackModifier fb = fallbackAttr ? fallbackAttr.getValue()
9289  : omp::FallbackModifier::default_mem;
9290  switch (fb) {
9291  case omp::FallbackModifier::abort:
9292  return llvm::omp::OMPDynGroupprivateFallbackType::Abort;
9293  case omp::FallbackModifier::null:
9294  return llvm::omp::OMPDynGroupprivateFallbackType::Null;
9295  case omp::FallbackModifier::default_mem:
9296  return llvm::omp::OMPDynGroupprivateFallbackType::DefaultMem;
9297  }
9298 
9299  llvm_unreachable("unexpected dyn_groupprivate fallback type");
9300 }
9301 
9302 static LogicalResult
9303 convertOmpTarget(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
9304  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
9305  auto targetOp = cast<omp::TargetOp>(opInst);
9306 
9307  // The current debug location already has the DISubprogram for the outlined
9308  // function that will be created for the target op. We save it here so that
9309  // we can set it on the outlined function.
9310  llvm::DebugLoc outlinedFnLoc = builder.getCurrentDebugLocation();
9311  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(opInst)))
9312  return failure();
9313 
9314  // During the handling of target op, we will generate instructions in the
9315  // parent function like call to the oulined function or branch to a new
9316  // BasicBlock. We set the debug location here to parent function so that those
9317  // get the correct debug locations. For outlined functions, the normal MLIR op
9318  // conversion will automatically pick the correct location.
9319  llvm::BasicBlock *parentBB = builder.GetInsertBlock();
9320  assert(parentBB && "No insert block is set for the builder");
9321  llvm::Function *parentLLVMFn = parentBB->getParent();
9322  assert(parentLLVMFn && "Parent Function must be valid");
9323  if (llvm::DISubprogram *SP = parentLLVMFn->getSubprogram())
9324  builder.SetCurrentDebugLocation(llvm::DILocation::get(
9325  parentLLVMFn->getContext(), outlinedFnLoc.getLine(),
9326  outlinedFnLoc.getCol(), SP, outlinedFnLoc.getInlinedAt()));
9327 
9328  // OMPIRBuilder emits runtime calls into the outlined function before bodyCB
9329  // below gets a chance to attach the subprogram to it, so it needs the
9330  // outlined function's location handed to it separately. Only pass it under
9331  // the same condition that decides whether the subprogram is attached at all:
9332  // a location may not be attached to an instruction in a function that has no
9333  // subprogram.
9334  llvm::DebugLoc outlinedFnDbgLoc;
9335  if (outlinedFnLoc && parentLLVMFn->getSubprogram())
9336  outlinedFnDbgLoc = outlinedFnLoc;
9337 
9338  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
9339  bool isTargetDevice = ompBuilder->Config.isTargetDevice();
9340  bool isGPU = ompBuilder->Config.isGPU();
9341 
9342  auto parentFn = opInst.getParentOfType<LLVM::LLVMFuncOp>();
9343  auto argIface = cast<omp::BlockArgOpenMPOpInterface>(opInst);
9344  auto &targetRegion = targetOp.getRegion();
9345  // Holds the private vars that have been mapped along with the block
9346  // argument that corresponds to the MapInfoOp corresponding to the private
9347  // var in question. So, for instance:
9348  //
9349  // %10 = omp.map.info var_ptr(%6#0 : !fir.ref<!fir.box<!fir.heap<i32>>>, ..)
9350  // omp.target map_entries(%10 -> %arg0) private(@box.privatizer %6#0-> %arg1)
9351  //
9352  // Then, %10 has been created so that the descriptor can be used by the
9353  // privatizer @box.privatizer on the device side. Here we'd record {%6#0,
9354  // %arg0} in the mappedPrivateVars map.
9355  llvm::DenseMap<Value, Value> mappedPrivateVars;
9356  DataLayout dl = DataLayout(opInst.getParentOfType<ModuleOp>());
9357  SmallVector<Value> mapVars = targetOp.getMapVars();
9358  SmallVector<Value> hdaVars = targetOp.getHasDeviceAddrVars();
9359  ArrayRef<BlockArgument> mapBlockArgs = argIface.getMapBlockArgs();
9360  ArrayRef<BlockArgument> hdaBlockArgs = argIface.getHasDeviceAddrBlockArgs();
9361  llvm::Function *llvmOutlinedFn = nullptr;
9362  TargetDirectiveEnumTy targetDirective =
9363  getTargetDirectiveEnumTyFromOp(&opInst);
9364 
9365  // TODO: It can also be false if a compile-time constant `false` IF clause is
9366  // specified.
9367  bool isOffloadEntry =
9368  isTargetDevice || !ompBuilder->Config.TargetTriples.empty();
9369 
9370  // Resolve in_reduction clauses on omp.target for the host. From the target
9371  // device's perspective an in_reduction list item behaves as a regular
9372  // map(tofrom) variable, so no special handling is needed there; only the
9373  // host redirects the mapped value to the per-task reduction-private storage
9374  // returned by __kmpc_task_reduction_get_th_data (emitted inside the
9375  // to-be-outlined target task body). This applies to both offloading and
9376  // non-offloading host modules.
9377  //
9378  // The target body has no dedicated in_reduction block argument: each
9379  // in_reduction variable is accessed through its map_entries block argument.
9380  // So each in_reduction variable must also be captured by a matching
9381  // map_entries entry (guaranteed by the verifier); without one the outlined
9382  // body would reference a value defined in the host function. Record, for each
9383  // in_reduction variable, the position of that map entry so the corresponding
9384  // map block argument can be redirected inside the body. The in_reduction
9385  // operand itself is used as the `orig` argument of the runtime lookup.
9386  SmallVector<llvm::Value *> inRedOrigPtrs;
9387  SmallVector<unsigned> inRedMapArgIdx;
9388  if (!targetOp.getInReductionVars().empty() && !isTargetDevice) {
9389  inRedOrigPtrs.reserve(targetOp.getInReductionVars().size());
9390  inRedMapArgIdx.reserve(targetOp.getInReductionVars().size());
9391  for (Value v : targetOp.getInReductionVars()) {
9392  // Select the map_entries entry that captures this in_reduction operand.
9393  // The verifier guarantees at least one match exists; more than one
9394  // matching entry is a lowering ambiguity (the redirect cannot pick which
9395  // map argument to rebind).
9396  std::optional<unsigned> matchIdx;
9397  for (auto [idx, mapV] : llvm::enumerate(targetOp.getMapVars())) {
9398  auto mapInfo = mapV.getDefiningOp<omp::MapInfoOp>();
9399  if (v != mapInfo.getVarPtr())
9400  continue;
9401  if (matchIdx)
9402  return targetOp.emitError()
9403  << "in_reduction variable on omp.target has multiple matching "
9404  "map_entries entries; the redirect target is ambiguous";
9405  matchIdx = idx;
9406  }
9407  // The verifier requires a capturing map entry for every in_reduction
9408  // operand, so a match must exist here.
9409  assert(matchIdx &&
9410  "TargetOp verifier guarantees a matching map_entries entry for "
9411  "each in_reduction variable");
9412  inRedMapArgIdx.push_back(*matchIdx);
9413  // The runtime `orig` pointer is the in_reduction operand itself, the
9414  // reduction variable the enclosing taskgroup registered.
9415  inRedOrigPtrs.push_back(moduleTranslation.lookupValue(v));
9416  }
9417  }
9418 
9419  // For some private variables, the MapsForPrivatizedVariablesPass
9420  // creates MapInfoOp instances. Go through the private variables and
9421  // the mapped variables so that during codegeneration we are able
9422  // to quickly look up the corresponding map variable, if any for each
9423  // private variable.
9424  if (!targetOp.getPrivateVars().empty() && !targetOp.getMapVars().empty()) {
9425  OperandRange privateVars = targetOp.getPrivateVars();
9426  std::optional<ArrayAttr> privateSyms = targetOp.getPrivateSyms();
9427  std::optional<DenseI64ArrayAttr> privateMapIndices =
9428  targetOp.getPrivateMapsAttr();
9429 
9430  for (auto [privVarIdx, privVarSymPair] :
9431  llvm::enumerate(llvm::zip_equal(privateVars, *privateSyms))) {
9432  auto privVar = std::get<0>(privVarSymPair);
9433  auto privSym = std::get<1>(privVarSymPair);
9434 
9435  SymbolRefAttr privatizerName = llvm::cast<SymbolRefAttr>(privSym);
9436  omp::PrivateClauseOp privatizer =
9437  findPrivatizer(targetOp, privatizerName);
9438 
9439  if (!privatizer.needsMap())
9440  continue;
9441 
9442  mlir::Value mappedValue =
9443  targetOp.getMappedValueForPrivateVar(privVarIdx);
9444  assert(mappedValue && "Expected to find mapped value for a privatized "
9445  "variable that needs mapping");
9446 
9447  // The MapInfoOp defining the map var isn't really needed later.
9448  // So, we don't store it in any datastructure. Instead, we just
9449  // do some sanity checks on it right now.
9450  auto mapInfoOp = mappedValue.getDefiningOp<omp::MapInfoOp>();
9451  [[maybe_unused]] Type varType = mapInfoOp.getVarPtrType();
9452 
9453  // Check #1: Check that the type of the private variable matches
9454  // the type of the variable being mapped.
9455  if (!isa<LLVM::LLVMPointerType>(privVar.getType()))
9456  assert(
9457  varType == privVar.getType() &&
9458  "Type of private var doesn't match the type of the mapped value");
9459 
9460  // Ok, only 1 sanity check for now.
9461  // Record the block argument corresponding to this mapvar.
9462  mappedPrivateVars.insert(
9463  {privVar,
9464  targetRegion.getArgument(argIface.getMapBlockArgsStart() +
9465  (*privateMapIndices)[privVarIdx])});
9466  }
9467  }
9468 
9469  using InsertPointTy = llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy;
9470  auto bodyCB = [&](InsertPointTy allocaIP, InsertPointTy codeGenIP,
9471  ArrayRef<llvm::BasicBlock *> deallocBlocks)
9472  -> llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy {
9473  llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPointGuard guard(builder);
9474  builder.SetCurrentDebugLocation(llvm::DebugLoc());
9475  // Forward target-cpu and target-features function attributes from the
9476  // original function to the new outlined function.
9477  llvm::Function *llvmParentFn =
9478  moduleTranslation.lookupFunction(parentFn.getName());
9479  llvmOutlinedFn = codeGenIP.getBlock()->getParent();
9480  assert(llvmParentFn && llvmOutlinedFn &&
9481  "Both parent and outlined functions must exist at this point");
9482 
9483  if (outlinedFnLoc && llvmParentFn->getSubprogram())
9484  llvmOutlinedFn->setSubprogram(outlinedFnLoc->getScope()->getSubprogram());
9485 
9486  if (auto attr = llvmParentFn->getFnAttribute("target-cpu");
9487  attr.isStringAttribute())
9488  llvmOutlinedFn->addFnAttr(attr);
9489 
9490  if (auto attr = llvmParentFn->getFnAttribute("target-features");
9491  attr.isStringAttribute())
9492  llvmOutlinedFn->addFnAttr(attr);
9493 
9494  for (auto [idx, arg] : llvm::enumerate(mapBlockArgs)) {
9495  // in_reduction list items on omp.target are accessed through their
9496  // map_entries block argument, which is redirected below to the per-task
9497  // reduction-private storage returned by the runtime. Skip the default
9498  // host-value mapping for those block arguments so the write-once
9499  // mapValue mapping is free to be set to the private pointer.
9500  if (llvm::is_contained(inRedMapArgIdx, idx))
9501  continue;
9502  auto mapInfoOp = cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapVars[idx].getDefiningOp());
9503  llvm::Value *mapOpValue =
9504  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(mapInfoOp.getVarPtr());
9505  moduleTranslation.mapValue(arg, mapOpValue);
9506  }
9507  for (auto [arg, mapOp] : llvm::zip_equal(hdaBlockArgs, hdaVars)) {
9508  auto mapInfoOp = cast<omp::MapInfoOp>(mapOp.getDefiningOp());
9509  llvm::Value *mapOpValue =
9510  moduleTranslation.lookupValue(mapInfoOp.getVarPtr());
9511  moduleTranslation.mapValue(arg, mapOpValue);
9512  }
9513 
9514  // Do privatization after moduleTranslation has already recorded
9515  // mapped values.
9516  PrivateVarsInfo privateVarsInfo(targetOp);
9517 
9518  llvm::Expected<llvm::BasicBlock *> afterAllocas =
9519  allocatePrivateVars(targetOp, builder, moduleTranslation,
9520  privateVarsInfo, allocaIP, &mappedPrivateVars);
9521 
9522  if (failed(handleError(afterAllocas, *targetOp)))
9523  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
9524 
9525  builder.restoreIP(codeGenIP);
9526  if (handleError(initPrivateVars(builder, moduleTranslation, privateVarsInfo,
9527  &mappedPrivateVars),
9528  *targetOp)
9529  .failed())
9530  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
9531 
9532  if (failed(copyFirstPrivateVars(
9533  targetOp, builder, moduleTranslation, privateVarsInfo.mlirVars,
9534  privateVarsInfo.llvmVars, privateVarsInfo.privatizers,
9535  targetOp.getPrivateNeedsBarrier(), &mappedPrivateVars)))
9536  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
9537 
9538  // The target body accesses each in_reduction variable through its
9539  // map_entries block argument. Redirect that block argument to the per-task
9540  // private storage returned by __kmpc_task_reduction_get_th_data so the body
9541  // accumulates into the reduction-private copy rather than the mapped
9542  // original. The lookup must run inside the target task body so the gtid
9543  // corresponds to the executing thread. The descriptor argument is NULL: the
9544  // runtime walks enclosing taskgroups to locate the matching task_reduction
9545  // registration for `origPtr`. Mirrors the in_reduction handling on
9546  // omp.taskloop.context.
9547  if (!inRedOrigPtrs.empty()) {
9548  // Collect, per item, the type the private pointer must have (the map
9549  // block argument's type), and, through the callback, rebind the map block
9550  // argument that stands in for each in_reduction list item to the per-task
9551  // reduction-private storage the runtime returns.
9552  SmallVector<llvm::Type *> inRedResultPtrTys;
9553  inRedResultPtrTys.reserve(inRedMapArgIdx.size());
9554  for (unsigned mapArgIdx : inRedMapArgIdx)
9555  inRedResultPtrTys.push_back(
9556  moduleTranslation.convertType(mapBlockArgs[mapArgIdx].getType()));
9557 
9558  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription bodyLoc(builder);
9559  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy redIP =
9560  ompBuilder->createTargetInReduction(
9561  bodyLoc, inRedOrigPtrs, inRedResultPtrTys,
9562  [&](unsigned idx, llvm::Value *priv) {
9563  moduleTranslation.mapValue(mapBlockArgs[inRedMapArgIdx[idx]],
9564  priv);
9565  });
9566  builder.restoreIP(redIP);
9567  }
9568 
9569  LLVM::ModuleTranslation::SaveStack<OpenMPAllocStackFrame> frame(
9570  moduleTranslation, allocaIP, deallocBlocks);
9571  llvm::Expected<llvm::BasicBlock *> exitBlock = convertOmpOpRegions(
9572  targetRegion, "omp.target", builder, moduleTranslation);
9573 
9574  if (failed(handleError(exitBlock, *targetOp)))
9575  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
9576 
9577  builder.SetInsertPoint(exitBlock.get()->getTerminator());
9578 
9579  if (failed(cleanupPrivateVars(targetOp, builder, moduleTranslation,
9580  targetOp.getLoc(), privateVarsInfo)))
9581  return llvm::make_error<PreviouslyReportedError>();
9582 
9583  return builder.saveIP();
9584  };
9585 
9586  StringRef parentName = parentFn.getName();
9587 
9588  llvm::TargetRegionEntryInfo entryInfo;
9589 
9590  getTargetEntryUniqueInfo(entryInfo, targetOp,
9591  *moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder(),
9592  moduleTranslation.getFileSystem(), parentName);
9593 
9594  MapInfoData mapData;
9595  collectMapDataFromMapOperands(mapData, mapVars, moduleTranslation, dl,
9596  builder, /*useDevPtrOperands=*/{},
9597  /*useDevAddrOperands=*/{}, hdaVars);
9598 
9599  MapInfosTy combinedInfos;
9600  auto genMapInfoCB =
9601  [&](llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy codeGenIP) -> MapInfosTy & {
9602  builder.restoreIP(codeGenIP);
9603  genMapInfos(builder, moduleTranslation, dl, combinedInfos, mapData,
9604  targetDirective);
9605 
9606  // Append a null entry for the implicit dyn_ptr argument so the argument
9607  // count sent to the runtime already includes it.
9608  auto *nullPtr = llvm::Constant::getNullValue(builder.getPtrTy());
9609  combinedInfos.BasePointers.push_back(nullPtr);
9610  combinedInfos.Pointers.push_back(nullPtr);
9611  combinedInfos.DevicePointers.push_back(
9612  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DeviceInfoTy::None);
9613  combinedInfos.Sizes.push_back(builder.getInt64(0));
9614  combinedInfos.Types.push_back(
9615  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_TARGET_PARAM |
9616  llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags::OMP_MAP_LITERAL);
9617  // TODO: set HasAttachPtr from Flang for pointee-storage entries.
9618  combinedInfos.HasAttachPtr.push_back(false);
9619  if (!combinedInfos.Names.empty())
9620  combinedInfos.Names.push_back(nullPtr);
9621  combinedInfos.Mappers.push_back(nullptr);
9622 
9623  return combinedInfos;
9624  };
9625 
9626  auto argAccessorCB = [&](llvm::Argument &arg, llvm::Value *input,
9627  llvm::Value *&retVal, InsertPointTy allocaIP,
9628  InsertPointTy codeGenIP,
9629  llvm::ArrayRef<InsertPointTy> deallocIPs)
9630  -> llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy {
9631  llvm::IRBuilderBase::InsertPointGuard guard(builder);
9632  builder.SetCurrentDebugLocation(llvm::DebugLoc());
9633  // We just return the unaltered argument for the host function
9634  // for now, some alterations may be required in the future to
9635  // keep host fallback functions working identically to the device
9636  // version (e.g. pass ByCopy values should be treated as such on
9637  // host and device, currently not always the case)
9638  if (!isTargetDevice) {
9639  retVal = cast<llvm::Value>(&arg);
9640  return codeGenIP;
9641  }
9642 
9643  return createDeviceArgumentAccessor(targetOp, mapData, arg, input, retVal,
9644  builder, *ompBuilder, moduleTranslation,
9645  allocaIP, codeGenIP, deallocIPs);
9646  };
9647 
9648  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::TargetKernelRuntimeAttrs runtimeAttrs;
9649  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::TargetKernelDefaultAttrs defaultAttrs;
9650  Operation *targetCapturedOp =
9651  cast<omp::ComposableOpInterface>(*targetOp).findCapturedOp();
9652  initTargetDefaultAttrs(targetOp, targetCapturedOp, defaultAttrs,
9653  isTargetDevice, isGPU);
9654 
9655  // Collect host-evaluated values needed to properly launch the kernel from the
9656  // host.
9657  if (!isTargetDevice)
9658  initTargetRuntimeAttrs(builder, moduleTranslation, targetOp,
9659  targetCapturedOp, runtimeAttrs);
9660 
9661  // Pass host-evaluated values as parameters to the kernel / host fallback,
9662  // except if they are constants. In any case, map the MLIR block argument to
9663  // the corresponding LLVM values.
9664  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::Value *, 4> kernelInput;
9665  SmallVector<Value> hostEvalVars = targetOp.getHostEvalVars();
9666  ArrayRef<BlockArgument> hostEvalBlockArgs = argIface.getHostEvalBlockArgs();
9667  for (auto [arg, var] : llvm::zip_equal(hostEvalBlockArgs, hostEvalVars)) {
9668  llvm::Value *value = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(var);
9669  moduleTranslation.mapValue(arg, value);
9670 
9671  if (!llvm::isa<llvm::Constant>(value))
9672  kernelInput.push_back(value);
9673  }
9674 
9675  for (size_t i = 0, e = mapData.OriginalValue.size(); i != e; ++i) {
9676  // 1) Declare target arguments are not passed to kernels as arguments.
9677  // 2) Attach maps are not passed in as arguments to kernels, except for
9678  // private attach maps used for corresponding-pointer initialization.
9679  // 3) Children of record objects are not passed in as arguments.
9680  // TODO: We currently do not handle cases where a member is explicitly
9681  // passed in as an argument, this will likley need to be handled in
9682  // the near future, rather than using IsAMember, it may be better to
9683  // test if the relevant BlockArg is used within the target region and
9684  // then use that as a basis for exclusion in the kernel inputs.
9685  using MapFlags = llvm::omp::OpenMPOffloadMappingFlags;
9686  bool isAttachMap = (mapData.Types[i] & MapFlags::OMP_MAP_ATTACH) ==
9687  MapFlags::OMP_MAP_ATTACH;
9688  bool isPrivateTargetParam =
9689  (mapData.Types[i] &
9690  (MapFlags::OMP_MAP_PRIVATE | MapFlags::OMP_MAP_TARGET_PARAM)) ==
9691  (MapFlags::OMP_MAP_PRIVATE | MapFlags::OMP_MAP_TARGET_PARAM);
9692 
9693  if (!mapData.IsDeclareTarget[i] && !mapData.IsAMember[i] &&
9694  (!isAttachMap || (isAttachMap && isPrivateTargetParam)))
9695  kernelInput.push_back(mapData.OriginalValue[i]);
9696  }
9697 
9698  llvm::SmallVector<llvm::BasicBlock *> deallocBlocks;
9699  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointTy allocaIP =
9700  findAllocInsertPoints(builder, moduleTranslation, &deallocBlocks);
9701 
9702  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::DependenciesInfo dds;
9703  if (failed(buildDependData(
9704  targetOp.getDependVars(), targetOp.getDependKinds(),
9705  targetOp.getDependIterated(), targetOp.getDependIteratedKinds(),
9706  builder, moduleTranslation, dds)))
9707  return failure();
9708 
9709  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
9710 
9711  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::TargetDataInfo info(
9712  /*RequiresDevicePointerInfo=*/false,
9713  /*SeparateBeginEndCalls=*/true);
9714 
9715  auto customMapperCB =
9716  [&](unsigned int i) -> llvm::Expected<llvm::Function *> {
9717  if (!combinedInfos.Mappers[i])
9718  return nullptr;
9719  info.HasMapper = true;
9720  return getOrCreateUserDefinedMapperFunc(combinedInfos.Mappers[i], builder,
9721  moduleTranslation, targetDirective);
9722  };
9723 
9724  llvm::Value *ifCond = nullptr;
9725  if (Value targetIfCond = targetOp.getIfExpr())
9726  ifCond = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(targetIfCond);
9727 
9728  Value dynGroupPrivateSize = targetOp.getDynGroupprivateSize();
9729  llvm::Value *dynSizeVal = nullptr;
9730  if (dynGroupPrivateSize) {
9731  dynSizeVal = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(dynGroupPrivateSize);
9732  dynSizeVal = builder.CreateIntCast(dynSizeVal, builder.getInt32Ty(),
9733  /*isSigned=*/false);
9734  }
9735 
9736  llvm::omp::OMPDynGroupprivateFallbackType fallbackType =
9737  getDynGroupprivateFallbackType(targetOp.getDynGroupprivateFallbackAttr());
9738 
9739  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterIP =
9740  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->createTarget(
9741  ompLoc, isOffloadEntry, allocaIP, builder.saveIP(), deallocBlocks,
9742  info, entryInfo, defaultAttrs, runtimeAttrs, ifCond, kernelInput,
9743  genMapInfoCB, bodyCB, argAccessorCB, customMapperCB, dds,
9744  targetOp.getNowait(), dynSizeVal, fallbackType, outlinedFnDbgLoc);
9745 
9746  if (failed(handleError(afterIP, opInst)))
9747  return failure();
9748 
9749  builder.restoreIP(*afterIP);
9750 
9751  if (dds.DepArray)
9752  builder.CreateFree(dds.DepArray);
9753 
9754  return success();
9755 }
9756 
9757 static LogicalResult
9758 convertDeclareTargetAttr(Operation *op, mlir::omp::DeclareTargetAttr attribute,
9759  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder,
9760  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
9761  // Amend omp.declare_target by deleting the IR of the outlined functions
9762  // created for target regions. They cannot be filtered out from MLIR earlier
9763  // because the omp.target operation inside must be translated to LLVM, but
9764  // the wrapper functions themselves must not remain at the end of the
9765  // process. We know that functions where omp.declare_target does not match
9766  // omp.is_target_device at this stage can only be wrapper functions because
9767  // those that aren't are removed earlier as an MLIR transformation pass.
9768  if (FunctionOpInterface funcOp = dyn_cast<FunctionOpInterface>(op)) {
9769  if (auto offloadMod = dyn_cast<omp::OffloadModuleInterface>(
9770  op->getParentOfType<ModuleOp>().getOperation())) {
9771  if (!offloadMod.getIsTargetDevice())
9772  return success();
9773 
9774  omp::DeclareTargetDeviceType declareType =
9775  attribute.getDeviceType().getValue();
9776 
9777  if (declareType == omp::DeclareTargetDeviceType::host) {
9778  llvm::Function *llvmFunc =
9779  moduleTranslation.lookupFunction(funcOp.getName());
9780  llvmFunc->dropAllReferences();
9781  llvmFunc->eraseFromParent();
9782 
9783  // Invalidate the builder's current insertion point, as it now points to
9784  // a deleted block.
9785  ompBuilder->Builder.ClearInsertionPoint();
9786  ompBuilder->Builder.SetCurrentDebugLocation(llvm::DebugLoc());
9787  } else if (llvm::Function *llvmFunc =
9788  moduleTranslation.lookupFunction(funcOp.getName())) {
9789  // Device-side declare target functions are externally visible by
9790  // default so they can be referenced from other device translation
9791  // units. That also prevents the offload LTO from internalizing and
9792  // deleting them when they end up unused in the final device image.
9793  // Such dead functions can still reference internal LDS and trigger
9794  // spurious "local memory global used by non-kernel function" backend
9795  // warnings. Marking them hidden keeps the symbol usable within the
9796  // device image's linkage unit while letting LTO drop it when nothing
9797  // references it; symbols that must stay reachable (e.g. via an offload
9798  // entry that takes their address) are kept alive by that reference.
9799  if (!llvmFunc->isDeclaration() && llvmFunc->hasExternalLinkage() &&
9800  llvmFunc->getVisibility() == llvm::GlobalValue::DefaultVisibility)
9801  llvmFunc->setVisibility(llvm::GlobalValue::HiddenVisibility);
9802  }
9803  }
9804  return success();
9805  }
9806 
9807  if (LLVM::GlobalOp gOp = dyn_cast<LLVM::GlobalOp>(op)) {
9808  llvm::Module *llvmModule = moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule();
9809  if (auto *gVal = llvmModule->getNamedValue(gOp.getSymName())) {
9810  auto *gVar = cast<llvm::GlobalVariable>(gVal);
9811  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
9812  bool isDeclaration = gOp.isDeclaration();
9813  bool isExternallyVisible =
9814  gOp.getVisibility() != mlir::SymbolTable::Visibility::Private;
9815  auto loc = op->getLoc()->findInstanceOf<FileLineColLoc>();
9816  llvm::StringRef mangledName = gOp.getSymName();
9817  mlir::omp::DeclareTargetCaptureClause captureClause =
9818  attribute.getCaptureClause().getValue();
9819  auto captureClauseKind = convertToCaptureClauseKind(captureClause);
9820  auto deviceClause =
9821  convertToDeviceClauseKind(attribute.getDeviceType().getValue());
9822  llvm::StringRef entryMangledName = mangledName;
9823  llvm::Constant *entryAddr = llvm::cast<llvm::Constant>(gVal);
9824  std::function<llvm::GlobalValue::LinkageTypes()> variableLinkage;
9825  llvm::SmallString<128> entryNameStorage;
9826  bool requiresUSM = ompBuilder->Config.hasRequiresUnifiedSharedMemory();
9827  bool isToOrEnter =
9828  captureClause == omp::DeclareTargetCaptureClause::to ||
9829  captureClause == omp::DeclareTargetCaptureClause::enter;
9830  bool isHostOnly = attribute.getDeviceType().getValue() ==
9831  omp::DeclareTargetDeviceType::host;
9832 
9833  // A to/enter declare-target variable needs a device-resident,
9834  // name-resolvable copy and a host offloading entry. A local-linkage
9835  // global provides neither, so we promote it to external.
9836  if (isToOrEnter && !isHostOnly && !requiresUSM &&
9837  gVar->hasLocalLinkage()) {
9838  gVar->setLinkage(llvm::GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);
9839  isExternallyVisible = true;
9840 
9841  // Clear the stale dso_local flag so it is referenced like a
9842  // module-scope declare target global.
9843  if (ompBuilder->Config.isTargetDevice())
9844  gVar->setDSOLocal(false);
9845  }
9846 
9847  if (isToOrEnter &&
9848  deviceClause ==
9849  llvm::OffloadEntriesInfoManager::OMPTargetDeviceClauseAny &&
9850  !requiresUSM && !isDeclaration &&
9851  (gVal->hasLocalLinkage() || gVal->hasHiddenVisibility())) {
9852  // Keep the original symbol as-is for target code, but create a visible
9853  // alias for the offload entry so libomptarget can associate the host
9854  // global with the actual device global.
9855  entryNameStorage = (mangledName + llvm::Twine("_decl_tgt_entry")).str();
9856  entryMangledName = entryNameStorage;
9857  if (llvm::GlobalValue *existing =
9858  llvmModule->getNamedValue(entryMangledName)) {
9859  entryAddr = llvm::cast<llvm::Constant>(existing);
9860  } else {
9861  entryAddr = llvm::GlobalAlias::create(
9862  gVal->getValueType(), gVal->getAddressSpace(),
9863  llvm::GlobalValue::WeakAnyLinkage, entryMangledName, entryAddr,
9864  llvmModule);
9865  llvm::cast<llvm::GlobalAlias>(entryAddr)->setVisibility(
9866  llvm::GlobalValue::DefaultVisibility);
9867  }
9868  variableLinkage = [] { return llvm::GlobalValue::WeakAnyLinkage; };
9869  }
9870  // unused for MLIR at the moment, required in Clang for book
9871  // keeping
9872  std::vector<llvm::GlobalVariable *> generatedRefs;
9873 
9874  std::vector<llvm::Triple> targetTriple;
9875  auto targetTripleAttr = dyn_cast_or_null<mlir::StringAttr>(
9876  op->getParentOfType<mlir::ModuleOp>()->getDiscardableAttr(
9877  LLVM::LLVMDialect::getTargetTripleAttrName()));
9878  if (targetTripleAttr)
9879  targetTriple.emplace_back(targetTripleAttr.data());
9880 
9881  auto fileInfoCallBack = [&loc]() {
9882  std::string filename = "";
9883  std::uint64_t lineNo = 0;
9884 
9885  if (loc) {
9886  filename = loc.getFilename().str();
9887  lineNo = loc.getLine();
9888  }
9889 
9890  return std::pair<std::string, std::uint64_t>(llvm::StringRef(filename),
9891  lineNo);
9892  };
9893 
9894  llvm::vfs::FileSystem &vfs = moduleTranslation.getFileSystem();
9895  ompBuilder->registerTargetGlobalVariable(
9896  captureClauseKind, deviceClause, isDeclaration, isExternallyVisible,
9897  ompBuilder->getTargetEntryUniqueInfo(fileInfoCallBack, vfs),
9898  entryMangledName, generatedRefs, /*OpenMPSimd*/ false, targetTriple,
9899  /*GlobalInitializer*/ nullptr, variableLinkage, gVal->getType(),
9900  entryAddr);
9901 
9902  if (ompBuilder->Config.isTargetDevice() &&
9903  (captureClause == omp::DeclareTargetCaptureClause::link ||
9904  requiresUSM)) {
9905  // For USM and link we generate a global reference pointer in the
9906  // default address space (e.g address space 0), as opposed to the
9907  // globals original type and address space.
9908  llvm::Type *ptrTy = llvm::PointerType::get(llvmModule->getContext(), 0);
9909  llvm::Constant *refPtr = ompBuilder->getAddrOfDeclareTargetVar(
9910  captureClauseKind, deviceClause, isDeclaration, isExternallyVisible,
9911  ompBuilder->getTargetEntryUniqueInfo(fileInfoCallBack, vfs),
9912  mangledName, generatedRefs, /*OpenMPSimd*/ false, targetTriple,
9913  ptrTy, /*GlobalInitializer*/ nullptr,
9914  /*VariableLinkage*/ nullptr);
9915 
9916  // For indirectly-accessed global pointers, we rely on "internal"
9917  // linkage to optimize out the unneeded full-variable storage later,
9918  // since we can't prevent the LLVM dialect from generating globals
9919  // without also breaking target lowering.
9920  if (refPtr) {
9921  gVar->setLinkage(llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
9922 
9923  // Register the (original global, reference pointer) pair so that the
9924  // OpenMPIRBuilder can rewrite uses of the original global during
9925  // finalization.
9926  if (auto *newGV =
9927  dyn_cast<llvm::GlobalValue>(refPtr->stripPointerCasts()))
9928  ompBuilder->registerDeclareTargetGlobalReplacement(gVal, newGV);
9929  }
9930  }
9931 
9932  // Mark 'device_type(host) enter(...)' variables as external in the device
9933  // since they're not supposed to have their own copy. This will cause
9934  // linker errors if accesses are attempted from the target device.
9935  if (ompBuilder->Config.isTargetDevice() && isHostOnly && isToOrEnter) {
9936  gVar->setLinkage(llvm::GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);
9937  gVar->setInitializer(nullptr);
9938  }
9939  }
9940  }
9941 
9942  return success();
9943 }

9945 namespace {
9946 
9947 /// Implementation of the dialect interface that converts operations belonging
9948 /// to the OpenMP dialect to LLVM IR.
9949 class OpenMPDialectLLVMIRTranslationInterface
9950  : public LLVMTranslationDialectInterface {
9951 public:
9952  using LLVMTranslationDialectInterface::LLVMTranslationDialectInterface;
9953 
9954  /// Translates the given operation to LLVM IR using the provided IR builder
9955  /// and saving the state in `moduleTranslation`.
9956  LogicalResult
9957  convertOperation(Operation *op, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
9958  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) const final;
9959 
9960  /// Given an OpenMP MLIR attribute, create the corresponding LLVM-IR,
9961  /// runtime calls, or operation amendments
9962  LogicalResult
9963  amendOperation(Operation *op, ArrayRef<llvm::Instruction *> instructions,
9964  NamedAttribute attribute,
9965  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) const final;
9966 
9967  /// Records the LLVM alloc pointer produced for an OMP ALLOCATE variable so
9968  /// that the paired omp.allocate_free op can generate the matching
9969  /// __kmpc_free call.
9970  void registerAllocatedPtr(Value var, llvm::Value *ptr) const {
9971  ompAllocatedPtrs[var] = ptr;
9972  }
9973 
9974  /// Returns the LLVM alloc pointer previously registered for var, or
9975  /// nullptr if no allocation was recorded.
9976  llvm::Value *lookupAllocatedPtr(Value var) const {
9977  auto it = ompAllocatedPtrs.find(var);
9978  return it != ompAllocatedPtrs.end() ? it->second : nullptr;
9979  }
9980 
9981 private:
9982  /// Maps each MLIR variable value that appeared in an omp.allocate_dir op to
9983  /// the LLVM pointer returned by the corresponding __kmpc_alloc call. The
9984  /// paired omp.allocate_free op looks up these pointers to emit __kmpc_free.
9985  mutable DenseMap<Value, llvm::Value *> ompAllocatedPtrs;
9986 };
9987

9990 LogicalResult OpenMPDialectLLVMIRTranslationInterface::amendOperation(
9991  Operation *op, ArrayRef<llvm::Instruction *> instructions,
9992  NamedAttribute attribute,
9993  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) const {
9994  return llvm::StringSwitch<llvm::function_ref<LogicalResult(Attribute)>>(
9995  attribute.getName())
9996  .Case("omp.is_target_device",
9997  [&](Attribute attr) {
9998  if (auto deviceAttr = dyn_cast<BoolAttr>(attr)) {
9999  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilderConfig &config =
10000  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->Config;
10001  config.setIsTargetDevice(deviceAttr.getValue());
10002  return success();
10003  }
10004  return failure();
10005  })
10006  .Case("omp.is_gpu",
10007  [&](Attribute attr) {
10008  if (auto gpuAttr = dyn_cast<BoolAttr>(attr)) {
10009  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilderConfig &config =
10010  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->Config;
10011  config.setIsGPU(gpuAttr.getValue());
10012  return success();
10013  }
10014  return failure();
10015  })
10016  .Case("omp.host_ir_filepath",
10017  [&](Attribute attr) {
10018  if (auto filepathAttr = dyn_cast<StringAttr>(attr)) {
10019  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder =
10020  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
10021  ompBuilder->loadOffloadInfoMetadata(
10022  moduleTranslation.getFileSystem(), filepathAttr.getValue());
10023  return success();
10024  }
10025  return failure();
10026  })
10027  .Case("omp.flags",
10028  [&](Attribute attr) {
10029  if (auto rtlAttr = dyn_cast<omp::FlagsAttr>(attr))
10030  return convertFlagsAttr(op, rtlAttr, moduleTranslation);
10031  return failure();
10032  })
10033  .Case("omp.version",
10034  [&](Attribute attr) {
10035  if (auto versionAttr = dyn_cast<omp::VersionAttr>(attr)) {
10036  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder =
10037  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
10038  ompBuilder->M.addModuleFlag(llvm::Module::Max, "openmp",
10039  versionAttr.getVersion());
10040  return success();
10041  }
10042  return failure();
10043  })
10044  .Case("omp.declare_target",
10045  [&](Attribute attr) {
10046  if (auto declareTargetAttr =
10047  dyn_cast<omp::DeclareTargetAttr>(attr)) {
10048  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder =
10049  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
10050  return convertDeclareTargetAttr(op, declareTargetAttr,
10051  ompBuilder, moduleTranslation);
10052  }
10053  return failure();
10054  })
10055  .Case("omp.requires",
10056  [&](Attribute attr) {
10057  if (auto requiresAttr = dyn_cast<omp::ClauseRequiresAttr>(attr)) {
10058  using Requires = omp::ClauseRequires;
10059  Requires flags = requiresAttr.getValue();
10060  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilderConfig &config =
10061  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->Config;
10062  config.setHasRequiresReverseOffload(
10063  bitEnumContainsAll(flags, Requires::reverse_offload));
10064  config.setHasRequiresUnifiedAddress(
10065  bitEnumContainsAll(flags, Requires::unified_address));
10066  config.setHasRequiresUnifiedSharedMemory(
10067  bitEnumContainsAll(flags, Requires::unified_shared_memory));
10068  config.setHasRequiresDynamicAllocators(
10069  bitEnumContainsAll(flags, Requires::dynamic_allocators));
10070  return success();
10071  }
10072  return failure();
10073  })
10074  .Case("omp.target_triples",
10075  [&](Attribute attr) {
10076  if (auto triplesAttr = dyn_cast<ArrayAttr>(attr)) {
10077  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilderConfig &config =
10078  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->Config;
10079  config.TargetTriples.clear();
10080  config.TargetTriples.reserve(triplesAttr.size());
10081  for (Attribute tripleAttr : triplesAttr) {
10082  if (auto tripleStrAttr = dyn_cast<StringAttr>(tripleAttr))
10083  config.TargetTriples.emplace_back(tripleStrAttr.getValue());
10084  else
10085  return failure();
10086  }
10087  return success();
10088  }
10089  return failure();
10090  })
10091  .Case("omp.integer_wrap_around",
10092  [&](Attribute attr) {
10093  if (auto wrapAttr = dyn_cast<omp::IntegerWrapAroundAttr>(attr)) {
10094  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilderConfig &config =
10095  moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder()->Config;
10096  config.setNoSignedWrap(!wrapAttr.getIntegerWrapAround());
10097  return success();
10098  }
10099  return failure();
10100  })
10101  .Default([](Attribute) {
10102  // Fall through for omp attributes that do not require lowering.
10103  return success();
10104  })(attribute.getValue());
10105 
10106  return failure();
10107 }

10109 // Returns true if the operation is not inside a TargetOp, it is part of a
10110 // function and that function is not declare target.
10111 static bool isHostDeviceOp(Operation *op) {
10112  // Assumes no reverse offloading
10113  if (op->getParentOfType<omp::TargetOp>())
10114  return false;
10115 
10116  if (auto parentFn = op->getParentOfType<LLVM::LLVMFuncOp>()) {
10117  if (auto declareTargetIface =
10118  llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::omp::DeclareTargetInterface>(
10119  parentFn.getOperation()))
10120  if (declareTargetIface.isDeclareTarget() &&
10121  declareTargetIface.getDeclareTargetDeviceType() !=
10122  mlir::omp::DeclareTargetDeviceType::host)
10123  return false;
10124 
10125  return true;
10126  }
10127 
10128  return false;
10129 }

10131 static llvm::Function *getOmpTargetAlloc(llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
10132  llvm::Module *llvmModule) {
10133  llvm::Type *i64Ty = builder.getInt64Ty();
10134  llvm::Type *i32Ty = builder.getInt32Ty();
10135  llvm::Type *returnType = builder.getPtrTy(0);
10136  llvm::FunctionType *fnType =
10137  llvm::FunctionType::get(returnType, {i64Ty, i32Ty}, false);
10138  llvm::Function *func = cast<llvm::Function>(
10139  llvmModule->getOrInsertFunction("omp_target_alloc", fnType).getCallee());
10140  return func;
10141 }

10143 template <typename T>
10144 static llvm::Value *
10145 getAllocationSize(llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
10146  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation, T op) {
10147  llvm::DataLayout dataLayout =
10148  moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule()->getDataLayout();
10149  llvm::Type *llvmHeapTy =
10150  moduleTranslation.convertType(op.getMemElemTypeAttr().getValue());
10151 
10152  auto alignment = op.getMemAlignment();
10153  llvm::TypeSize typeSize = llvm::alignTo(
10154  dataLayout.getTypeStoreSize(llvmHeapTy),
10155  alignment ? *alignment : dataLayout.getABITypeAlign(llvmHeapTy).value());
10156 
10157  llvm::Value *allocSize = builder.getInt64(typeSize.getFixedValue());
10158  return builder.CreateMul(
10159  allocSize,
10160  builder.CreateIntCast(moduleTranslation.lookupValue(op.getMemArraySize()),
10161  builder.getInt64Ty(),
10162  /*isSigned=*/false));
10163 }
10164 
10165 template <>
10166 llvm::Value *getAllocationSize(llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
10167  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation,
10168  omp::TargetAllocMemOp op) {
10169  llvm::DataLayout dataLayout =
10170  moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule()->getDataLayout();
10171  llvm::Type *llvmHeapTy = moduleTranslation.convertType(op.getAllocatedType());
10172  llvm::TypeSize typeSize = dataLayout.getTypeAllocSize(llvmHeapTy);
10173  llvm::Value *allocSize = builder.getInt64(typeSize.getFixedValue());
10174  for (auto typeParam : op.getTypeparams()) {
10175  allocSize = builder.CreateMul(
10176  allocSize,
10177  builder.CreateIntCast(moduleTranslation.lookupValue(typeParam),
10178  builder.getInt64Ty(),
10179  /*isSigned=*/false));
10180  }
10181  return allocSize;
10182 }
10183 
10184 static LogicalResult
10185 convertTargetAllocMemOp(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
10186  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
10187  auto allocMemOp = cast<omp::TargetAllocMemOp>(opInst);
10188  if (!allocMemOp)
10189  return failure();
10190 
10191  // Get "omp_target_alloc" function
10192  llvm::Module *llvmModule = moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule();
10193  llvm::Function *ompTargetAllocFunc = getOmpTargetAlloc(builder, llvmModule);
10194  // Get the corresponding device value in llvm
10195  mlir::Value deviceNum = allocMemOp.getDevice();
10196  llvm::Value *llvmDeviceNum = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(deviceNum);
10197  // Get the allocation size.
10198  llvm::Value *allocSize =
10199  getAllocationSize(builder, moduleTranslation, allocMemOp);
10200  // Create call to "omp_target_alloc" with the args as translated llvm values.
10201  llvm::CallInst *call =
10202  builder.CreateCall(ompTargetAllocFunc, {allocSize, llvmDeviceNum});
10203  llvm::Value *resultI64 = builder.CreatePtrToInt(call, builder.getInt64Ty());
10204 
10205  // Map the result
10206  moduleTranslation.mapValue(allocMemOp.getResult(), resultI64);
10207  return success();
10208 }
10209 
10210 static LogicalResult
10211 convertAllocSharedMemOp(omp::AllocSharedMemOp allocMemOp,
10212  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
10213  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
10214  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
10215  llvm::Value *size = getAllocationSize(builder, moduleTranslation, allocMemOp);
10216  moduleTranslation.mapValue(allocMemOp.getResult(),
10217  ompBuilder->createOMPAllocShared(builder, size));
10218  return success();
10219 }

10221 static LogicalResult
10222 convertAllocateDirOp(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
10223  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation,
10224  const OpenMPDialectLLVMIRTranslationInterface &ompIface) {
10225  auto allocateDirOp = cast<omp::AllocateDirOp>(opInst);
10226  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
10227 
10228  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
10229  llvm::Module *llvmModule = moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule();
10230  llvm::DataLayout dataLayout = llvmModule->getDataLayout();
10231  SmallVector<Value> vars = allocateDirOp.getVarList();
10232  std::optional<int64_t> alignAttr = allocateDirOp.getAlign();
10233 
10234  llvm::Value *allocator;
10235  if (auto allocatorVar = allocateDirOp.getAllocator()) {
10236  allocator = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(allocatorVar);
10237  if (allocator->getType()->isIntegerTy())
10238  allocator = builder.CreateIntToPtr(allocator, builder.getPtrTy());
10239  else if (allocator->getType()->isPointerTy())
10240  allocator = builder.CreatePointerBitCastOrAddrSpaceCast(
10241  allocator, builder.getPtrTy());
10242  } else {
10243  allocator = llvm::ConstantPointerNull::get(builder.getPtrTy());
10244  }
10245 
10246  for (Value var : vars) {
10247  llvm::Type *llvmVarTy = moduleTranslation.convertType(var.getType());
10248 
10249  // Opaque pointers lose element type. Trace to GlobalOp for type
10250  // Falls back to llvmVarTy when not from a global.
10251  llvm::Type *typeToInspect = llvmVarTy;
10252  if (llvmVarTy->isPointerTy()) {
10253  Value baseVar = getBaseValueForTypeLookup(var);
10254  if (Operation *globalOp = getGlobalOpFromValue(baseVar)) {
10255  if (auto gop = dyn_cast<LLVM::GlobalOp>(globalOp))
10256  typeToInspect = moduleTranslation.convertType(gop.getGlobalType());
10257  }
10258  }
10259 
10260  llvm::Value *size;
10261  if (auto arrTy = llvm::dyn_cast<llvm::ArrayType>(typeToInspect)) {
10262  llvm::Value *elementCount = builder.getInt64(1);
10263  llvm::Type *currentType = arrTy;
10264  while (auto nestedArrTy = llvm::dyn_cast<llvm::ArrayType>(currentType)) {
10265  elementCount = builder.CreateMul(
10266  elementCount, builder.getInt64(nestedArrTy->getNumElements()));
10267  currentType = nestedArrTy->getElementType();
10268  }
10269  uint64_t elemSizeInBits = dataLayout.getTypeSizeInBits(currentType);
10270  size =
10271  builder.CreateMul(elementCount, builder.getInt64(elemSizeInBits / 8));
10272  } else {
10273  size = builder.getInt64(
10274  dataLayout.getTypeStoreSize(typeToInspect).getFixedValue());
10275  }
10276 
10277  uint64_t alignValue =
10278  alignAttr ? alignAttr.value()
10279  : dataLayout.getABITypeAlign(typeToInspect).value();
10280  llvm::Value *alignConst = builder.getInt64(alignValue);
10281  // Align the size: ((size + align - 1) / align) * align
10282  size = builder.CreateAdd(size, builder.getInt64(alignValue - 1), "", true);
10283  size = builder.CreateUDiv(size, alignConst);
10284  size = builder.CreateMul(size, alignConst, "", true);
10285 
10286  std::string allocName =
10287  ompBuilder->createPlatformSpecificName({".void.addr"});
10288  llvm::CallInst *allocCall;
10289  if (alignAttr.has_value()) {
10290  allocCall = ompBuilder->createOMPAlignedAlloc(
10291  ompLoc, builder.getInt64(alignAttr.value()), size, allocator,
10292  allocName);
10293  } else {
10294  allocCall =
10295  ompBuilder->createOMPAlloc(ompLoc, size, allocator, allocName);
10296  }
10297  // Record the alloc pointer keyed by the MLIR variable value.
10298  ompIface.registerAllocatedPtr(var, allocCall);
10299  }
10300 
10301  return success();
10302 }
10303 
10304 static LogicalResult
10305 convertAllocateFreeOp(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
10306  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation,
10307  const OpenMPDialectLLVMIRTranslationInterface &ompIface) {
10308  auto freeOp = cast<omp::AllocateFreeOp>(opInst);
10309  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
10310  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::LocationDescription ompLoc(builder);
10311 
10312  llvm::Value *allocator;
10313  if (auto allocatorVar = freeOp.getAllocator()) {
10314  allocator = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(allocatorVar);
10315  if (allocator->getType()->isIntegerTy())
10316  allocator = builder.CreateIntToPtr(allocator, builder.getPtrTy());
10317  else if (allocator->getType()->isPointerTy())
10318  allocator = builder.CreatePointerBitCastOrAddrSpaceCast(
10319  allocator, builder.getPtrTy());
10320  } else {
10321  allocator = llvm::ConstantPointerNull::get(builder.getPtrTy());
10322  }
10323 
10324  // Emit __kmpc_free for each variable in reverse allocation order.
10325  SmallVector<Value> vars = freeOp.getVarList();
10326  for (Value var : llvm::reverse(vars)) {
10327  llvm::Value *allocPtr = ompIface.lookupAllocatedPtr(var);
10328  if (!allocPtr)
10329  return opInst.emitError("omp.allocate_free: no allocation recorded");
10330  ompBuilder->createOMPFree(ompLoc, allocPtr, allocator, "");
10331  }
10332 
10333  return success();
10334 }
10335 
10336 static llvm::Function *getOmpTargetFree(llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
10337  llvm::Module *llvmModule) {
10338  llvm::Type *ptrTy = builder.getPtrTy(0);
10339  llvm::Type *i32Ty = builder.getInt32Ty();
10340  llvm::Type *voidTy = builder.getVoidTy();
10341  llvm::FunctionType *fnType =
10342  llvm::FunctionType::get(voidTy, {ptrTy, i32Ty}, false);
10343  llvm::Function *func = dyn_cast<llvm::Function>(
10344  llvmModule->getOrInsertFunction("omp_target_free", fnType).getCallee());
10345  return func;
10346 }

10348 static LogicalResult
10349 convertTargetFreeMemOp(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
10350  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
10351  auto freeMemOp = cast<omp::TargetFreeMemOp>(opInst);
10352  if (!freeMemOp)
10353  return failure();
10354 
10355  // Get "omp_target_free" function
10356  llvm::Module *llvmModule = moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule();
10357  llvm::Function *ompTragetFreeFunc = getOmpTargetFree(builder, llvmModule);
10358  // Get the corresponding device value in llvm
10359  mlir::Value deviceNum = freeMemOp.getDevice();
10360  llvm::Value *llvmDeviceNum = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(deviceNum);
10361  // Get the corresponding heapref value in llvm
10362  mlir::Value heapref = freeMemOp.getHeapref();
10363  llvm::Value *llvmHeapref = moduleTranslation.lookupValue(heapref);
10364  // Convert heapref int to ptr and call "omp_target_free"
10365  llvm::Value *intToPtr =
10366  builder.CreateIntToPtr(llvmHeapref, builder.getPtrTy(0));
10367  builder.CreateCall(ompTragetFreeFunc, {intToPtr, llvmDeviceNum});
10368  return success();
10369 }
10370 
10371 static LogicalResult
10372 convertFreeSharedMemOp(omp::FreeSharedMemOp freeMemOp,
10373  llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
10374  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
10375  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
10376  llvm::Value *size = getAllocationSize(builder, moduleTranslation, freeMemOp);
10377  ompBuilder->createOMPFreeShared(
10378  builder, moduleTranslation.lookupValue(freeMemOp.getHeapref()), size);
10379  return success();
10380 }

10382 /// Converts an OpenMP groupprivate operation into LLVM IR.
10383 static LogicalResult
10384 convertOmpGroupprivate(Operation &opInst, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
10385  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) {
10386  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
10387  auto groupprivateOp = cast<omp::GroupprivateOp>(opInst);
10388 
10389  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(opInst)))
10390  return failure();
10391 
10392  bool isTargetDevice = ompBuilder->Config.isTargetDevice();
10393 
10394  // Determine whether group-private storage should be allocated based on
10395  // device_type. When not specified, default to 'any' (allocate on both).
10396  bool shouldAllocate = true;
10397  switch (groupprivateOp.getDeviceType().value_or(
10398  mlir::omp::DeclareTargetDeviceType::any)) {
10399  case mlir::omp::DeclareTargetDeviceType::host:
10400  shouldAllocate = !isTargetDevice;
10401  break;
10402  case mlir::omp::DeclareTargetDeviceType::nohost:
10403  shouldAllocate = isTargetDevice;
10404  break;
10405  case mlir::omp::DeclareTargetDeviceType::any:
10406  shouldAllocate = true;
10407  break;
10408  }
10409 
10410  // Look up the global variable directly by symbol name.
10411  LLVM::GlobalOp global = SymbolTable::lookupNearestSymbolFrom<LLVM::GlobalOp>(
10412  &opInst, groupprivateOp.getSymNameAttr());
10413  if (!global)
10414  return opInst.emitError()
10415  << "expected symbol '" << groupprivateOp.getSymName()
10416  << "' to reference an LLVM global variable";
10417 
10418  llvm::GlobalValue *globalValue = moduleTranslation.lookupGlobal(global);
10419  llvm::Type *varType = moduleTranslation.convertType(global.getType());
10420  std::string varName = globalValue->getName().str();
10421 
10422  llvm::Value *resultPtr;
10423  if (shouldAllocate && isTargetDevice) {
10424  llvm::Module *llvmModule = moduleTranslation.getLLVMModule();
10425  llvm::Triple targetTriple(llvmModule->getTargetTriple());
10426  unsigned sharedAddressSpace;
10427  if (targetTriple.isAMDGCN())
10428  sharedAddressSpace = llvm::AMDGPUAS::LOCAL_ADDRESS;
10429  else if (targetTriple.isNVPTX())
10430  sharedAddressSpace = llvm::NVPTXAS::ADDRESS_SPACE_SHARED;
10431  else
10432  return opInst.emitError() << "groupprivate is not supported for target: "
10433  << targetTriple.str();
10434  llvm::GlobalVariable *sharedVar = new llvm::GlobalVariable(
10435  *llvmModule, varType, /*isConstant=*/false,
10436  llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, llvm::PoisonValue::get(varType),
10437  varName, /*InsertBefore=*/nullptr, llvm::GlobalValue::NotThreadLocal,
10438  sharedAddressSpace,
10439  /*isExternallyInitialized=*/false);
10440  resultPtr = sharedVar;
10441  } else {
10442  if (shouldAllocate && !isTargetDevice)
10443  opInst.emitWarning("groupprivate directive is currently ignored on the "
10444  "host, using original global");
10445  resultPtr = globalValue;
10446  }
10447 
10448  moduleTranslation.mapValue(opInst.getResult(0), resultPtr);
10449  return success();
10450 }
10451 
10452 /// Given an OpenMP MLIR operation, create the corresponding LLVM IR (including
10453 /// OpenMP runtime calls).
10454 LogicalResult OpenMPDialectLLVMIRTranslationInterface::convertOperation(
10455  Operation *op, llvm::IRBuilderBase &builder,
10456  LLVM::ModuleTranslation &moduleTranslation) const {
10457  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder *ompBuilder = moduleTranslation.getOpenMPBuilder();
10458 
10459  if (ompBuilder->Config.isTargetDevice() &&
10460  !isa<omp::TargetOp, omp::MapInfoOp, omp::TerminatorOp, omp::YieldOp>(
10461  op) &&
10462  isHostDeviceOp(op))
10463  return op->emitOpError() << "unsupported host op found in device";
10464 
10465  // For each loop, introduce one stack frame to hold loop information. Ensure
10466  // this is only done for the outermost loop wrapper to prevent introducing
10467  // multiple stack frames for a single loop. Initially set to null, the loop
10468  // information structure is initialized during translation of the nested
10469  // omp.loop_nest operation, making it available to translation of all loop
10470  // wrappers after their body has been successfully translated.
10471  bool isOutermostLoopWrapper =
10472  isa_and_present<omp::LoopWrapperInterface>(op) &&
10473  !dyn_cast_if_present<omp::LoopWrapperInterface>(op->getParentOp());
10474 
10475  // The TASKLOOP construct is implemented with an outer taskloop.context
10476  // operation which is not a loop wrapper, containing an inner taskloop
10477  // operation which is a loop wrapper. The stack frame should be pushed when
10478  // translating the outer taskloop.context and popped when translating the
10479  // inner taskloop which is a loop wrapper. We need access to the loop
10480  // information in the outer taskloop context so we need to create it and pop
10481  // it around the taskloop context not the inner loop wrapper.
10482  if (isa<omp::TaskloopContextOp>(op))
10483  isOutermostLoopWrapper = true;
10484  else if (isa<omp::TaskloopWrapperOp>(op))
10485  isOutermostLoopWrapper = false;
10486 
10487  if (isOutermostLoopWrapper)
10488  moduleTranslation.stackPush<OpenMPLoopInfoStackFrame>();
10489 
10490  auto result =
10491  llvm::TypeSwitch<Operation *, LogicalResult>(op)
10492  .Case([&](omp::BarrierOp op) -> LogicalResult {
10493  if (failed(checkImplementationStatus(*op)))
10494  return failure();
10495 
10496  llvm::OpenMPIRBuilder::InsertPointOrErrorTy afterIP =
10497  ompBuilder->createBarrier(builder, llvm::omp::OMPD_barrier);
10498  LogicalResult res = handleError(afterIP, *op);
10499  if (res.succeeded()) {
10500  // If the barrier generated a cancellation check, the insertion
10501  // point might now need to be changed to a new continuation block
